counteroffer_components AS (
    SELECT
        ei.application_id,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN LEAST(ei.requested_amount, ei.product_max_approved_amount)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS counteroffer_product_cap_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND ei.requested_payment_to_income_ratio > 0
                THEN ei.requested_amount
                     * ei.counteroffer_target_pti
                     / ei.requested_payment_to_income_ratio

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND ei.requested_payment_to_income_ratio = 0
                THEN ei.requested_amount

            ELSE NULL
        END AS counteroffer_pti_target_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN ei.product_approved_el_cap / NULLIF((ei.estimated_pd * ei.estimated_lgd), 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS counteroffer_el_cap_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN GREATEST(
                    ei.product_min_approved_amount,
                    ei.requested_amount * ei.product_min_counteroffer_pct,
                    ei.requested_amount * (1.0 - ei.product_max_exposure_reduction_pct)
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS counteroffer_min_viable_amount

    FROM exposure_inputs ei
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Raw maximum feasible counteroffer amount.

The raw maximum feasible amount is the most conservative of:
    requested amount
    product cap amount
    PTI target amount
    approved Expected Loss cap amount

A NULL component produces a NULL raw feasible amount because silent fallback would hide an
unresolved feasibility constraint.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
counteroffer_raw_feasible AS (
    SELECT
        cc.application_id,
        cc.counteroffer_product_cap_amount,
        cc.counteroffer_pti_target_amount,
        cc.counteroffer_el_cap_amount,
        cc.counteroffer_min_viable_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN cc.counteroffer_product_cap_amount IS NULL
              OR cc.counteroffer_pti_target_amount IS NULL
              OR cc.counteroffer_el_cap_amount IS NULL
                THEN NULL
            ELSE LEAST(
                ei.requested_amount,
                cc.counteroffer_product_cap_amount,
                cc.counteroffer_pti_target_amount,
                cc.counteroffer_el_cap_amount
            )
        END AS counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount

    FROM counteroffer_components cc
    JOIN exposure_inputs ei
        ON ei.application_id = cc.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Counteroffer rounding.

Rounding convention:
    FLOOR(raw amount / rounding increment) * rounding increment

Reason:
    Rounding down ensures the preliminary approved exposure does not accidentally exceed product cap,
    PTI target, or approved Expected Loss cap.

If rounding down causes the amount to fall below the minimum viable amount, the counteroffer fails
feasibility rather than being silently increased above a constraint.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
counteroffer_rounding AS (
    SELECT
        crf.application_id,
        crf.counteroffer_product_cap_amount,
        crf.counteroffer_pti_target_amount,
        crf.counteroffer_el_cap_amount,
        crf.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount,
        crf.counteroffer_min_viable_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND crf.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount IS NOT NULL
             AND ei.approved_amount_rounding_increment > 0
                THEN FLOOR(
                    crf.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount
                    / ei.approved_amount_rounding_increment
                ) * ei.approved_amount_rounding_increment

            ELSE NULL
        END AS counteroffer_rounded_amount

    FROM counteroffer_raw_feasible crf
    JOIN exposure_inputs ei
        ON ei.application_id = crf.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Exposure amount assignment for evaluation.

This CTE creates candidate exposure amounts used to calculate preliminary affordability and
preliminary economics.

Final output fields are assigned later after counteroffer feasibility is evaluated.

Candidate conventions:
    APPROVE:
        requested amount

    DECLINE:
        zero exposure

    MANUAL_REVIEW:
        NULL because manual review is unresolved

    COUNTEROFFER:
        rounded counteroffer amount for feasibility testing
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
exposure_amount_assignment AS (
    SELECT
        ei.application_id,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation

    FROM exposure_inputs ei
    LEFT JOIN counteroffer_rounding cr
        ON cr.application_id = ei.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Approved affordability proxy calculation for evaluation.

The proportional payment formula is a strategy-simulation proxy:

    requested_monthly_payment_proxy
    * approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation
    / requested_amount

This is not a recalculated contractual payment schedule.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
approved_affordability AS (
    SELECT
        eaa.application_id,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_monthly_payment_proxy

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation IS NOT NULL
                THEN ei.requested_monthly_payment_proxy
                     * eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation
                     / NULLIF(ei.requested_amount, 0)

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_monthly_payment_proxy_candidate,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_payment_to_income_ratio

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation IS NOT NULL
                THEN (
                    ei.requested_monthly_payment_proxy
                    * eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation
                    / NULLIF(ei.requested_amount, 0)
                ) / NULLIF((ei.annual_income / 12.0), 0)

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate

    FROM exposure_amount_assignment eaa
    JOIN exposure_inputs ei
        ON ei.application_id = eaa.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Approved economics calculation for evaluation.

approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate:
    approved exposure candidate * synthetic estimated-PD proxy * LGD

estimated_pd remains the Module 1 SQL field and is interpreted as the synthetic estimated-PD proxy.
It is not recalculated in Module 2.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
approved_economics AS (
    SELECT
        eaa.application_id,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_expected_loss_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation IS NOT NULL
                THEN eaa.approved_amount_candidate_for_evaluation
                     * ei.estimated_pd
                     * ei.estimated_lgd

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate

    FROM exposure_amount_assignment eaa
    JOIN exposure_inputs ei
        ON ei.application_id = eaa.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Counteroffer feasibility base.

This CTE calculates:
    counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag
    counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag
    counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count

For non-counteroffer preliminary routes:
    evaluated flag = FALSE
    pass flag = NULL
    constraint count = NULL

The pass flag is deliberately strict. All configured constraints must be satisfied.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
counteroffer_feasibility_base AS (
    SELECT
        ei.application_id,

        (ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')
            AS counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN NULL::BOOLEAN

            WHEN ei.counteroffer_allowed_flag IS TRUE
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount > 0
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.requested_amount
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount >= ei.product_min_approved_amount
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount >= ei.requested_amount * ei.product_min_counteroffer_pct
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount >= ei.requested_amount * (1.0 - ei.product_max_exposure_reduction_pct)
             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount <= ei.product_max_approved_amount
             AND aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate IS NOT NULL
             AND aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate <= ei.counteroffer_target_pti
             AND ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate IS NOT NULL
             AND ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate <= ei.product_approved_el_cap
                THEN TRUE

            ELSE FALSE
        END AS counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN NULL::INTEGER

            ELSE
                (
                    CASE WHEN ei.counteroffer_allowed_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount >= ei.requested_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.product_min_approved_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.requested_amount * ei.product_min_counteroffer_pct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.requested_amount * (1.0 - ei.product_max_exposure_reduction_pct) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NOT NULL
                             AND cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount > ei.product_max_approved_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate IS NOT NULL
                             AND aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate > ei.counteroffer_target_pti THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    + CASE WHEN ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate IS NOT NULL
                             AND ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate > ei.product_approved_el_cap THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                )
        END AS counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count

    FROM exposure_inputs ei
    LEFT JOIN counteroffer_rounding cr
        ON cr.application_id = ei.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_affordability aa
        ON aa.application_id = ei.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_economics ae
        ON ae.application_id = ei.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Counteroffer feasibility failure reason.

This field is a feasibility diagnostic only.

It is not:
    primary_reason_code
    secondary_reason_code
    tertiary_reason_code
    regulatory adverse-action reason
    final policy reason

The priority order is deterministic so failed preliminary counteroffer routes are explainable.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
counteroffer_feasibility AS (
    SELECT
        cfb.application_id,
        cfb.counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag,
        cfb.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,
        cfb.counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN cfb.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN NULL

            WHEN ei.counteroffer_allowed_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_ALLOWED_BY_PRODUCT'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount IS NULL
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_RAW_AMOUNT_NULL'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount IS NULL
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_ROUNDED_AMOUNT_NULL'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount <= 0
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_ROUNDED_AMOUNT_NON_POSITIVE'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount >= ei.requested_amount
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_BELOW_REQUESTED_AMOUNT'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.product_min_approved_amount
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_BELOW_PRODUCT_MINIMUM'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.requested_amount * ei.product_min_counteroffer_pct
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_BELOW_MINIMUM_REQUESTED_PERCENT'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount < ei.requested_amount * (1.0 - ei.product_max_exposure_reduction_pct)
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_EXCEEDS_MAX_REDUCTION'

            WHEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount > ei.product_max_approved_amount
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_EXCEEDS_PRODUCT_CAP'

            WHEN aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate > ei.counteroffer_target_pti
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_PTI_STILL_ABOVE_TARGET'

            WHEN ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate > ei.product_approved_el_cap
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_APPROVED_EL_ABOVE_CAP'

            ELSE 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_UNKNOWN'
        END AS counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason

    FROM counteroffer_feasibility_base cfb
    JOIN exposure_inputs ei
        ON ei.application_id = cfb.application_id
    LEFT JOIN counteroffer_rounding cr
        ON cr.application_id = cfb.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_affordability aa
        ON aa.application_id = cfb.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_economics ae
        ON ae.application_id = cfb.application_id
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Final Section 8 exposure-treatment fields.

These are still preliminary fields.

Final decision_outcome and final reason codes are not created here.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
final_exposure_treatment AS (
    SELECT
        ei.*,

        /* Counteroffer calculation diagnostics */
        cr.counteroffer_product_cap_amount,
        cr.counteroffer_pti_target_amount,
        cr.counteroffer_el_cap_amount,
        cr.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount,
        cr.counteroffer_min_viable_amount,
        cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount,

        /* Counteroffer feasibility diagnostics */
        cf.counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag,
        cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,
        cf.counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason,
        cf.counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count,

        /* Exposure treatment status */
        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 'APPROVED_AS_REQUESTED_PRELIMINARY'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'NO_OFFER_PRELIMINARY_DECLINE'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'UNRESOLVED_MANUAL_REVIEW'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY'

            ELSE 'EXPOSURE_TREATMENT_UNKNOWN'
        END AS exposure_treatment_status,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 'APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'NO_OFFER'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW_UNRESOLVED'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE'

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE'

            ELSE 'EXPOSURE_TREATMENT_UNKNOWN'
        END AS exposure_treatment_path,


        /* Preliminary approved amount and counteroffer amount */
        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_amount_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount
            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS counteroffer_amount_preliminary,


        /* Preliminary exposure reduction fields */
        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN ei.requested_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN ei.requested_amount - cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 1.0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (ei.requested_amount - cr.counteroffer_rounded_amount)
                     / NULLIF(ei.requested_amount, 0)

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary,


        /* Preliminary approved payment and PTI */
        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_monthly_payment_proxy

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN aa.approved_monthly_payment_proxy_candidate

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_payment_to_income_ratio

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN aa.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_candidate

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary,


        /* Preliminary approved Expected Loss and EL reduction */
        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN ei.requested_expected_loss_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN ei.requested_expected_loss_amount

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN ei.requested_expected_loss_amount
                     - ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary,

        CASE
            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN ei.requested_expected_loss_amount > 0 THEN 1.0::NUMERIC
                    ELSE 0::NUMERIC
                END

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN ei.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND cf.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN (
                    ei.requested_expected_loss_amount
                    - ae.approved_expected_loss_amount_candidate
                ) / NULLIF(ei.requested_expected_loss_amount, 0)

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary

    FROM exposure_inputs ei
    LEFT JOIN counteroffer_rounding cr
        ON cr.application_id = ei.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_affordability aa
        ON aa.application_id = ei.application_id
    LEFT JOIN approved_economics ae
        ON ae.application_id = ei.application_id
    LEFT JOIN counteroffer_feasibility cf
        ON cf.application_id = ei.application_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final_exposure_treatment;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 8.3 — LOCAL FAIL-FAST CHECKS FOR EXPOSURE TREATMENT STAGE
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Validate the Section 8 exposure-treatment layer before final decision outcome, reason-code,
    latest-run output, or archive logic is built.

IMPORTANT:
    These are local staging gatekeepers only.

    They are not full Module 2 QA.
    They are not final decision validation.
    They are not reason-code validation.
    They are not archive validation.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    v_stage4_count BIGINT;
    v_stage5_count BIGINT;
    v_stage5_distinct_app_count BIGINT;

    v_duplicate_application_count BIGINT;
    v_required_field_failure_count BIGINT;

    v_approve_route_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_decline_route_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_manual_review_route_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_counteroffer_eval_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_counteroffer_pass_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_counteroffer_fail_failure_count BIGINT;

    v_forbidden_column_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: row count must be unchanged from Section 7 to Section 8.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage4_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_4_preliminary_decision_routing;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage5_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment;

    IF v_stage5_count <> v_stage4_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: row count changed from Section 7 to Section 8. Stage 4 rows: %, Stage 5 rows: %.',
            v_stage4_count,
            v_stage5_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: application_id remains unique.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
    INTO v_stage5_distinct_app_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment;

    IF v_stage5_distinct_app_count <> v_stage5_count THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO v_duplicate_application_count
        FROM (
            SELECT application_id
            FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
            GROUP BY application_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ) d;

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: application_id uniqueness was not preserved. Stage 5 rows: %, distinct application_id count: %, duplicate application_id group count: %.',
            v_stage5_count,
            v_stage5_distinct_app_count,
            v_duplicate_application_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: required exposure-treatment fields must be populated.

    Manual review and failed counteroffer rows may intentionally have NULL exposure economics, but
    route-status fields and feasibility evaluation indicators must still be complete.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_required_field_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE exposure_treatment_status IS NULL
       OR exposure_treatment_path IS NULL
       OR counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag IS NULL;

    IF v_required_field_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % row(s) have null required exposure-treatment status fields.',
            v_required_field_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: APPROVE preliminary route consistency.

    Preliminary APPROVE rows are approved as requested for exposure-treatment purposes, but final
    APPROVE is still not assigned in Section 8.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_approve_route_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
      AND (
            approved_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
         OR counteroffer_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_monthly_payment_proxy
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_payment_to_income_ratio
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_treatment_status <> 'APPROVED_AS_REQUESTED_PRELIMINARY'
         OR exposure_treatment_path <> 'APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED'
      );

    IF v_approve_route_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % preliminary APPROVE row(s) violate exposure-treatment conventions.',
            v_approve_route_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: DECLINE preliminary route consistency.

    Preliminary DECLINE rows use the locked zero-exposure convention, but final DECLINE is still
    not assigned in Section 8.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_decline_route_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
      AND (
            approved_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR counteroffer_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
         OR exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 1.0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
                WHEN requested_expected_loss_amount > 0 THEN 1.0::NUMERIC
                ELSE 0::NUMERIC
            END
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_treatment_status <> 'NO_OFFER_PRELIMINARY_DECLINE'
         OR exposure_treatment_path <> 'NO_OFFER'
      );

    IF v_decline_route_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % preliminary DECLINE row(s) violate zero-exposure conventions.',
            v_decline_route_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: MANUAL_REVIEW preliminary route consistency.

    Manual review remains unresolved by design. It should not receive preliminary approved exposure
    economics.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_manual_review_route_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
      AND (
            approved_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_treatment_status <> 'UNRESOLVED_MANUAL_REVIEW'
         OR exposure_treatment_path <> 'MANUAL_REVIEW_UNRESOLVED'
      );

    IF v_manual_review_route_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % preliminary MANUAL_REVIEW row(s) violate unresolved-review conventions.',
            v_manual_review_route_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: COUNTEROFFER preliminary route must be evaluated.

    A preliminary COUNTEROFFER route is not automatically feasible. Section 8 must explicitly
    evaluate feasibility and populate pass / fail.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_counteroffer_eval_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
      AND (
            counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS NULL
         OR exposure_treatment_status NOT IN (
                'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY',
                'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY'
            )
         OR exposure_treatment_path NOT IN (
                'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE',
                'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE'
            )
      );

    IF v_counteroffer_eval_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % preliminary COUNTEROFFER row(s) were not fully evaluated for feasibility.',
            v_counteroffer_eval_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: feasible preliminary counteroffer consistency.

    A feasible preliminary counteroffer must produce a positive approved amount below the requested
    amount and must satisfy product, reduction, approved PTI, and approved Expected Loss constraints.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_counteroffer_pass_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
      AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
      AND (
            approved_amount_preliminary IS NULL
         OR counteroffer_amount_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM approved_amount_preliminary
         OR approved_amount_preliminary <= 0
         OR approved_amount_preliminary >= requested_amount
         OR exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary <= 0
         OR exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary <= 0
         OR approved_amount_preliminary < product_min_approved_amount
         OR approved_amount_preliminary < requested_amount * product_min_counteroffer_pct
         OR approved_amount_preliminary < requested_amount * (1.0 - product_max_exposure_reduction_pct)
         OR approved_amount_preliminary > product_max_approved_amount
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary IS NULL
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary > counteroffer_target_pti
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary IS NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary > product_approved_el_cap
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary IS NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary IS NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary IS NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_treatment_status <> 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY'
         OR exposure_treatment_path <> 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE'
      );

    IF v_counteroffer_pass_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % feasible preliminary COUNTEROFFER row(s) violate approved-exposure feasibility conventions.',
            v_counteroffer_pass_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: infeasible preliminary counteroffer consistency.

    Failed preliminary counteroffers remain unresolved for final handling. They should not carry
    preliminary approved exposure economics.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_counteroffer_fail_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
      AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
      AND (
            approved_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason IS NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count IS NULL
         OR counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count < 1
         OR exposure_treatment_status <> 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_PRELIMINARY'
         OR exposure_treatment_path <> 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE'
      );

    IF v_counteroffer_fail_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: % infeasible preliminary COUNTEROFFER row(s) violate failed-feasibility conventions.',
            v_counteroffer_fail_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: forbidden final-output fields must not exist yet.

    Section 8 is not allowed to create final decisions, final flags, simulated offer exposure flags,
    final reason codes, latest-run output, or archive persistence.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_forbidden_column_count
    FROM pg_attribute
    WHERE attrelid = 'tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment'::REGCLASS
      AND attnum > 0
      AND NOT attisdropped
      AND attname IN (
            'decision_outcome',
            'decision_path',
            'approval_flag',
            'decline_flag',
            'manual_review_flag',
            'counteroffer_flag',
            'simulated_offer_exposure_flag',

            'primary_reason_code',
            'secondary_reason_code',
            'tertiary_reason_code',
            'triggered_reason_code_list',
            'reason_priority_rank',
            'primary_reason_family',

            'approved_amount',
            'counteroffer_amount',
            'approved_monthly_payment_proxy',
            'approved_payment_to_income_ratio',
            'approved_expected_loss_amount'
      );

    IF v_forbidden_column_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: forbidden final-output field(s) were created before final decision / reason-code sections.';
    END IF;

    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions') IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 8 failure: final latest-run strategy_decisions table exists before final output section.';
    END IF;
END $$;

GROUP BY

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 9.2 — CREATE FINAL DECISION RESOLUTION TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

TABLE:
    tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution

GRAIN:
    One row per application_id for the selected Module 1 scenario / population and active Module 2
    strategy.

INPUT:
    tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment

OUTPUT:
    All Section 8 fields plus:
        decision_outcome
        decision_path
        decision_priority_rank
        decision_resolution_source
        approval_flag
        counteroffer_flag
        manual_review_flag
        decline_flag
        simulated_offer_exposure_flag
        approved_amount
        counteroffer_amount
        exposure_reduction_flag
        exposure_reduction_amount
        exposure_reduction_pct
        approved_monthly_payment_proxy
        approved_payment_to_income_ratio
        approved_expected_loss_amount
        approved_el_reduction_amount
        approved_el_reduction_pct

IMPORTANT:
    This table does not contain simulated reason-code fields.
    Reason-code assignment is intentionally deferred to Section 10.

***************************************************************************************************/

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
AS
WITH active_params AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_module2_strategy_params
    WHERE active_strategy_flag IS TRUE
    LIMIT 1
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Attach final decision-resolution parameter.

failed_counteroffer_resolution is attached here so final decision logic does not rely on a hidden
hardcoded treatment for infeasible preliminary COUNTEROFFER routes.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
decision_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.failed_counteroffer_resolution
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment e
    CROSS JOIN active_params p
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Final decision assignment.

This CTE creates final decision fields only.

Reason-code fields are not created here.
Final latest-run output is not created here.
Archive persistence is not created here.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
decision_assignment AS (
    SELECT
        di.*,

        /*
        decision_outcome:
            Final simulated strategy outcome.

        Allowed values:
            APPROVE
            COUNTEROFFER
            MANUAL_REVIEW
            DECLINE

        This field is final within Module 2 decision-resolution logic, but it remains a simulated
        strategy outcome on synthetic applicants.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'DECLINE'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 'APPROVE'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'DECLINE'

            ELSE 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
        END AS decision_outcome,


        /*
        decision_path:
            Final route label for the simulated strategy outcome.

        Naming discipline:
            APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED is used as the decision path for final approvals.

            APPROVED_AS_REQUESTED remains reserved for the later simulated reason-code layer,
            where it can be used as the approval primary_reason_code.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN di.preliminary_decision_path

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN di.preliminary_decision_path

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 'APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_REVIEW'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_DECLINE'

            ELSE 'FINAL_RESIDUAL_STRATEGY_REVIEW'
        END AS decision_path,


        /*
        decision_priority_rank:
            Carries the preliminary routing rank where a normal route is resolved.
            Uses 99 only for the residual final fallback.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome IN ('DECLINE', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'APPROVE')
                THEN di.preliminary_decision_priority_rank

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS NOT NULL
                THEN di.preliminary_decision_priority_rank

            ELSE 99
        END AS decision_priority_rank,


        /*
        decision_resolution_source:
            Explains how the preliminary route and exposure-treatment feasibility resolved into
            the final simulated strategy outcome.

        This is not a reason code.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'PRELIMINARY_DECLINE_CONFIRMED'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'PRELIMINARY_MANUAL_REVIEW_CONFIRMED'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 'PRELIMINARY_APPROVE_CONFIRMED'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS TRUE
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_CONFIRMED'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_FAILED_TO_REVIEW'

            WHEN di.preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
             AND di.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
             AND di.failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_FAILED_TO_DECLINE'

            ELSE 'FINAL_RESIDUAL_FALLBACK'
        END AS decision_resolution_source

    FROM decision_inputs di
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Final exposure economics assignment.

These final fields are derived from final decision_outcome and the Section 8 preliminary exposure
treatment fields.

No reason-code fields are created here.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
final_exposure_assignment AS (
    SELECT
        da.*,

        /*
        approved_amount:
            Final simulated approved exposure.

        APPROVE:
            requested_amount

        COUNTEROFFER:
            feasible reduced exposure from Section 8

        MANUAL_REVIEW:
            NULL, unresolved by design

        DECLINE:
            0, no simulated offer exposure
        */
        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN da.requested_amount

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.approved_amount_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.approved_amount_preliminary
            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS counteroffer_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS exposure_reduction_flag,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.requested_amount - da.approved_amount_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN da.requested_amount

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS exposure_reduction_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN (da.requested_amount - da.approved_amount_preliminary)
                     / NULLIF(da.requested_amount, 0)

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 1.0::NUMERIC

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS exposure_reduction_pct,


        /*
        Final approved affordability fields.

        approved_monthly_payment_proxy:
            Simulated proportional payment proxy after final exposure treatment.

        approved_payment_to_income_ratio:
            Simulated post-exposure-treatment affordability ratio.

        These are not contractual payment schedules.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN da.requested_monthly_payment_proxy

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_monthly_payment_proxy,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN da.requested_payment_to_income_ratio

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_payment_to_income_ratio,


        /*
        Final approved Expected Loss fields.

        requested_expected_loss_amount:
            Module 1 requested-exposure Expected Loss.

        approved_expected_loss_amount:
            Module 2 final approved-exposure Expected Loss.

        estimated_pd remains the Module 1 synthetic estimated-PD proxy input.
        */
        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN da.requested_expected_loss_amount

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_expected_loss_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN da.requested_expected_loss_amount - da.approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN da.requested_expected_loss_amount

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_el_reduction_amount,

        CASE
            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                THEN 0::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                THEN (
                    da.requested_expected_loss_amount - da.approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary
                ) / NULLIF(da.requested_expected_loss_amount, 0)

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                THEN NULL::NUMERIC

            WHEN da.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN da.requested_expected_loss_amount > 0 THEN 1.0::NUMERIC
                    ELSE 0::NUMERIC
                END

            ELSE NULL::NUMERIC
        END AS approved_el_reduction_pct

    FROM decision_assignment da
),

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Final outcome flags.

These flags reconcile directly to final decision_outcome.

simulated_offer_exposure_flag:
    TRUE for APPROVE and COUNTEROFFER.
    FALSE for MANUAL_REVIEW and DECLINE.

This is a simulated strategy exposure flag only.
It does not imply operational account creation or real customer treatment.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
final_flags AS (
    SELECT
        fea.*,

        (fea.decision_outcome = 'APPROVE') AS approval_flag,
        (fea.decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER') AS counteroffer_flag,
        (fea.decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW') AS manual_review_flag,
        (fea.decision_outcome = 'DECLINE') AS decline_flag,

        (fea.decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER'))
            AS simulated_offer_exposure_flag

    FROM final_exposure_assignment fea
)

SELECT *
FROM final_flags;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 9.3 — LOCAL FAIL-FAST CHECKS FOR FINAL DECISION RESOLUTION
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Validate the Section 9 final decision-resolution layer before simulated reason-code assignment,
    latest-run output creation, or archive persistence is built.

IMPORTANT:
    These are local staging gatekeepers only.

    They are not the full Module 2 QA framework.
    They are not reason-code validation.
    They are not archive validation.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    v_stage5_count BIGINT;
    v_stage6_count BIGINT;
    v_stage6_distinct_app_count BIGINT;

    v_duplicate_application_count BIGINT;
    v_final_decision_completeness_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_final_flag_reconciliation_failure_count BIGINT;

    v_approve_convention_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_counteroffer_convention_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_manual_review_convention_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_decline_convention_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_failed_counteroffer_resolution_failure_count BIGINT;

    v_forbidden_reason_column_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: row count must be unchanged from Section 8 to Section 9.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage5_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_5_exposure_treatment;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage6_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution;

    IF v_stage6_count <> v_stage5_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: row count changed from Section 8 to Section 9. Stage 5 rows: %, Stage 6 rows: %.',
            v_stage5_count,
            v_stage6_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: application_id remains unique.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
    INTO v_stage6_distinct_app_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution;

    IF v_stage6_distinct_app_count <> v_stage6_count THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO v_duplicate_application_count
        FROM (
            SELECT application_id
            FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
            GROUP BY application_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ) d;

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: application_id uniqueness was not preserved. Stage 6 rows: %, distinct application_id count: %, duplicate application_id group count: %.',
            v_stage6_count,
            v_stage6_distinct_app_count,
            v_duplicate_application_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final decision fields must be complete and valid.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_final_decision_completeness_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE decision_outcome IS NULL
       OR decision_outcome NOT IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
       OR decision_path IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_path), '') IS NULL
       OR decision_priority_rank IS NULL
       OR decision_priority_rank <= 0
       OR decision_resolution_source IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_resolution_source), '') IS NULL
       OR failed_counteroffer_resolution IS NULL
       OR failed_counteroffer_resolution NOT IN ('MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE');

    IF v_final_decision_completeness_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % row(s) have null or invalid final decision-resolution fields.',
            v_final_decision_completeness_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final flags must reconcile to decision_outcome.

    Exactly one final outcome flag must be TRUE per row.
    simulated_offer_exposure_flag must be TRUE only for APPROVE and COUNTEROFFER.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_final_flag_reconciliation_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE (
            COALESCE(approval_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(counteroffer_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(manual_review_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(decline_flag::INT, 0)
          ) <> 1
       OR approval_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')
       OR counteroffer_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')
       OR manual_review_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')
       OR decline_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')
       OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER'));

    IF v_final_flag_reconciliation_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % row(s) have final flag reconciliation failures.',
            v_final_flag_reconciliation_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final APPROVE convention.

    APPROVE is a simulated approval-as-requested strategy outcome.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_approve_convention_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
      AND (
            approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
         OR counteroffer_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR exposure_reduction_pct IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM requested_monthly_payment_proxy
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM requested_payment_to_income_ratio
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR decision_path <> 'APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED'
      );

    IF v_approve_convention_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % final APPROVE row(s) violate approval-as-requested conventions.',
            v_approve_convention_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final COUNTEROFFER convention.

    COUNTEROFFER requires a feasible Section 8 reduced-exposure treatment.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_counteroffer_convention_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
      AND (
            counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR approved_amount IS NULL
         OR approved_amount <= 0
         OR approved_amount >= requested_amount
         OR counteroffer_amount IS DISTINCT FROM approved_amount
         OR exposure_reduction_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount IS DISTINCT FROM (requested_amount - approved_amount)
         OR exposure_reduction_pct IS DISTINCT FROM (
                exposure_reduction_amount / NULLIF(requested_amount, 0)
            )
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS NULL
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount > product_approved_el_cap
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio > counteroffer_target_pti
         OR approved_amount < product_min_approved_amount
         OR approved_amount > product_max_approved_amount
         OR approved_amount < requested_amount * product_min_counteroffer_pct
         OR approved_amount < requested_amount * (1.0 - product_max_exposure_reduction_pct)
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount IS NULL
         OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
         OR decision_path <> 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBLE'
      );

    IF v_counteroffer_convention_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % final COUNTEROFFER row(s) violate feasible counteroffer conventions.',
            v_counteroffer_convention_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final MANUAL_REVIEW convention.

    Manual review remains unresolved by design.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_manual_review_convention_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
      AND (
            approved_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR counteroffer_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_pct IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct IS NOT NULL
         OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
      );

    IF v_manual_review_convention_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % final MANUAL_REVIEW row(s) violate unresolved-review conventions.',
            v_manual_review_convention_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final DECLINE convention.

    DECLINE uses the locked zero-exposure convention.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_decline_convention_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
      AND (
            approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR counteroffer_amount IS NOT NULL
         OR exposure_reduction_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
         OR exposure_reduction_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
         OR exposure_reduction_pct IS DISTINCT FROM 1.0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
         OR approved_el_reduction_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
         OR approved_el_reduction_pct IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
                WHEN requested_expected_loss_amount > 0 THEN 1.0::NUMERIC
                ELSE 0::NUMERIC
            END
         OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS DISTINCT FROM FALSE
      );

    IF v_decline_convention_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % final DECLINE row(s) violate zero-exposure conventions.',
            v_decline_convention_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: failed counteroffer resolution.

    Infeasible preliminary COUNTEROFFER rows must resolve according to failed_counteroffer_resolution.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_failed_counteroffer_resolution_failure_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution
    WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
      AND counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag IS FALSE
      AND (
            (
                failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                AND NOT (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                    AND decision_path = 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_REVIEW'
                    AND decision_resolution_source = 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_FAILED_TO_REVIEW'
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                failed_counteroffer_resolution = 'DECLINE'
                AND NOT (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                    AND decision_path = 'COUNTEROFFER_NOT_FEASIBLE_DECLINE'
                    AND decision_resolution_source = 'COUNTEROFFER_FEASIBILITY_FAILED_TO_DECLINE'
                )
            )
      );

    IF v_failed_counteroffer_resolution_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: % failed preliminary COUNTEROFFER row(s) do not resolve according to failed_counteroffer_resolution.',
            v_failed_counteroffer_resolution_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: reason-code fields must not exist yet.

    Reason-code assignment belongs to the next section.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_forbidden_reason_column_count
    FROM pg_attribute
    WHERE attrelid = 'tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution'::REGCLASS
      AND attnum > 0
      AND NOT attisdropped
      AND attname IN (
            'primary_reason_code',
            'secondary_reason_code',
            'tertiary_reason_code',
            'triggered_reason_code_list',
            'reason_priority_rank',
            'primary_reason_family'
      );

    IF v_forbidden_reason_column_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: reason-code field(s) were created before the reason-code assignment section.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final latest-run output table must not exist yet.

    Section 9 creates a temporary final decision-resolution staging table only.
    The permanent latest-run strategy output is created in a later section.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions') IS NOT NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 9 failure: final latest-run strategy_decisions table exists before the final output section.';
    END IF;

    /*
    Archive note:
        Section 9 contains no INSERT, DELETE, TRUNCATE, or CREATE logic for
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive.

        Archive persistence remains deferred to a later section.
    */
END $$;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 9.4 — LOCAL STAGING SANITY CHECKS
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Provide lightweight diagnostics for the Section 9 final decision-resolution staging layer.

IMPORTANT:
    These are not full Module 2 QA outputs.
    These should not be treated as the final Validation Summary evidence set.

/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 10 — SIMULATED REASON-CODE ASSIGNMENT LAYER
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Assign deterministic simulated strategy explanation codes after final decision resolution.

    Section 10 answers:

        "Why did this synthetic applicant receive this simulated strategy outcome?"

    Section 10 does NOT answer:

        "What should be communicated to a real customer?"
        "What is the regulatory explanation for a real decision?"
        "What is the compliance-approved reason for an operational credit action?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Read from tmp_m2_stage_6_final_decision_resolution.
    2. Preserve all prior source, lineage, strategy metadata, thresholds, segmentation, rule flags,
       preliminary routing diagnostics, exposure-treatment diagnostics, and final decision fields.
    3. Create one candidate simulated reason-code row per applicable rule / route / treatment driver.
    4. Filter reason-code candidates by final decision_outcome family.
    5. Rank candidate reasons deterministically using governed priority ranges.
    6. Pivot ranked candidates into:
            primary_reason_code
            secondary_reason_code
            tertiary_reason_code
            primary_reason_family
            triggered_reason_code_list
            reason_priority_rank
            reason_code_count
    7. Validate reason-code completeness, outcome-family alignment, and staging integrity.
    8. Confirm that latest-run output creation and archive persistence remain deferred.

WHY REASON-CODE ASSIGNMENT IS SEPARATED FROM FINAL DECISION RESOLUTION:
    Section 9 creates final simulated strategy outcomes and final exposure economics.
    Section 10 explains those outcomes.

    Keeping explanation logic separate allows the reason-code layer to use:
        final decision_outcome
        final decision_path
        decision_resolution_source
        Section 6 trigger flags
        Section 7 preliminary routing diagnostics
        Section 8 counteroffer feasibility diagnostics
        final exposure-treatment fields
        mixed-signal diagnostics
        borderline diagnostics

    This makes reason-code assignment transparent and extensible.

REASON-CODE BOUNDARY:
    The fields created in Section 10 are simulated strategy explanation codes.

    They are used for:
        strategy transparency
        QA review
        decision-path traceability
        segmentation diagnostics
        portfolio interpretation

    They are not:
        production customer communications
        compliance-approved customer notices
        real-world underwriting explanations
        fair lending conclusions
        customer-level treatment logic

OUTCOME-SPECIFIC FILTERING:
    Candidate reasons are filtered by final decision_outcome family so that:

        APPROVE rows receive APPROVAL reasons.
        COUNTEROFFER rows receive COUNTEROFFER reasons.
        MANUAL_REVIEW rows receive MANUAL_REVIEW reasons.
        DECLINE rows receive POLICY_STOP reasons.

    This prevents reason-family leakage and ensures the primary reason aligns with the final simulated
    strategy outcome.

IMPLEMENTATION PATTERN:
    Section 10 intentionally avoids one large opaque CASE block.

    Instead, it uses:
        reason_candidate_base
        reason_candidates_raw
        reason_candidates
        ranked_reasons
        reason_pivot
        final_reason_assignment

    This pattern is more auditable because every candidate reason has:
        a code,
        a family,
        a priority rank,
        and a source explanation.

REASON PRIORITY RANGES:
    DECLINE / POLICY_STOP reasons:
        100–199

    MANUAL_REVIEW reasons:
        300–399

    COUNTEROFFER reasons:
        500–599

    APPROVAL reasons:
        900–999

    Lower numeric rank means higher priority.

TRIGGERED REASON LIST:
    triggered_reason_code_list contains all applicable candidate reason codes after filtering to the
    final decision_outcome family.

    The list is deterministic:

        STRING_AGG(candidate_reason_code, ' | '
                   ORDER BY candidate_reason_priority_rank, candidate_reason_code)

SECONDARY AND TERTIARY REASONS:
    secondary_reason_code and tertiary_reason_code are additional diagnostics only.
    They do not change decision_outcome.
    They do not change decision_path.
    They do not change approved exposure.

LATEST-RUN / ARCHIVE BOUNDARY:
    Section 10 creates only a temporary reason-code staging table.

    It does not create:
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions

    It does not insert rows into:
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

***************************************************************************************************/

SECTION 10.1 — CLEAN RESET OF SECTION 10 STAGING OBJECT
****************************************************************************************************/
