```sql
/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 14.17 — FINAL OUTPUT CONVENTION VALIDATION
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Confirm final output conventions hold in the latest-run table.

BUSINESS INTERPRETATION:
    This query produces diagnostic failure counts suitable for validation evidence.

EXPECTED RESULT:
    All violation counts should be zero.

WHY THIS SECTION IS READ-ONLY:
    The latest-run table was materialized in Section 11.
    Section 14 validates the output but does not repair, overwrite, or recalculate it.

***************************************************************************************************/

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (
            COALESCE(approval_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(counteroffer_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(manual_review_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(decline_flag::INT, 0)
        ) <> 1
    ) AS final_outcome_flag_count_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag
              IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER'))
    ) AS simulated_offer_exposure_flag_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
          AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
    ) AS approve_amount_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
          AND (
                approved_amount IS NULL
             OR approved_amount <= 0
             OR approved_amount >= requested_amount
             OR counteroffer_amount IS DISTINCT FROM approved_amount
          )
    ) AS counteroffer_amount_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
          AND approved_amount IS NOT NULL
    ) AS manual_review_amount_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
          AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
    ) AS decline_amount_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
          AND approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM requested_monthly_payment_proxy
    ) AS approve_payment_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
          AND (
                approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS NULL
             OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS NULL
             OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio > counteroffer_target_pti
          )
    ) AS counteroffer_affordability_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
          AND (
                approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS NOT NULL
             OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS NOT NULL
          )
    ) AS manual_review_affordability_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
          AND (
                approved_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
             OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
          )
    ) AS decline_affordability_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
          AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
    ) AS approve_expected_loss_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
          AND (
                approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
             OR approved_expected_loss_amount < 0
             OR approved_expected_loss_amount > requested_expected_loss_amount
             OR approved_expected_loss_amount > product_approved_el_cap
          )
    ) AS counteroffer_expected_loss_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
          AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
    ) AS manual_review_expected_loss_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
          AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
    ) AS decline_expected_loss_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE primary_reason_code IS NULL
           OR primary_reason_family IS NULL
           OR triggered_reason_code_list IS NULL
           OR reason_code_count IS NULL
           OR reason_code_count < 1
    ) AS reason_code_completeness_violation_rows,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE (
                decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'APPROVAL'
        )
        OR (
                decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
        )
        OR (
                decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
        )
        OR (
                decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'POLICY_STOP'
        )
    ) AS reason_family_alignment_violation_rows
FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 14.18 — ARCHIVE AND COMPARISON READINESS RECAP
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Summarize whether the latest run is archived and whether Section 13 matched comparison is
    available.

BUSINESS INTERPRETATION:
    This recap helps users decide whether the current latest-run output is ready for archived strategy
    comparison.

    It does not replace Section 13. It gives Section 14 users a latest-run readiness snapshot.

ARCHIVE BOUNDARY:
    This query does not insert archive rows.
    This query does not delete archive rows.
    This query does not update archive rows.

TIMESTAMP BOUNDARY:
    latest_output_created_ts and archive_inserted_ts are audit metadata.
    They are not deterministic strategy-comparison keys.

***************************************************************************************************/

WITH latest_context AS (
    SELECT
        archive_run_flag,
        strategy_archive_reset_mode,

        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version,

        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id,

        COUNT(*) AS latest_run_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS latest_run_distinct_application_id_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    GROUP BY
        archive_run_flag,
        strategy_archive_reset_mode,
        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version,
        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id
),

current_archived_slice AS (
    SELECT
        lc.strategy_set_name,
        lc.strategy_name,
        lc.strategy_version,
        lc.module1_scenario_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_name,
        lc.population_id,

        COUNT(ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
        MIN(ar.archive_inserted_ts) AS min_archive_inserted_ts,
        MAX(ar.archive_inserted_ts) AS max_archive_inserted_ts
    FROM latest_context lc
    LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        ON ar.strategy_set_name = lc.strategy_set_name
       AND ar.strategy_name = lc.strategy_name
       AND ar.strategy_version = lc.strategy_version
       AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = lc.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND ar.module1_scenario_name = lc.module1_scenario_name
       AND ar.population_id = lc.population_id
    GROUP BY
        lc.strategy_set_name,
        lc.strategy_name,
        lc.strategy_version,
        lc.module1_scenario_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_name,
        lc.population_id
),

comparison_inventory AS (
    SELECT
        lc.strategy_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_name,
        lc.population_id,

        COUNT(DISTINCT (
            ar.strategy_set_name,
            ar.strategy_name,
            ar.strategy_version
        )) AS archived_strategy_slice_count_for_same_set_scenario_population
    FROM latest_context lc
    LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        ON ar.strategy_set_name = lc.strategy_set_name
       AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = lc.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND ar.module1_scenario_name = lc.module1_scenario_name
       AND ar.population_id = lc.population_id
    GROUP BY
        lc.strategy_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_set_name,
        lc.module1_scenario_name,
        lc.population_id
)

SELECT
    lc.archive_run_flag,
    lc.strategy_archive_reset_mode,

    lc.strategy_set_name,
    lc.strategy_name,
    lc.strategy_version,

    lc.module1_scenario_set_name,
    lc.module1_scenario_name,
    lc.population_id,

    lc.latest_run_row_count,
    lc.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,

    cas.current_archived_slice_row_count,
    cas.current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
    cas.min_archive_inserted_ts,
    cas.max_archive_inserted_ts,

    ci.archived_strategy_slice_count_for_same_set_scenario_population,

    (
        ci.archived_strategy_slice_count_for_same_set_scenario_population >= 2
    ) AS at_least_two_strategy_slices_available_for_matched_comparison,

    CASE
        WHEN lc.archive_run_flag IS FALSE
            THEN 'LATEST_RUN_NOT_MARKED_FOR_ARCHIVE'

        WHEN cas.current_archived_slice_row_count = lc.latest_run_row_count
         AND cas.current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count = lc.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count
         AND ci.archived_strategy_slice_count_for_same_set_scenario_population >= 2
            THEN 'ARCHIVED_AND_COMPARISON_CANDIDATES_AVAILABLE'

        WHEN cas.current_archived_slice_row_count = lc.latest_run_row_count
         AND cas.current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count = lc.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count
            THEN 'ARCHIVED_CURRENT_SLICE_ONLY'

        ELSE 'ARCHIVE_READINESS_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
    END AS archive_and_comparison_readiness_status
FROM latest_context lc
LEFT JOIN current_archived_slice cas
    ON cas.strategy_set_name = lc.strategy_set_name
   AND cas.strategy_name = lc.strategy_name
   AND cas.strategy_version = lc.strategy_version
   AND cas.module1_scenario_set_name = lc.module1_scenario_set_name
   AND cas.module1_scenario_name = lc.module1_scenario_name
   AND cas.population_id = lc.population_id
LEFT JOIN comparison_inventory ci
    ON ci.strategy_set_name = lc.strategy_set_name
   AND ci.module1_scenario_set_name = lc.module1_scenario_set_name
   AND ci.module1_scenario_name = lc.module1_scenario_name
   AND ci.population_id = lc.population_id;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 14.19 — VALIDATION STATUS SUMMARY TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Create a compact temporary validation status summary for the completed latest-run Module 2 output.

TABLE:
    tmp_m2_validation_status_summary

FIELDS:
    validation_area
    validation_test_name
    validation_category
    validation_status
    observed_value
    expected_behavior
    interpretation

STATUS VALUES:
    PASS:
        Structural or diagnostic expectations are satisfied.

    REVIEW:
        Diagnostic patterns may be acceptable but should be interpreted.

        Examples include:
            high manual-review rate,
            high counteroffer concentration,
            high reason-code concentration,
            unusual product-level decision skew,
            source-field mismatch review required,
            unusual but explainable mixed-signal concentration.

    NOT_APPLICABLE:
        Test depends on unavailable archive slices, unavailable comparison parameters, insufficient
        segment density, or non-ready matched comparison setup.

NO FAIL STATUS:
    Critical structural failures are handled by fail-fast gatekeepers in prior sections.

DIAGNOSTIC REVIEW THRESHOLD NOTE:
    Concentration thresholds in this section are QA review prompts, not policy thresholds.

    They are used to highlight potential strategy concentration patterns that may be perfectly
    explainable after review. They should not be interpreted as empirical validation cutoffs,
    operational risk appetite, or decisioning thresholds.

READ-ONLY / TEMPORARY BOUNDARY:
    This temporary summary table does not modify:
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions,
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive,
        tmp_module2_strategy_params,
        tmp_module2_product_policy_params.

***************************************************************************************************/

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_m2_validation_status_summary;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_validation_status_summary
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
AS
WITH latest_structural AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS distinct_application_id_count,
        COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS duplicate_application_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (strategy_set_name, strategy_name, strategy_version)) AS strategy_version_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT (module1_scenario_set_name, module1_scenario_name, population_id))
            AS module1_scenario_population_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

decision_conventions AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome IS NULL
               OR decision_outcome NOT IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
        ) AS invalid_decision_outcome_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                COALESCE(approval_flag::INT, 0)
                + COALESCE(counteroffer_flag::INT, 0)
                + COALESCE(manual_review_flag::INT, 0)
                + COALESCE(decline_flag::INT, 0)
            ) <> 1
        ) AS final_flag_count_violation_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag
                  IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER'))
        ) AS simulated_offer_exposure_flag_violation_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                    decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                AND (
                        approved_amount IS NULL
                     OR approved_amount <= 0
                     OR approved_amount >= requested_amount
                    )
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                AND approved_amount IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
            )
        ) AS approved_amount_convention_violation_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                    decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                AND (
                        approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
                     OR approved_expected_loss_amount < 0
                     OR approved_expected_loss_amount > requested_expected_loss_amount
                     OR approved_expected_loss_amount > product_approved_el_cap
                    )
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
            )
        ) AS approved_el_convention_violation_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

decision_distribution_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decline_rate
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

reason_conventions AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE primary_reason_code IS NULL
               OR primary_reason_family IS NULL
               OR reason_code_count IS NULL
               OR reason_code_count < 1
               OR triggered_reason_code_list IS NULL
        ) AS reason_code_completeness_violation_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE (
                    decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
                AND primary_reason_family <> 'APPROVAL'
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
                AND primary_reason_family <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
                AND primary_reason_family <> 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            )
            OR (
                    decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
                AND primary_reason_family <> 'POLICY_STOP'
            )
        ) AS reason_family_alignment_violation_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '')) LIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%REGULATORY%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%REGULATORY%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%REGULATORY%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '')) LIKE '%REGULATORY%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '')) LIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '')) LIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
               OR UPPER(COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '')) LIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
        ) AS prohibited_terminology_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

reason_code_concentration AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(primary_reason_code_share) AS max_primary_reason_code_share
    FROM (
        SELECT
            primary_reason_code,
            COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS primary_reason_code_share
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        GROUP BY primary_reason_code
    ) x
),

product_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT product_type_policy_key) AS product_count,
        MAX(product_decision_share) AS max_product_decision_share
    FROM (
        SELECT
            product_type_policy_key,
            decision_outcome,
            COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY product_type_policy_key), 0)
                AS product_decision_share
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        GROUP BY
            product_type_policy_key,
            decision_outcome
    ) x
),

score_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT score_band_policy_key) AS score_band_count,
        MAX(score_decision_share) AS max_score_decision_share
    FROM (
        SELECT
            score_band_policy_key,
            decision_outcome,
            COUNT(*)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY score_band_policy_key), 0)
                AS score_decision_share
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        GROUP BY
            score_band_policy_key,
            decision_outcome
    ) x
),

risk_ordering AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(estimated_pd) FILTER (WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows,

        AVG(estimated_pd) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_decline_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE) AS offer_rows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE') AS decline_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

affordability_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('HIGH_REQUESTED_PTI', 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_PTI')
        ) AS high_requested_pti_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('LOW_REQUESTED_PTI', 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_PTI')
        ) AS low_requested_pti_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('HIGH_REQUESTED_PTI', 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_PTI')
              AND decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
        )::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('HIGH_REQUESTED_PTI', 'SEVERE_REQUESTED_PTI')
            ),
            0
        ) AS high_requested_pti_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('LOW_REQUESTED_PTI', 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_PTI')
              AND decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
        )::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(
            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE requested_pti_bucket IN ('LOW_REQUESTED_PTI', 'MODERATE_REQUESTED_PTI')
            ),
            0
        ) AS low_requested_pti_approval_rate
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

counteroffer_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE preliminary_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER') AS preliminary_counteroffer_rows,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER') AS final_counteroffer_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
              AND (
                    approved_amount IS NULL
                 OR approved_amount <= 0
                 OR approved_amount >= requested_amount
                 OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio > counteroffer_target_pti
                 OR approved_expected_loss_amount > product_approved_el_cap
                 OR primary_reason_family <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
              )
        ) AS final_counteroffer_convention_violation_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

manual_review_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW') AS manual_review_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
              AND (
                    approved_amount IS NOT NULL
                 OR approved_payment_to_income_ratio IS NOT NULL
                 OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
              )
        ) AS manual_review_unresolved_convention_violation_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

decline_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE') AS decline_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
              AND (
                    approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
                 OR approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
                 OR primary_reason_family <> 'POLICY_STOP'
              )
        ) AS decline_zero_exposure_or_reason_convention_violation_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

mixed_signal_diag AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mixed_signal_profile_type <> 'NO_MIXED_SIGNAL_PROFILE')
            AS mixed_signal_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE borderline_profile_flag IS TRUE)
            AS borderline_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE decision_path IN (
                'RESIDUAL_STRATEGY_REVIEW',
                'FINAL_RESIDUAL_STRATEGY_REVIEW'
            )
        ) AS residual_review_rows,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE mixed_signal_profile_type <> 'NO_MIXED_SIGNAL_PROFILE'
              AND decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
        ) AS mixed_signal_manual_review_rows
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
),

archive_diag AS (
    SELECT
        lc.archive_run_flag,
        lc.strategy_archive_reset_mode,
        lc.latest_run_row_count,
        COUNT(ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            archive_run_flag,
            strategy_archive_reset_mode,
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id,
            COUNT(*) AS latest_run_row_count
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
        GROUP BY
            archive_run_flag,
            strategy_archive_reset_mode,
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id
    ) lc
    LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        ON ar.strategy_set_name = lc.strategy_set_name
       AND ar.strategy_name = lc.strategy_name
       AND ar.strategy_version = lc.strategy_version
       AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = lc.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND ar.module1_scenario_name = lc.module1_scenario_name
       AND ar.population_id = lc.population_id
    GROUP BY
        lc.archive_run_flag,
        lc.strategy_archive_reset_mode,
        lc.latest_run_row_count
),

comparison_params AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params
    LIMIT 1
),

comparison_readiness AS (
    WITH p AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM comparison_params
    ),
    baseline_slice AS (
        SELECT ar.*
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        JOIN p
            ON ar.strategy_set_name = p.baseline_strategy_set_name
           AND ar.strategy_name = p.baseline_strategy_name
           AND ar.strategy_version = p.baseline_strategy_version
           AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND ar.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
           AND ar.population_id = p.population_id
    ),
    challenger_slice AS (
        SELECT ar.*
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        JOIN p
            ON ar.strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
           AND ar.strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
           AND ar.strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
           AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND ar.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
           AND ar.population_id = p.population_id
    ),
    baseline_counts AS (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS baseline_archived_row_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS baseline_distinct_application_id_count,
            COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS baseline_duplicate_application_row_count
        FROM baseline_slice
    ),
    challenger_counts AS (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) AS challenger_archived_row_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS challenger_distinct_application_id_count,
            COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS challenger_duplicate_application_row_count
        FROM challenger_slice
    ),
    baseline_apps AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT application_id FROM baseline_slice
    ),
    challenger_apps AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT application_id FROM challenger_slice
    ),
    application_match AS (
        SELECT
            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE b.application_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND c.application_id IS NOT NULL
            ) AS matched_application_id_count,

            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE b.application_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND c.application_id IS NULL
            ) AS baseline_only_application_id_count,

            COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE b.application_id IS NULL
                  AND c.application_id IS NOT NULL
            ) AS challenger_only_application_id_count
        FROM baseline_apps b
        FULL OUTER JOIN challenger_apps c
            ON c.application_id = b.application_id
    )
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p)
                THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE_COMPARISON_PARAMETERS_MISSING'

            WHEN p.baseline_strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
             AND p.baseline_strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
             AND p.baseline_strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
                THEN 'NOT_READY_SAME_STRATEGY_SELECTED'

            WHEN bc.baseline_archived_row_count = 0
                THEN 'NOT_READY_BASELINE_MISSING'

            WHEN cc.challenger_archived_row_count = 0
                THEN 'NOT_READY_CHALLENGER_MISSING'

            WHEN bc.baseline_duplicate_application_row_count > 0
              OR cc.challenger_duplicate_application_row_count > 0
                THEN 'NOT_READY_DUPLICATE_ARCHIVE_GRAIN'

            WHEN bc.baseline_archived_row_count <> cc.challenger_archived_row_count
                THEN 'NOT_READY_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH'

            WHEN am.baseline_only_application_id_count > 0
              OR am.challenger_only_application_id_count > 0
              OR am.matched_application_id_count <> bc.baseline_distinct_application_id_count
                THEN 'NOT_READY_UNMATCHED_APPLICATIONS'

            ELSE 'READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'
        END AS readiness_status
    FROM p
    CROSS JOIN baseline_counts bc
    CROSS JOIN challenger_counts cc
    CROSS JOIN application_match am
),

matched_source_consistency AS (
    WITH p AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM comparison_params
    ),
    r AS (
        SELECT *
        FROM comparison_readiness
    ),
    baseline_slice AS (
        SELECT ar.*
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        JOIN p
            ON ar.strategy_set_name = p.baseline_strategy_set_name
           AND ar.strategy_name = p.baseline_strategy_name
           AND ar.strategy_version = p.baseline_strategy_version
           AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND ar.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
           AND ar.population_id = p.population_id
    ),
    challenger_slice AS (
        SELECT ar.*
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
        JOIN p
            ON ar.strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
           AND ar.strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
           AND ar.strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
           AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND ar.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
           AND ar.population_id = p.population_id
    ),
    matched AS (
        SELECT
            b.application_id,

            (
                b.product_type_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM c.product_type_policy_key
             OR b.score_band_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM c.score_band_policy_key
             OR b.credit_score IS DISTINCT FROM c.credit_score
             OR b.annual_income IS DISTINCT FROM c.annual_income
             OR b.requested_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.requested_amount
             OR b.requested_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM c.requested_monthly_payment_proxy
             OR b.requested_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM c.requested_payment_to_income_ratio
             OR b.amount_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM c.amount_to_income_ratio
             OR b.estimated_pd IS DISTINCT FROM c.estimated_pd
             OR b.estimated_lgd IS DISTINCT FROM c.estimated_lgd
             OR b.requested_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM c.requested_expected_loss_amount
             OR b.module1_scenario_set_name IS DISTINCT FROM c.module1_scenario_set_name
             OR b.module1_scenario_name IS DISTINCT FROM c.module1_scenario_name
             OR b.population_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.population_id
            ) AS source_field_mismatch_flag
        FROM baseline_slice b
        JOIN challenger_slice c
            ON c.module1_scenario_set_name = b.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND c.module1_scenario_name = b.module1_scenario_name
           AND c.population_id = b.population_id
           AND c.application_id = b.application_id
    )
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r)
                THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'

            WHEN (SELECT readiness_status FROM r) <> 'READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'
                THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'

            WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_field_mismatch_flag IS TRUE) = 0
                THEN 'SOURCE_FIELDS_MATCH'

            ELSE 'SOURCE_FIELD_MISMATCH_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        END AS source_consistency_status,

        COUNT(*) AS matched_application_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_field_mismatch_flag IS TRUE)
            AS source_field_mismatch_count
    FROM matched
),

validation_rows AS (
    SELECT
        'Latest-run structural integrity'::TEXT AS validation_area,
        'row_count_application_id_strategy_lineage_integrity'::TEXT AS validation_test_name,
        'STRUCTURAL'::TEXT AS validation_category,
        CASE
            WHEN total_rows > 0
             AND duplicate_application_row_count = 0
             AND strategy_version_count = 1
             AND module1_scenario_population_count = 1
                THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END AS validation_status,
        FORMAT(
            'rows=%s; distinct_application_id=%s; duplicate_application_rows=%s; strategy_version_count=%s; module1_scenario_population_count=%s',
            total_rows,
            distinct_application_id_count,
            duplicate_application_row_count,
            strategy_version_count,
            module1_scenario_population_count
        ) AS observed_value,
        'Latest-run output should be populated, unique by application_id, and scoped to one strategy and one Module 1 scenario / population.'::TEXT
            AS expected_behavior,
        'Structural integrity confirms that the latest-run strategy output is suitable for downstream QA review.'::TEXT
            AS interpretation
    FROM latest_structural

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Decision outcome completeness',
        'decision_outcome_populated_and_valid',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN invalid_decision_outcome_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('invalid_decision_outcome_rows=%s', invalid_decision_outcome_rows),
        'Every row should have one valid final decision_outcome in APPROVE, COUNTEROFFER, MANUAL_REVIEW, DECLINE.',
        'Decision completeness confirms that the final resolution layer assigned a valid simulated strategy outcome.'
    FROM decision_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Final flag reconciliation',
        'exactly_one_final_flag_true_per_row',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN final_flag_count_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('final_flag_count_violation_rows=%s', final_flag_count_violation_rows),
        'Exactly one of approval_flag, counteroffer_flag, manual_review_flag, and decline_flag should be TRUE per row.',
        'Final flags should reconcile directly to decision_outcome.'
    FROM decision_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Simulated offer-exposure convention',
        'offer_exposure_flag_alignment',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN simulated_offer_exposure_flag_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('simulated_offer_exposure_flag_violation_rows=%s', simulated_offer_exposure_flag_violation_rows),
        'simulated_offer_exposure_flag should be TRUE only for APPROVE and COUNTEROFFER.',
        'This validates the simulated positive offer-exposure boundary without implying operational exposure.'
    FROM decision_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Approved amount convention',
        'approved_amount_by_decision_outcome',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN approved_amount_convention_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('approved_amount_convention_violation_rows=%s', approved_amount_convention_violation_rows),
        'APPROVE equals requested amount; COUNTEROFFER is positive and below requested amount; MANUAL_REVIEW is NULL; DECLINE is zero.',
        'Approved amount conventions confirm that exposure treatment is internally consistent.'
    FROM decision_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Approved Expected Loss convention',
        'approved_expected_loss_by_decision_outcome',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN approved_el_convention_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('approved_el_convention_violation_rows=%s', approved_el_convention_violation_rows),
        'Approved Expected Loss should follow approved-exposure conventions by decision outcome.',
        'This validates the distinction between requested-exposure and approved-exposure Expected Loss.'
    FROM decision_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Reason-code completeness',
        'primary_reason_code_and_triggered_list_populated',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN reason_code_completeness_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('reason_code_completeness_violation_rows=%s', reason_code_completeness_violation_rows),
        'Every row should have primary reason fields and at least one triggered simulated reason code.',
        'Every simulated strategy outcome should be explainable.'
    FROM reason_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Reason-code family alignment',
        'primary_reason_family_aligns_to_decision_outcome',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN reason_family_alignment_violation_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('reason_family_alignment_violation_rows=%s', reason_family_alignment_violation_rows),
        'APPROVE uses APPROVAL; COUNTEROFFER uses COUNTEROFFER; MANUAL_REVIEW uses MANUAL_REVIEW; DECLINE uses POLICY_STOP.',
        'Reason-code family alignment prevents explanation-family leakage.'
    FROM reason_conventions

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Prohibited terminology check',
        'reason_code_boundary_terms_absent',
        'STRUCTURAL',
        CASE
            WHEN prohibited_terminology_rows = 0 THEN 'PASS'
            ELSE 'REVIEW'
        END,
        FORMAT('prohibited_terminology_rows=%s', prohibited_terminology_rows),
        'Reason-code strings should not include prohibited regulatory, customer communication, or fair-lending terminology.',
```

## 2. Module 2 elite commentary standard

For every major section, the commentary should follow this standard.

**Business purpose:** State the strategy question answered by the section. Example: “Which simulated policy conditions are triggered?” rather than “Creates rule flags.”

**SQL purpose:** State the technical object produced or validated, including input and output table names.

## Recommended Module 2 strategy set

Use one strategy set for comparable downstream strategies:

## A. `BASELINE_STRATEGY`

Already built.

**Purpose:** reference strategy.

**Expected behavior:** balanced approval / counteroffer / manual review / decline distribution.

---

## B. `TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK_STRATEGY`

You are running this now.

**Primary change:** lower synthetic estimated-PD proxy tolerance.

Example direction:

```text
approve_max_estimated_pd_proxy       0.08 → 0.06
counteroffer_max_estimated_pd_proxy  0.16 → 0.12
review_max_estimated_pd_proxy        0.30 → 0.25
decline_min_estimated_pd_proxy       0.35 → 0.30
```

**Expected behavior:**

- approval rate decreases;
- decline or manual-review rate increases;
- offer rows show lower average synthetic estimated-PD proxy;
- approved Expected Loss decreases;
- decision migration matrix should show approvals moving to counteroffer/review/decline.

**Why marketable:**  
Clean “risk-tightening” story.

---

## C. `GROWTH_ORIENTED_STRATEGY`

**Primary change:** loosen risk / affordability tolerance modestly.

Example direction:

```text
approve_max_estimated_pd_proxy       0.08 → 0.10
counteroffer_max_estimated_pd_proxy  0.16 → 0.20
review_max_estimated_pd_proxy        0.30 → 0.35
decline_min_estimated_pd_proxy       0.35 → 0.40
```

Optionally relax PTI slightly:

```text
global_approve_max_pti 0.25 → 0.28
global_review_max_pti  0.40 → 0.45
```

**Expected behavior:**

- approval / offer rate increases;
- approved amount increases;
- approved Expected Loss increases;
- average synthetic estimated-PD proxy among offer rows increases;
- reason-code distribution shifts away from policy stops.

**Why marketable:**  
Great “growth vs risk tradeoff” story.

---

## D. `TIGHTER_AFFORDABILITY_STRATEGY`

**Primary change:** tighten PTI thresholds but keep synthetic risk thresholds unchanged.

Example direction:

```text
global_approve_max_pti 0.25 → 0.22
global_review_max_pti  0.40 → 0.35
global_decline_min_pti 0.55 → 0.50
```

Product-specific PTI thresholds could also be tightened selectively.

**Expected behavior:**

- fewer clean approvals in high-PTI products;
- more counteroffers and manual reviews;
- mortgage and HELOC outcomes move most visibly;
- approved PTI improves;
- approved Expected Loss may decline through exposure treatment.

**Why marketable:**  
This is the best strategy to showcase affordability governance.

---

## E. `COUNTEROFFER_FIRST_EXPOSURE_STRATEGY`

**Primary change:** preserve offer exposure but reduce approved amount more aggressively.

Example parameter direction:

```text
lower product_max_approved_amount for selected products
lower counteroffer_target_pti
tighten product_approved_el_cap
keep failed_counteroffer_resolution = MANUAL_REVIEW
```

**Expected behavior:**

- counteroffer rate increases;
- approval rate may decline;
- simulated offer-exposure rate may remain stable or modestly decline;
- average approved amount decreases;
- approved PTI improves;
- approved Expected Loss decreases.

**Why marketable:**  
This is probably the most “credit strategy” looking result because it demonstrates a nuanced alternative to blunt declines:

```text
More constrained offers, lower approved exposure, lower approved Expected Loss.
```

---

## F. `PRODUCT_SPECIFIC_GUARDRAIL_STRATEGY`

**Primary change:** tailor product caps and counteroffer behavior by product.

Example direction:

```text
tighten REVOLVING_LINE and UNSECURED_PERSONAL_LOAN caps
tighten approved EL caps for unsecured products
preserve or mildly loosen secured product treatment
```

**Expected behavior:**

- unsecured products show lower approved exposure;
- revolving / personal loan counteroffer or decline rates increase;
- mortgage / HELOC may remain more stable;
- product × score matrix becomes highly interesting.

**Why marketable:**  
Excellent for showing that strategy is product-aware, not generic.

---

## G. `MANUAL_REVIEW_REDUCTION_STRATEGY`

**Primary change:** reduce unresolved manual review by changing failed counteroffer handling and/or tightening hierarchy.

Example direction:

```text
failed_counteroffer_resolution = DECLINE
```

Potentially also reduce borderline buffer if desired later.

**Expected behavior:**

- manual review rate decreases;
- decline rate increases;
- operational unresolved population shrinks;
- counteroffer failures become final no-offer paths.

**Why marketable:**  
This tells an operational strategy story:

```text
What happens if the strategy reduces unresolved manual review and forces clearer outcomes?
```

Use carefully because it may look harsher. But it is valuable.

## What would elevate the roadmap most

### 1. Add “strategy efficiency” metrics

This is the biggest upgrade.

Most portfolio projects show approval rates. Senior credit strategy teams care about **tradeoff efficiency**.

Add metrics like:

| Metric | Why it is senior-level |
|---|---|
| `approved_expected_loss_amount / approved_amount` | Approved Expected Loss rate on simulated offer exposure |
| `delta_total_approved_amount / delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount` | Incremental approved exposure per incremental Expected Loss |
| `delta_offer_count / delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount` | Offer growth per unit of risk cost |
| `manual_review_rate` | Operational burden / unresolved population |
| `counteroffer_share_of_offers` | How much of growth is constrained exposure rather than clean approval |
| `avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio` | Affordability quality of simulated offer exposure |
| `reason-code migration` | Explains why strategy movement occurred |

This turns the project from “decision distribution” into a **risk / growth / operations tradeoff engine**.

### 2. Make the Module 2 strategy set more like a real strategy committee pack

For marketability, I would use these five Module 2 strategies as the core strategy library:

| Strategy | Keep? | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `BASELINE_STRATEGY` | Yes | Reference strategy |
| `TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK_STRATEGY` | Yes | Risk discipline / credit tightening |
| `GROWTH_ORIENTED_STRATEGY` | Yes | Growth appetite / expanded credit box |

The most marketable one is probably **`COUNTEROFFER_FIRST_EXPOSURE_STRATEGY`** because it shows nuance:

> “We can preserve simulated offer access while reducing approved exposure, approved PTI, and approved Expected Loss.”

That is a very senior credit strategy story.

### 3. Add one “operational capacity” angle

Senior leaders care about manual review volume.

Your current Module 2 already tracks manual review. I would explicitly make one showcase about:

> “What happens when the strategy reduces unresolved manual-review volume?”

That can use:

```text
MANUAL_REVIEW_REDUCTION_STRATEGY
failed_counteroffer_resolution = DECLINE
```

This creates a clean operating-model tradeoff:

| Strategy question | Expected tradeoff |
|---|---|
| Reduce manual review volume | Lower unresolved population |
| Force failed counteroffers to no-offer path | Higher decline rate |
| Preserve baseline strategy | Higher manual review but less harsh final outcome |
| Compare reason-code movement | Shows why cases moved |

This is attractive because it shows you understand strategy is not only risk selection. It is also workflow, capacity, and governance.

### 4. Add one “concentration risk” story

This would elevate the product-mix roadmap.

A senior risk audience will like a story like:

> “If the portfolio shifts toward revolving and unsecured exposure, how do approved amount, approved Expected Loss, counteroffer rates, and reason-code drivers change?”

Use:

```text
UNSECURED_GROWTH_MIX
REVOLVING_LINE_EXPANSION_MIX
PRODUCT_SPECIFIC_GUARDRAIL_STRATEGY
```

This lets you show:

| Metric | Expected insight |
|---|---|
| Product share | Portfolio composition shift |
| Total approved amount by product | Exposure concentration |
| Approved Expected Loss by product | Risk concentration |
| Counteroffer reason codes by product | Strategy explainability |
| Product × score matrix | Segmented risk control |

This is much more marketable than simply saying “I changed product mix.”

### 5. Add one “near-prime expansion” story

This is likely your strongest credit-box showcase.

Near-prime is where strategy design matters. A portfolio of all super-prime or all deep-subprime is less interesting. Near-prime creates tradeoffs.

Use:

```text

BASELINE_STRATEGY
TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK_STRATEGY
COUNTEROFFER_FIRST_EXPOSURE_STRATEGY
```

The story:

> “Near-prime applicants are not a single decision population. Depending on product, affordability, requested exposure, and risk thresholds, they split into clean approvals, counteroffers, manual reviews, and declines.”

That is exactly the type of nuanced segmentation thinking senior credit strategy roles value.

Add this immediately after Section 12.5 and before Section 12.6.

```sql
/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 12.5A — ARCHIVE VALIDATION INDEX SUPPORT BEFORE FAIL-FAST CHECKS
****************************************************************************************************

Purpose:
    Section 12.6 performs archive persistence gatekeepers that compare the latest-run table
    to the current archived slice and validate archive grain integrity.

    These checks are validation checks, not strategy logic. They should not become a runtime
    bottleneck. The latest-run and archive tables therefore need practical indexes before
    Section 12.6 performs row-level comparison and archive grain review.

Boundary:
    This section does not recalculate decision_outcome.
    This section does not recalculate approved exposure.
    This section does not recalculate approved Expected Loss.
    This section does not reassign simulated reason codes.
    This section only supports efficient archive validation.

Why this exists:
    The archive replacement / rerun key identifies the strategy × Module 1 scenario × population
    slice. The row-level archive grain additionally includes application_id.

    Section 12.6 compares latest-run rows to archived rows at the row-level grain. Without a
    supporting index, PostgreSQL may choose a poor plan, especially as the archive grows across
    multiple strategy and scenario slices.

***************************************************************************************************/

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_m2_strategy_decisions_validation_grain
ON credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions (
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    application_id
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_m2_strategy_decisions_archive_validation_grain
ON credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive (
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    application_id
);

/*
Unique archive grain enforcement:
    The archive should not contain duplicate rows for the same application under the same
    Module 1 scenario and Module 2 strategy version.

    If duplicates already exist, this index creation will fail clearly. That is preferable to
    allowing ambiguous matched comparison later.
*/
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_m2_strategy_decisions_archive_unique_grain
ON credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive (
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    application_id
);

ANALYZE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;
ANALYZE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive;
```

```sql
Gatekeeper: archive row-level grain uniqueness must be enforced.

The unique index created before Section 12.6 is the authoritative archive-grain control.
This avoids repeatedly scanning and grouping the full archive as the archive grows.

If duplicate archive grain existed, the unique index creation would have failed before
this gatekeeper. This check confirms that the uniqueness control exists and is valid.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_index i
    JOIN pg_class idx
        ON idx.oid = i.indexrelid
    JOIN pg_class tbl
```

# Recommended permanent Section 13.0 patch

Replace the current Section 13.0 comparison parameter setup with this structure.

```sql
/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.0 — GOVERNED COMPARISON PARAMETER SETUP
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Define the selected baseline and challenger archived strategy slices for read-only matched
    comparison.

PERMANENT DESIGN CHANGE:
    Section 13 no longer infers the baseline strategy from credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions.

    The latest-run table changes whenever a new strategy is executed. Using it as the default
    comparison baseline can silently select the wrong strategy after a challenger run.

    Instead, Section 13 uses a governed temporary comparison registry. Users explicitly select
    one active comparison, and downstream Section 13 queries read from the canonical
    tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params table.

BUSINESS INTERPRETATION:
    A Module 2 strategy comparison should answer:

        "How did the challenger Module 2 strategy change outcomes relative to the baseline
         Module 2 strategy when both were applied to the same Module 1 scenario and population?"

V1.0 MATCHED COMPARISON BOUNDARY:
    Baseline and challenger strategy slices must share:

        module1_scenario_set_name
        module1_scenario_name
        population_id

    This isolates downstream Module 2 strategy effects.

WHY LATEST-RUN INFERENCE IS NOT USED:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions is the current latest-run output.
    It is intentionally replaceable.

    It is appropriate for latest-run QA.
    It is not appropriate as an implicit comparison selector.

WHY A REGISTRY IS USED:
    The registry allows multiple planned comparisons to be listed while selecting exactly one
    active comparison for the current Section 13 review.

READ-ONLY BOUNDARY:
    This section creates temporary helper tables only.
    It does not insert, delete, update, or modify archive rows.
    It does not recalculate decisions, approved exposure, approved Expected Loss, or simulated
    reason codes.

***************************************************************************************************/


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry (
    active_comparison_flag              BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    comparison_set_name                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    comparison_description              TEXT,

    baseline_strategy_set_name          TEXT NOT NULL,
    baseline_strategy_name              TEXT NOT NULL,
    baseline_strategy_version           TEXT NOT NULL,

    challenger_strategy_set_name        TEXT NOT NULL,
    challenger_strategy_name            TEXT NOT NULL,
    challenger_strategy_version         TEXT NOT NULL,

    module1_scenario_set_name           TEXT NOT NULL,
    module1_scenario_name               TEXT NOT NULL,
    population_id                       TEXT NOT NULL
) ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS;


/*
Primary active comparison for the current Module 2 validation workflow.

Users should update this registry row when changing the comparison being reviewed.

Do not use CHALLENGER_STRATEGY_PLACEHOLDER.
Do not infer baseline or challenger from the latest-run table.
*/
INSERT INTO tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry (
    active_comparison_flag,
    comparison_set_name,
    comparison_description,

    baseline_strategy_set_name,
    baseline_strategy_name,
    baseline_strategy_version,

    challenger_strategy_set_name,
    challenger_strategy_name,
    challenger_strategy_version,

    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id
)
VALUES (
    TRUE,
    'BASELINE_V2_BASELINE_STRATEGY_VS_TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK',
    'Compares Module 2 baseline strategy against tighter synthetic-risk strategy on the same Module 1 BASELINE_V2 archived population.',

    'MODULE2_BASELINE_STRATEGY_SET',
    'BASELINE_STRATEGY',
    'V1_0',

    'MODULE2_BASELINE_STRATEGY_SET',
    'TIGHTER_SYNTHETIC_RISK_STRATEGY',
    'V1_0',

    'MODULE1_V2_BASELINE_SET',
    'BASELINE_V2',
    'BASE_POPULATION_V1'
);


/*
Optional future comparisons can be added here with active_comparison_flag = FALSE.

Only one comparison should be active at a time. The selected active row is copied into
tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params, which is the canonical table used by Sections 13.2+.
*/


/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.0A — COMPARISON PARAMETER GATEKEEPER
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Validate that exactly one active comparison has been selected and that the selected comparison
    is meaningful before downstream Section 13 matched-comparison queries run.

WHY THIS GATEKEEPER EXISTS:
    Section 13 comparison outputs can appear blank if the challenger strategy slice does not exist
    or if placeholder comparison parameters are used.

    This gatekeeper prevents accidental placeholder comparison setup and protects reviewers from
    interpreting blank output as a strategy result.

BOUNDARY:
    This gatekeeper validates comparison selection only.
    It does not modify archive rows.
    It does not recalculate any strategy output.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    v_active_comparison_count BIGINT;
    v_placeholder_count BIGINT;
    v_same_strategy_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_active_comparison_count
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry
    WHERE active_comparison_flag IS TRUE;

    IF v_active_comparison_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 13.0 failure: expected exactly one active strategy comparison, found %.',
            v_active_comparison_count;
    END IF;


    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_placeholder_count
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry
    WHERE active_comparison_flag IS TRUE
      AND (
             baseline_strategy_name ILIKE '%PLACEHOLDER%'
          OR challenger_strategy_name ILIKE '%PLACEHOLDER%'
          OR baseline_strategy_set_name ILIKE '%PLACEHOLDER%'
          OR challenger_strategy_set_name ILIKE '%PLACEHOLDER%'
          OR comparison_set_name ILIKE '%PLACEHOLDER%'
      );

    IF v_placeholder_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 13.0 failure: active comparison contains placeholder strategy identifiers. Update tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry before running matched comparison.';
    END IF;


    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_same_strategy_count
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_registry
    WHERE active_comparison_flag IS TRUE
      AND baseline_strategy_set_name = challenger_strategy_set_name
      AND baseline_strategy_name = challenger_strategy_name
      AND baseline_strategy_version = challenger_strategy_version;

    IF v_same_strategy_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 13.0 failure: active comparison selects the same strategy as both baseline and challenger.';
    END IF;
END $$;


/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.0B — CANONICAL ACTIVE COMPARISON PARAMETER TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Materialize the single active comparison into the canonical parameter table used by all
    downstream Section 13 queries.

WHY THIS TABLE IS PRESERVED:
    Sections 13.2 through 13.11 already reference tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params.

    By loading the active registry row into this canonical table, the permanent Section 13 fix
    avoids rewriting downstream comparison queries.

***************************************************************************************************/

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params;

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params (
    comparison_set_name                   TEXT,

    baseline_strategy_set_name            TEXT,
    baseline_strategy_name                TEXT,
    baseline_strategy_version             TEXT,

    challenger_strategy_set_name          TEXT,
    challenger_strategy_name              TEXT,
    challenger_strategy_version           TEXT,

    module1_scenario_set_name             TEXT,
    module1_scenario_name                 TEXT,
    population_id                         TEXT
) ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS;
```

```sql
         estimated-risk profile, counteroffer usage, manual-review burden, and decline rate?"
```
