        strategy_name,
        strategy_version,
        application_id.

REQUESTED VS APPROVED EXPECTED LOSS:
    requested_expected_loss_amount is the requested-exposure Expected Loss carried from Module 1.

    approved_expected_loss_amount is the approved-exposure Expected Loss calculated by Module 2 after
    final simulated exposure treatment.

    This distinction is critical because a final COUNTEROFFER can reduce approved exposure and
    approved Expected Loss without changing the original requested-exposure Expected Loss.

ESTIMATED_PD BOUNDARY:
    estimated_pd remains the finalized Module 1 SQL field name.

    In interpretation, estimated_pd means the synthetic estimated-PD proxy.

    Module 2 does not recalculate estimated_pd.
    Module 2 does not calibrate estimated_pd.
    Module 2 does not create a post-decision risk model.

SIMULATED OFFER EXPOSURE BOUNDARY:
    simulated_offer_exposure_flag identifies simulated positive offer exposure for APPROVE and
    COUNTEROFFER outcomes.

    It does not imply:
        operational account creation,
        booked exposure,
        funded exposure,
        production approval,
        customer treatment,
        or a real applicant decision.

SIMULATED REASON-CODE BOUNDARY:
    Reason-code fields are simulated strategy explanation codes only.

    They support:
        strategy transparency,
        QA review,
        decision-path traceability,
        matched comparison,
        executive evidence capture,
        and validation documentation.

    They are not:
        customer communications,
        regulatory notices,
        adverse-action reasons,
        production compliance determinations,
        fair-lending conclusions,
        or external communication text.

LATEST_OUTPUT_CREATED_TS BOUNDARY:
    latest_output_created_ts records when the latest-run table was materialized.

    It is audit metadata.

    It is not deterministic comparison evidence.

    Matched strategy comparison should exclude timestamp fields unless specifically validating run
    metadata.

SECTION 11 QA BOUNDARY:
    Section 11 local checks validate latest-run output integrity only.

    They are not the full Module 2 QA framework.

    The full validation and QA framework is built in Section 14.

SQL CONCEPTS TAUGHT IN THIS SECTION:
    CREATE TABLE ... AS:
        Materializes a permanent table from the completed temporary reason-code staging output.

    Explicit SELECT list:
        Governs the permanent output schema and prevents accidental helper-column drift.

    CROSS JOIN:
        Attaches the one active archive-control parameter row to every latest-run output row.

    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS:
        Adds practical access paths for common latest-run review queries without changing the table
        rows.

    COUNT(*) and COUNT(DISTINCT application_id):
        Validate row preservation and application-level uniqueness.

    COUNT(DISTINCT (...)):
        Validates that latest-run output contains one strategy slice and one Module 1 source slice.

    IS DISTINCT FROM:
        Provides NULL-safe convention checks.

    FILTER:
        Supports compact diagnostic aggregation in Section 11.5.

    TO_REGCLASS:
        Checks whether the permanent latest-run table exists.

GOVERNANCE ROLE:
    Section 11 creates the stable latest-run output surface consumed by:
        Section 12 archive persistence,
        Section 14 latest-run validation,
        Section 15 strategy frontier summary,
        and Section 16 evidence capture.

COMMON MISUSE TO AVOID:
    Do not treat credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions as historical archive.
    Do not compare multiple completed strategies from the latest-run table.
    Do not interpret latest_output_created_ts as a business outcome.
    Do not interpret simulated_offer_exposure_flag as real operational exposure.
    Do not interpret simulated reason codes as external communication text.
    Do not expect campaign registry IDs to appear in every applicant-level latest-run row.
    Do not skip Section 14 QA merely because Section 11 local gatekeepers pass.

***************************************************************************************************/



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 11.0 — SECTION 11 DEPENDENCY PREFLIGHT
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Confirm that Section 10 reason-code staging output and active strategy parameters exist before
    the permanent latest-run table is materialized.

    Section 11.0 answers:

        "Can Section 11 safely create the latest-run output from the completed Section 10 staging
         layer?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Confirm tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment exists.
    2. Confirm tmp_module2_strategy_params exists.
    3. Confirm Section 10 staging contains rows.
    4. Confirm Section 10 staging remains unique at application_id.
    5. Confirm Section 10 staging resolves to exactly one Module 2 strategy identity.
    6. Confirm Section 10 staging resolves to exactly one Module 1 scenario / population identity.
    7. Confirm exactly one active strategy parameter row exists.
    8. Confirm archive controls are valid before they are attached to latest-run output.
    9. Confirm required final decision and reason-code fields exist in Section 10 staging.
    10. Fail clearly if Section 11 is run out of order.

WHY THIS PREFLIGHT EXISTS:
    Section 11 creates a permanent latest-run table.

    It should not materialize a permanent output from missing, empty, duplicated, mixed-strategy, or
    incomplete staging data.

BOUNDARY:
    Section 11.0 does not create the latest-run output table.
    Section 11.0 does not insert archive rows.
    Section 11.0 does not modify the archive.
    Section 11.0 does not perform matched comparison.
    Section 11.0 does not create evidence rows.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    v_stage7_exists BOOLEAN;
    v_strategy_params_exists BOOLEAN;

    v_stage7_count BIGINT;
    v_stage7_distinct_application_count BIGINT;
    v_stage7_strategy_scope_count BIGINT;
    v_stage7_module1_scope_count BIGINT;

    v_active_strategy_count BIGINT;
    v_archive_control_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_required_stage7_gap_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Dependency check: Section 10 reason-code assignment table must exist.

    SQL mechanics:
        TO_REGCLASS checks whether the temporary object exists.

        pg_temp is checked because tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment is a temporary table.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COALESCE(
        TO_REGCLASS('pg_temp.tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment'),
        TO_REGCLASS('tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment')
    ) IS NOT NULL
    INTO v_stage7_exists;

    IF v_stage7_exists IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment is required. Run Section 10 before Section 11.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Dependency check: active strategy parameter table must exist.

    Section 11 uses tmp_module2_strategy_params to attach archive controls to the latest-run output.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COALESCE(
        TO_REGCLASS('pg_temp.tmp_module2_strategy_params'),
        TO_REGCLASS('tmp_module2_strategy_params')
    ) IS NOT NULL
    INTO v_strategy_params_exists;

    IF v_strategy_params_exists IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: tmp_module2_strategy_params is required. Run Section 2 before Section 11.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Section 10 staging table must contain rows.

    Business interpretation:
        A permanent latest-run output with zero applicant rows is not a usable completed strategy run.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage7_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment;

    IF v_stage7_count <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment contains zero rows.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Section 10 staging must remain unique at application_id.

    Section 11 should materialize one latest-run row per synthetic application.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
    INTO v_stage7_distinct_application_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment;

    IF v_stage7_distinct_application_count <> v_stage7_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: Section 10 staging is not unique at application_id. Rows=%, distinct application_id=%.',
            v_stage7_count,
            v_stage7_distinct_application_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Section 10 staging should contain exactly one Module 2 strategy identity.

    Business interpretation:
        The latest-run table is current-run only.

        It should not contain multiple strategy_name / strategy_version combinations.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (
        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version
    ))
    INTO v_stage7_strategy_scope_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment;

    IF v_stage7_strategy_scope_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: Section 10 staging contains % Module 2 strategy identities. Expected exactly one.',
            v_stage7_strategy_scope_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Section 10 staging should contain exactly one Module 1 scenario / population slice.

    Business interpretation:
        Module 2 V1.0 latest-run output is a single-source-slice output.

        Multi-scenario latest-run output is not designed in this version.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (
        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id
    ))
    INTO v_stage7_module1_scope_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment;

    IF v_stage7_module1_scope_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: Section 10 staging contains % Module 1 scenario / population identities. Expected exactly one.',
            v_stage7_module1_scope_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: exactly one active strategy parameter row.

    Section 11 attaches archive controls through active_archive_controls.

    That CTE must resolve to one row only.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_active_strategy_count
    FROM tmp_module2_strategy_params
    WHERE active_strategy_flag IS TRUE;

    IF v_active_strategy_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: expected exactly one active strategy parameter row, found %.',
            v_active_strategy_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: archive controls must be valid before they are attached to the latest-run output.

    Archive persistence happens in Section 12, but Section 11 carries the active archive controls so
    Section 12 can validate and act on them from the completed latest-run table.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_archive_control_failure_count
    FROM tmp_module2_strategy_params
    WHERE active_strategy_flag IS TRUE
      AND (
             archive_run_flag IS NULL
          OR strategy_archive_reset_mode IS NULL
          OR strategy_archive_reset_mode NOT IN (
                'NONE',
                'STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY',
                'STRATEGY_SET_ONLY',
                'ALL'
          )
      );

    IF v_archive_control_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: active strategy archive controls are missing or invalid.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Section 10 staging must contain the fields required for permanent output
    materialization.

    Business interpretation:
        Section 11 should not create a permanent latest-run output if final decision, final exposure,
        or simulated reason-code fields are incomplete.

    SQL mechanics:
        This check focuses on required fields that should be populated for every row or by locked
        final outcome convention.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_required_stage7_gap_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment
    WHERE module2_model_version IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(module2_model_version), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_set_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_set_name), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_name), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_version IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_version), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_run_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_run_id), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_run_ts IS NULL

       OR module1_scenario_set_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(module1_scenario_set_name), '') IS NULL
       OR module1_scenario_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(module1_scenario_name), '') IS NULL
       OR population_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(population_id), '') IS NULL

       OR application_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(application_id), '') IS NULL

       OR requested_amount IS NULL
       OR requested_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
       OR estimated_pd IS NULL
       OR estimated_lgd IS NULL

       OR decision_outcome IS NULL
       OR decision_outcome NOT IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
       OR decision_path IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_path), '') IS NULL
       OR decision_resolution_source IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_resolution_source), '') IS NULL

       OR approval_flag IS NULL
       OR counteroffer_flag IS NULL
       OR manual_review_flag IS NULL
       OR decline_flag IS NULL
       OR simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS NULL

       OR primary_reason_code IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(primary_reason_code), '') IS NULL
       OR primary_reason_family IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(primary_reason_family), '') IS NULL
       OR triggered_reason_code_list IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(triggered_reason_code_list), '') IS NULL
       OR reason_priority_rank IS NULL
       OR reason_code_count IS NULL;

    IF v_required_stage7_gap_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % Section 10 staging row(s) are missing required latest-run output fields.',
            v_required_stage7_gap_count;
    END IF;
END $$;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 11.1 — CLEAN RESET OF LATEST-RUN OUTPUT TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Drop the replaceable latest-run output table before rebuilding it from completed Section 10
    staging output.

SQL PURPOSE:
    Remove only:

        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions

WHY THIS MATTERS:
    The latest-run table is intentionally current-run only.

    Dropping it prevents a partial or prior latest-run output from being mixed with the current
    completed strategy run.

SQL MECHANICS:
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS makes the reset rerunnable.

    If the latest-run table does not exist, PostgreSQL does not error.

BOUNDARY:
    This does not drop:
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_campaign_registry
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_comparison_campaign_registry
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_validation_evidence
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_segment_evidence_summary

****************************************************************************************************/

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 11.2 — CREATE LATEST-RUN STRATEGY DECISION OUTPUT TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

TABLE:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions

GRAIN:
    One row per application_id for the selected Module 1 source scenario / population and active
    Module 2 strategy.

INPUT:
    tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment

OUTPUT:
    Permanent latest-run table with final simulated strategy output and diagnostic trace fields.

IMPORTANT:
    This table does not preserve prior runs.

    Prior completed runs are preserved through Section 12 archive persistence.

SQL DESIGN:
    This section uses:

        CREATE TABLE ... AS
        WITH active_archive_controls AS (...)
        SELECT explicit_field_list
        FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment
        CROSS JOIN active_archive_controls

    The active archive-control CTE is one row because Section 11.0 validated active strategy
    parameter cardinality.

WHY CROSS JOIN IS APPROPRIATE:
    active_archive_controls contains exactly one active strategy control row.

    CROSS JOIN attaches that one archive-control setting to every applicant row in the latest-run
    output.

    If active_archive_controls had more than one row, CROSS JOIN would duplicate applicants. Section
    11.0 prevents that.

WHY CAMPAIGN IDS ARE NOT SELECTED HERE:
    Campaign registry IDs are run-level evidence metadata.

    They are persisted later in Section 16 evidence tables.

    The latest-run applicant table keeps technical lineage and applicant-level strategy output fields.

***************************************************************************************************/

CREATE TABLE credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions AS
WITH active_archive_controls AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    CTE: active_archive_controls

    Purpose:
        Select the active archive persistence controls from the current strategy parameter card.

    SQL mechanics:
        Section 11.0 already validated exactly one active strategy parameter row.

        LIMIT 1 is therefore safe.

    Boundary:
        These controls are carried into the latest-run output so Section 12 can validate archive
        behavior from the completed current-run table.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        archive_run_flag,
        strategy_archive_reset_mode
    FROM tmp_module2_strategy_params
    WHERE active_strategy_flag IS TRUE
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    /***********************************************************************************************
    1. Module 2 strategy metadata

    These fields identify the downstream simulated strategy applied to the selected Module 1
    population.

    strategy_run_id and strategy_run_ts are audit metadata.

    They support run traceability but do not replace:
        archive replacement key,
        matched comparison key,
        campaign registry key,
        or application-level grain.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.module2_model_version,
    r.strategy_set_name,
    r.strategy_name,
    r.strategy_version,
    r.strategy_run_id,
    r.strategy_run_ts,
    r.failed_counteroffer_resolution,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    2. Archive controls

    Archive controls are included in the latest-run output so Section 12 archive persistence can be
    audited directly from the completed latest-run table.

    These fields are run-level controls repeated on applicant-level rows.

    They are not part of the row-level application grain.

    They do not replace the archive replacement / rerun key.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    aac.archive_run_flag,
    aac.strategy_archive_reset_mode,

    r.module1_input_source,
    r.module1_source_table_name,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    3. Module 1 lineage

    These fields preserve upstream synthetic population and scenario lineage from Module 1.

    They describe the source population / scenario environment, not the downstream Module 2 strategy.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.module1_model_version,
    r.module1_scenario_set_name,
    r.module1_scenario_name,
    r.population_id,
    r.anchor_date,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    4. Application lineage

    These fields identify the synthetic application and synthetic applicant.

    application_id should be unique in the latest-run table.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.application_seq,
    r.application_id,
    r.applicant_id,
    r.application_date,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    5. Product and score segmentation

    product_type:
        original Module 1 product value.

        normalized Module 2 product policy key.

    score_band:
        original Module 1 score-band value.

    score_band_policy_key:
        normalized Module 2 score policy key.

    product_score_policy_segment:
        product × score segment used for segment-level QA and evidence capture.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.product_type,
    r.product_type_policy_key,
    r.score_band,
    r.score_band_policy_key,
    r.credit_score,
    r.product_score_policy_segment,

    6. Borrower and behavioral profile

    These fields are applicant-profile inputs preserved from the staged source.

    prequalified_flag and returning_customer_flag remain nullable when Module 1 does not provide
    them.

    These fields support diagnostics, not real applicant treatment.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.annual_income,

    r.utilization_rate,
    r.tradeline_count,
    r.months_since_oldest_trade,
    r.recent_inquiry_count,
    r.delinquency_count_12m,
    r.major_derogatory_flag,

    r.preliminary_decline_flag,
    r.preliminary_counteroffer_flag,
    r.preliminary_manual_review_flag,
    r.preliminary_approve_flag,

    r.requires_counteroffer_feasibility_flag,
    r.requires_approved_exposure_calculation_flag,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    12. Exposure treatment and counteroffer feasibility diagnostics

    These fields preserve the Section 8 exposure-treatment workflow.

    The preliminary fields support traceability from:
        preliminary routing
        → counteroffer feasibility
        → final decision resolution.

    counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason is a diagnostic, not a final simulated reason code.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.exposure_treatment_status,
    r.exposure_treatment_path,

    r.approved_amount_preliminary,
    r.counteroffer_amount_preliminary,
    r.exposure_reduction_flag_preliminary,
    r.exposure_reduction_amount_preliminary,
    r.exposure_reduction_pct_preliminary,

    r.approved_monthly_payment_proxy_preliminary,
    r.approved_payment_to_income_ratio_preliminary,

    r.approved_expected_loss_amount_preliminary,
    r.approved_el_reduction_amount_preliminary,
    r.approved_el_reduction_pct_preliminary,

    r.counteroffer_feasibility_evaluated_flag,
    r.counteroffer_feasibility_pass_flag,
    r.counteroffer_feasibility_failure_reason,
    r.counteroffer_feasibility_constraint_count,

    r.counteroffer_product_cap_amount,
    r.counteroffer_pti_target_amount,
    r.counteroffer_el_cap_amount,
    r.counteroffer_raw_max_feasible_amount,
    r.counteroffer_min_viable_amount,
    r.counteroffer_rounded_amount,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    13. Final decision outcome fields

    These fields are the final simulated strategy outcome labels from Section 9.

    decision_outcome is one of:
        APPROVE,
        COUNTEROFFER,
        MANUAL_REVIEW,
        DECLINE.

    decision_path and decision_resolution_source are internal strategy diagnostics, not customer
    communications.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.decision_outcome,
    r.decision_path,
    r.decision_priority_rank,
    r.decision_resolution_source,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    14. Final decision flags

    Exactly one of:
        approval_flag,
        counteroffer_flag,
        manual_review_flag,
        decline_flag

    should be TRUE per row.

    simulated_offer_exposure_flag is TRUE for final APPROVE and final COUNTEROFFER only.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.approval_flag,
    r.counteroffer_flag,
    r.manual_review_flag,
    r.decline_flag,
    r.simulated_offer_exposure_flag,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    15. Final approved exposure and economics

    These are final simulated Module 2 output fields.

    APPROVE:
        preserves requested exposure.

    COUNTEROFFER:
        uses feasible reduced exposure.

    MANUAL_REVIEW:
        remains unresolved with NULL approved exposure and economics.

    DECLINE:
        uses zero-exposure convention.

    approved_expected_loss_amount is approved-exposure Expected Loss, not requested-exposure
    Expected Loss.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.approved_amount,
    r.counteroffer_amount,
    r.exposure_reduction_flag,
    r.exposure_reduction_amount,
    r.exposure_reduction_pct,

    r.approved_monthly_payment_proxy,
    r.approved_payment_to_income_ratio,

    r.approved_expected_loss_amount,
    r.approved_el_reduction_amount,
    r.approved_el_reduction_pct,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    16. Simulated reason-code fields

    These are simulated strategy explanation codes, not external communication text.

    primary_reason_code:
        highest-priority simulated explanation code.

    secondary_reason_code and tertiary_reason_code:
        additional same-family diagnostics when present.

    triggered_reason_code_list:
        full deterministic list of applicable simulated explanation codes for the final outcome
        family.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    r.primary_reason_code,
    r.secondary_reason_code,
    r.tertiary_reason_code,
    r.primary_reason_family,
    r.triggered_reason_code_list,
    r.reason_priority_rank,
    r.reason_code_count,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    17. Latest-run audit timestamp

    latest_output_created_ts is audit metadata.

    It should not be used as deterministic comparison evidence unless specifically validating run
    metadata.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS latest_output_created_ts

FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment r
CROSS JOIN active_archive_controls aac;

BUSINESS PURPOSE:

SQL PURPOSE:

WHY INDEXES ARE CREATED HERE:

    Common downstream review patterns filter or group by:

INTERPRETATION:
    Indexes improve query performance and review ergonomics.

    They do not alter rows, decision outcomes, exposure fields, reason codes, or archive state.

SQL MECHANICS:
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS makes index creation rerunnable.

****************************************************************************************************/

/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 11.4 — LOCAL FAIL-FAST CHECKS FOR LATEST-RUN OUTPUT
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Confirm that the permanent latest-run output table faithfully preserves the completed Section 10
    result and obeys the accepted Module 2 output conventions before archive persistence begins.

    Section 11.4 answers:

        "Is credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions structurally sound and safe to hand to
         archive persistence, QA, frontier review, and evidence capture?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Confirm credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions exists.
    2. Confirm row count matches tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment.
    3. Confirm application_id uniqueness.
    4. Confirm exactly one Module 2 strategy identity exists.
    5. Confirm exactly one Module 1 scenario / population identity exists.
    6. Confirm latest_output_created_ts is populated.
    7. Confirm strategy metadata and Module 1 lineage are populated.
    8. Confirm archive controls are populated and valid.
    9. Confirm final decision fields and final decision flags reconcile.
    10. Confirm simulated_offer_exposure_flag convention.
    11. Confirm approved amount and exposure conventions.
    12. Confirm requested / approved Expected Loss conventions.
    13. Confirm simulated reason-code completeness and family alignment.
    14. Confirm prohibited reason-code terminology controls.

LOCAL GATEKEEPER BOUNDARY:
    These are latest-run output gatekeepers only.

    They are not:
        archive validation,
        matched strategy comparison,
        full Module 2 QA,
        final Validation Summary evidence,
        executive frontier evidence,
        or campaign-run evidence capture.

SQL MECHANICS:
    This block uses PL/pgSQL because it needs multiple diagnostic counts and fail-fast exceptions.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Row-grain diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_stage7_count BIGINT;
    v_latest_count BIGINT;
    v_latest_distinct_app_count BIGINT;
    v_duplicate_application_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Object and scope diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_output_table_exists BOOLEAN;
    v_strategy_scope_count BIGINT;
    v_module1_scope_count BIGINT;
    v_latest_output_created_ts_null_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Integrity diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_metadata_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_archive_control_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_decision_integrity_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_offer_flag_failure_count BIGINT;

    v_amount_integrity_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_expected_loss_integrity_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_reason_integrity_failure_count BIGINT;
    v_prohibited_reason_term_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run output table must exist.

    SQL mechanics:
        TO_REGCLASS returns NULL if the table is absent.

    Failure interpretation:
        Section 11.2 did not materialize the output table or was not run.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions') IS NOT NULL
    INTO v_output_table_exists;

    IF v_output_table_exists IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions does not exist.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run row count must match Section 10 staging.

    Business purpose:
        Confirm Section 11 materialized the completed reason-code staging layer without dropping,
        duplicating, or filtering rows.

    SQL mechanics:
        Compare COUNT(*) in the temporary Section 10 output and the permanent latest-run table.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_stage7_count
    FROM tmp_m2_stage_7_reason_code_assignment;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_latest_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_latest_count <> v_stage7_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: latest-run row count (%) does not match Section 10 staging row count (%).',
            v_latest_count,
            v_stage7_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: application_id remains unique.

    Business purpose:
        Latest-run output should be one row per synthetic application.

    Why this matters:
        Duplicate application_id rows would corrupt archive persistence, QA counts, matched
        comparison, frontier summaries, and evidence capture.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
    INTO v_latest_distinct_app_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_latest_distinct_app_count <> v_latest_count THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO v_duplicate_application_count
        FROM (
            SELECT application_id
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
            GROUP BY application_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ) d;

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: application_id uniqueness failed in latest-run output. Rows: %, distinct application_id count: %, duplicate application_id group count: %.',
            v_latest_count,
            v_latest_distinct_app_count,
            v_duplicate_application_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run output should contain exactly one Module 2 strategy identity.

    Business purpose:
        The latest-run table is current-run only.

        Multiple strategy identities would make Section 12 archive controls and Section 14 latest-run
        validation ambiguous.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (
        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version
    ))
    INTO v_strategy_scope_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_strategy_scope_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: latest-run output contains % Module 2 strategy identities. Expected exactly one.',
            v_strategy_scope_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run output should contain exactly one Module 1 scenario / population identity.

    Business purpose:
        Module 2 V1.0 latest-run output is one selected Module 1 source slice.

        Multiple Module 1 source slices would mix upstream scenario effects inside one latest-run
        strategy output.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (
        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id
    ))
    INTO v_module1_scope_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_module1_scope_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: latest-run output contains % Module 1 scenario / population identities. Expected exactly one.',
            v_module1_scope_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest_output_created_ts must be populated.

    Business purpose:
        latest_output_created_ts provides audit metadata showing when Section 11 materialized the
        current latest-run table.

    Boundary:
        This timestamp is not a strategy comparison key.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_latest_output_created_ts_null_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE latest_output_created_ts IS NULL;

    IF v_latest_output_created_ts_null_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have null latest_output_created_ts.',
            v_latest_output_created_ts_null_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: metadata and lineage integrity.

    Business interpretation:
        Strategy metadata identifies the downstream Module 2 strategy.
        Module 1 lineage identifies the upstream synthetic population / scenario.

    These two lineage families must remain separate and populated.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_metadata_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE strategy_set_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_set_name), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_name), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_version IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_version), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_run_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_run_id), '') IS NULL
       OR strategy_run_ts IS NULL

       OR module1_scenario_set_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(module1_scenario_set_name), '') IS NULL
       OR module1_scenario_name IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(module1_scenario_name), '') IS NULL
       OR population_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(population_id), '') IS NULL;

    IF v_metadata_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have missing strategy metadata or Module 1 lineage.',
            v_metadata_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: archive controls are populated and valid.

    Business interpretation:
        archive_run_flag and strategy_archive_reset_mode support Section 12 archive persistence.

        They are not archive replacement keys.

    Allowed reset modes:
        NONE
        STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY
        STRATEGY_SET_ONLY
        ALL
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_archive_control_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE archive_run_flag IS NULL
       OR strategy_archive_reset_mode IS NULL
       OR strategy_archive_reset_mode NOT IN (
            'NONE',
            'STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY',
            'STRATEGY_SET_ONLY',
            'ALL'
       );

    IF v_archive_control_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % row(s) have missing or invalid archive control fields.',
            v_archive_control_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: final decision integrity.

    Business interpretation:
        Every latest-run row should have one and only one final simulated decision outcome.

    Expected:
        decision_outcome in APPROVE / COUNTEROFFER / MANUAL_REVIEW / DECLINE.

        Exactly one of:
            approval_flag,
            counteroffer_flag,
            manual_review_flag,
            decline_flag

        should be TRUE per row.

    SQL mechanics:
        Boolean flags are cast to INT so they can be summed.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_decision_integrity_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE decision_outcome IS NULL
       OR decision_outcome NOT IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
       OR decision_path IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_path), '') IS NULL
       OR decision_resolution_source IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(decision_resolution_source), '') IS NULL
       OR (
            COALESCE(approval_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(counteroffer_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(manual_review_flag::INT, 0)
            + COALESCE(decline_flag::INT, 0)
          ) <> 1
       OR approval_flag IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')
       OR counteroffer_flag IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')
       OR manual_review_flag IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')
       OR decline_flag IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome = 'DECLINE');

    IF v_decision_integrity_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have final decision integrity or flag reconciliation failures.',
            v_decision_integrity_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: simulated_offer_exposure_flag integrity.

    Expected:
        TRUE only for APPROVE and COUNTEROFFER.

        FALSE for MANUAL_REVIEW and DECLINE.

    Boundary:
        simulated_offer_exposure_flag means simulated positive offer exposure only.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_offer_flag_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE simulated_offer_exposure_flag
          IS DISTINCT FROM (decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER'));

    IF v_offer_flag_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have simulated_offer_exposure_flag reconciliation failures.',
            v_offer_flag_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: amount / exposure integrity.

    Final output conventions:
        APPROVE:
            approved_amount = requested_amount.

        COUNTEROFFER:
            approved_amount is positive and below requested_amount.
            counteroffer_amount = approved_amount.

        MANUAL_REVIEW:
            approved_amount is NULL because unresolved.

        DECLINE:
            approved_amount = 0 by zero-exposure convention.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_amount_integrity_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE
        (
            approved_amount IS NOT NULL
            AND approved_amount < 0
        )
     OR (
            approved_amount IS NOT NULL
            AND approved_amount > requested_amount
        )
     OR (
            decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
            AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_amount
        )
     OR (
            decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
            AND (
                approved_amount IS NULL
                OR approved_amount <= 0
                OR approved_amount >= requested_amount
                OR counteroffer_amount IS DISTINCT FROM approved_amount
            )
        )
     OR (
            decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            AND approved_amount IS NOT NULL
        )
     OR (
            decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
            AND approved_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
        );

    IF v_amount_integrity_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have approved amount or exposure convention failures.',
            v_amount_integrity_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: Expected Loss integrity.

    Business interpretation:
        requested_expected_loss_amount is requested-exposure Expected Loss.
        approved_expected_loss_amount is approved-exposure Expected Loss.

    Final output conventions:
        APPROVE:
            approved Expected Loss equals requested Expected Loss.

        COUNTEROFFER:
            approved Expected Loss is populated and should not exceed requested Expected Loss.

        MANUAL_REVIEW:
            approved Expected Loss is NULL because unresolved.

        DECLINE:
            approved Expected Loss equals zero by zero-exposure convention.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_expected_loss_integrity_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE requested_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
       OR (
            approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
            AND approved_expected_loss_amount < 0
       )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
            AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM requested_expected_loss_amount
       )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
            AND (
                approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
                OR approved_expected_loss_amount > requested_expected_loss_amount
            )
       )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS NOT NULL
       )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
            AND approved_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM 0::NUMERIC
       );

    IF v_expected_loss_integrity_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have requested / approved Expected Loss convention failures.',
            v_expected_loss_integrity_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: simulated reason-code integrity.

    Business interpretation:
        Reason-code fields should be populated and aligned to final decision_outcome.

    Expected family alignment:
        APPROVE       → APPROVAL
        COUNTEROFFER  → COUNTEROFFER
        MANUAL_REVIEW → MANUAL_REVIEW
        DECLINE       → POLICY_STOP
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_reason_integrity_failure_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE primary_reason_code IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(primary_reason_code), '') IS NULL
       OR primary_reason_family IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(primary_reason_family), '') IS NULL
       OR triggered_reason_code_list IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(triggered_reason_code_list), '') IS NULL
       OR reason_priority_rank IS NULL
       OR reason_priority_rank <= 0
       OR reason_code_count IS NULL
       OR reason_code_count < 1
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'APPROVAL'
          )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'COUNTEROFFER'
          )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
          )
       OR (
            decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
            AND primary_reason_family <> 'POLICY_STOP'
          );

    IF v_reason_integrity_failure_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) have simulated reason-code integrity failures.',
            v_reason_integrity_failure_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: prohibited reason-code terminology controls.

    Business purpose:
        Protect the interpretation boundary that Module 2 reason codes are simulated strategy
        explanation codes only.

    These controls prevent terms that imply:
        adverse-action notice,
        regulatory notice,
        customer notice,
        fair-lending conclusion.

    Boundary:
        This does not make simulated reason codes externally approved communication language.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_prohibited_reason_term_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
       OR COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
       OR COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'
       OR COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') ILIKE '%ADVERSE_ACTION%'

       OR COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%REGULATORY%'
       OR COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%REGULATORY%'
       OR COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%REGULATORY%'
       OR COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') ILIKE '%REGULATORY%'

       OR COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
       OR COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
       OR COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'
       OR COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') ILIKE '%CUSTOMER_NOTICE%'

       OR COALESCE(primary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
       OR COALESCE(secondary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
       OR COALESCE(tertiary_reason_code, '') ILIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%'
       OR COALESCE(triggered_reason_code_list, '') ILIKE '%FAIR_LENDING%';

    IF v_prohibited_reason_term_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 11 failure: % latest-run row(s) contain prohibited reason-code terminology.',
            v_prohibited_reason_term_count;
    END IF;

    /*
    Archive note:
        Section 11 contains no archive insert logic.
        Archive persistence remains deferred to Section 12.
    */
END $$;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 11.5 — LOCAL LATEST-RUN SANITY CHECKS
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Let reviewers inspect the newly materialized latest-run output before archive persistence begins.

    Section 11.5 answers:

        "What does the current latest-run output look like at a high level?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    Provide lightweight diagnostics for:
        row count,
        final decision outcome distribution,
        final decision path distribution,
        primary reason-code distribution,
        primary reason-family distribution,
        product × outcome,
        score band × outcome,
        product × primary reason,
        score band × primary reason,
        synthetic risk tier × outcome,
        requested PTI bucket × outcome,
        mixed-signal profile × outcome,
        borderline profile × outcome,
        requested versus approved amount,
        requested versus approved PTI,
        requested versus approved Expected Loss,
        simulated offer-exposure profile.

INTERPRETATION:
    These are latest-run output diagnostics.

    They are not:

        matched strategy comparison,
        full Module 2 validation,
        executive frontier summary,
        or final evidence capture.

SQL TEACHING POINT:
    These SELECT statements are read-only.

    GROUP BY summarizes the latest-run table along key dimensions.

    FILTER is used to calculate offer-row metrics without losing all-application context.

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
11.5.1 Latest-run row count and distinct application_id count.

Purpose:

Expected:
    latest_run_row_count = distinct_application_id_count.

Interpretation:
    Matching values indicate one row per synthetic application.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS latest_run_row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS distinct_application_id_count,
    MIN(latest_output_created_ts) AS min_latest_output_created_ts,
    MAX(latest_output_created_ts) AS max_latest_output_created_ts
FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Purpose:

    DECLINE follows zero-exposure convention.

Boundary:

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    decision_outcome,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC

    ) AS pct_of_latest_run
FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
GROUP BY decision_outcome
ORDER BY
    CASE decision_outcome
        WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'COUNTEROFFER' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW' THEN 3

/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 12 — STRATEGY DECISION ARCHIVE PERSISTENCE LAYER
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Persist completed latest-run Module 2 strategy outputs into a governed archive table.

    Section 12 answers:

        "Should this completed Module 2 strategy run be archived, and if so, how should existing
         archive rows be handled before inserting the current latest-run output?"

    This section is the governed history layer for Module 2.

    Section 11 materialized the current latest-run output.
    Section 12 decides whether that completed latest-run output should become durable historical
    strategy evidence.

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Consume credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions.
    2. Create or reuse credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive.
    3. Validate latest-run archive controls.
    4. Validate archive schema alignment.
    5. Capture archive inventory before persistence.
    6. Apply governed archive reset / replacement behavior.
    7. Insert the current latest-run output into the archive when archive_run_flag = TRUE.
    8. Add archive_inserted_ts as archive persistence audit metadata.
    9. Capture archive inventory after persistence.
    10. Add archive validation indexes before row-level persistence checks.
    11. Validate archive grain, current slice integrity, and archive-control behavior.
    12. Create practical archive indexes.
    13. Provide lightweight archive diagnostics.

WHO SHOULD REVIEW THIS SECTION:
    Credit strategy reviewers:
        Confirm that completed strategy outputs are archived under the intended replacement behavior
        before strategy comparison or frontier review begins.

    Model governance / validation reviewers:
        Confirm that archive persistence preserves the completed latest-run output without
        recalculating decisions, reason codes, approved exposure, or approved Expected Loss.

    SQL reviewers:
        Confirm that archive persistence uses explicit keys, schema-alignment checks, dynamic insert
        column lists, row-level fidelity checks, and archive grain enforcement.

    Portfolio / executive reviewers:
        Use the archive as the governed source for later matched comparison, strategy frontier, and
        run-evidence capture.

WHEN TO RUN THIS SECTION:
    Run Section 12 after:

        Section 11 — Latest-Run Strategy Decision Output Table

    Section 12 should be run before:

        Section 13 — Archive Inventory and Matched Strategy Comparison Framework
        Section 15 — Strategy Frontier Summary and Executive Comparison View
        Section 16 — Strategy Run Evidence Capture and Executive Story Register

    Section 12 depends on:

        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions

HOW TO INTERPRET THIS SECTION:
    Passing Section 12 means:
        the archive table exists,
        the archive schema aligns to the latest-run schema,
        archive controls were unambiguous,
        archive reset / replacement behavior was applied according to the active controls,
        archived rows preserve the latest-run core strategy output fields,
        archive row-level grain is protected,
        and archive diagnostics are available for review.

    Passing Section 12 does not mean:
        matched strategy comparison has been performed,
        full latest-run QA has passed,
        strategy frontier evidence has been created,
        executive evidence has been captured,
        or documentation is ready to draft.

INPUT:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions

OUTPUT:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTIC OUTPUTS:
    tmp_m2_archive_inventory_before
    tmp_m2_archive_inventory_after
    tmp_m2_archive_persistence_audit

WHY LATEST-RUN OUTPUT AND ARCHIVE PERSISTENCE ARE SEPARATE:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions is the current latest-run output.

    It is replaced each run.

    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive is the governed history layer.

    It supports:
        completed-run retention,
        rerun replacement control,
        strategy comparison,
        strategy frontier analysis,
        validation evidence review,
        and documentation traceability.

SECTION 12 DOES NOT RECALCULATE STRATEGY RESULTS:
    Section 12 does not recalculate:
        decision_outcome,
        decision_path,
        approved_amount,
        approved_payment_to_income_ratio,
        approved_expected_loss_amount,
        simulated reason codes,
        trigger flags,
        segmentation fields,
        counteroffer feasibility,
        or final outcome flags.

    It persists the already-materialized latest-run output.

CREDIT RISK GOVERNANCE CONCEPT — WHY ARCHIVING MATTERS:
    A credit strategy simulator needs durable history.

    The latest-run output tells reviewers what happened in the current run.
    The archive tells reviewers how completed runs compare over time.

    Without archive persistence, strategy review would rely on manually copied outputs or transient
    session tables, which weakens repeatability and validation traceability.

ARCHIVE GRAIN:
    One row per application
    × Module 1 scenario
    × Module 2 strategy version.

Archive row-level grain fields:
    strategy_set_name
    strategy_name
    strategy_version
    module1_scenario_set_name
    module1_scenario_name
    population_id
    application_id

ARCHIVE REPLACEMENT / RERUN KEY:
    strategy_set_name
    strategy_name
    strategy_version
    module1_scenario_set_name
    module1_scenario_name
    population_id

WHY APPLICATION_ID IS EXCLUDED FROM THE REPLACEMENT KEY:
    The replacement key identifies the completed strategy / scenario / population slice.

    application_id identifies each row within that slice.

    Deleting by replacement key clears the whole prior slice before inserting the current completed
    latest-run slice.

AUDIT METADATA BOUNDARY:
    strategy_run_id:
        run traceability metadata.

    strategy_run_ts:
        run timestamp metadata.

    latest_output_created_ts:
        latest-run table materialization metadata.

    archive_inserted_ts:
        archive persistence metadata.

    None of these timestamp or run-audit fields define archive replacement grain.
    None of them should define matched strategy comparison grain.

ARCHIVE CONTROL MODES:
    archive_run_flag = FALSE:
        Skip archive persistence.
        Do not delete archive rows.
        Do not insert archive rows.

    strategy_archive_reset_mode = NONE:
        Do not delete existing archive rows before insert.
        Fail if the current replacement key already exists.

    strategy_archive_reset_mode = STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY:
        Ordinary rerun mode.
        Replace only the current strategy / Module 1 scenario / population slice.

    strategy_archive_reset_mode = STRATEGY_SET_ONLY:
        Broader reset mode.
        Replace all strategy_name / strategy_version outputs within the current strategy_set_name
        for the selected Module 1 scenario and population.

    strategy_archive_reset_mode = ALL:
        Broadest reset mode.
        Delete all archive rows before inserting the current latest-run output.

SCHEMA ALIGNMENT NOTE:
    The archive table is created from the current latest-run output schema when it does not exist.

    If the latest-run schema changes after the archive already exists, the archive table may need to
    be altered or recreated so both schemas remain aligned.

    Section 12 includes practical schema alignment gatekeepers:
        missing-column checks,
        data-type alignment checks,
        unexpected archive column checks,
        and archive_inserted_ts existence checks.

    It does not attempt to build a full dynamic schema migration system.

WHY ARCHIVE VALIDATION INDEXES ARE CREATED BEFORE SECTION 12.6:
    Section 12.6 compares latest-run rows to archived rows at row-level archive grain.

    As the archive grows across strategy and scenario slices, row-level validation can become slow if
    the latest-run and archive tables lack supporting indexes.

    Section 12.5A therefore creates validation indexes before Section 12.6 performs persistence
    fidelity checks.

CAMPAIGN REGISTRY BOUNDARY:
    Campaign IDs such as module1_run_id, module2_run_id, showcase_id, comparison_group_id, and
    validation_evidence_group_id are evidence-linkage metadata.

    They are persisted later through Section 16 evidence capture.

    They do not replace archive grain and are not inserted into every archive row in Section 12.

MATCHED COMPARISON BOUNDARY:
    Section 12 persists archive rows.

    It does not compare archived strategies.

    Matched strategy comparison is built in Section 13.

SQL CONCEPTS TAUGHT IN THIS SECTION:
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ... LIKE:
        Creates the archive table from the latest-run table shape when the archive does not yet
        exist.

    ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS:
        Adds archive_inserted_ts without failing if the column already exists.

    information_schema.columns:
        Inspects table schemas so Section 12 can verify latest-run and archive column alignment.

    DO $$ ... END $$:
        Runs procedural validation and archive-control logic with variables, IF statements,
        dynamic SQL, and explicit exceptions.

    SELECT ... INTO:
        Loads counts, archive controls, replacement keys, and diagnostic values into PL/pgSQL
        variables.

    GET DIAGNOSTICS ... ROW_COUNT:
        Captures how many rows were deleted or inserted by the most recent DML statement.

    EXECUTE FORMAT(...):
        Runs a dynamic INSERT statement using an explicit column list derived from the latest-run
        schema.

    IS DISTINCT FROM:
        Provides NULL-safe comparisons when checking whether archived values match latest-run values.

    FULL OUTER JOIN:
        Compares before / after archive inventory even when a slice exists only before or only after
        persistence.

    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX:
        Enforces the row-level archive grain so matched comparison does not operate on duplicate
        archived applications.

GOVERNANCE ROLE:
    Section 12 protects history, replacement discipline, schema consistency, archive grain, and
    persistence fidelity before archive comparison or executive evidence capture occurs.

COMMON MISUSE TO AVOID:
    Do not use the latest-run table as strategy history.
    Do not manually delete archive rows outside governed archive controls.
    Do not treat timestamp fields as matched-comparison keys.
    Do not interpret archive persistence as recalculation or revalidation of decision logic.
    Do not interpret archive_inserted_ts as a business outcome.
    Do not treat archive_run_flag = TRUE as proof that validation passed.
    Do not treat archive persistence as a substitute for Section 14 QA.

***************************************************************************************************/



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 12.1 — LATEST-RUN SOURCE INTEGRITY AND ARCHIVE-CONTROL PREFLIGHT
****************************************************************************************************

PURPOSE:
    Confirm that the latest-run strategy_decisions table exists, is populated, is unique at
    application_id, and contains one unambiguous archive-control configuration and replacement key.

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Archive persistence should operate on one completed latest-run strategy slice.

    A mixed latest-run table would make archive reset behavior ambiguous and could corrupt archive
    history.

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Confirm credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions exists.
    2. Confirm latest-run output contains rows.
    3. Confirm application_id is unique in the latest-run output.
    4. Confirm archive_run_flag and strategy_archive_reset_mode are populated.
    5. Confirm strategy_archive_reset_mode uses an accepted mode.
    6. Confirm the latest-run output contains exactly one archive-control configuration.
    7. Confirm the latest-run output contains exactly one archive replacement / rerun key.

WHY THIS PREFLIGHT EXISTS:
    Archive operations can delete or insert persistent historical rows.

    Section 12 therefore must prove the current latest-run slice is unambiguous before any archive
    reset or insert logic executes.

SQL MECHANICS:
    TO_REGCLASS checks table existence.
    COUNT(*) checks latest-run row count.
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) checks row-level latest-run grain.
    COUNT(DISTINCT archive_run_flag) checks archive-control uniqueness.
    COUNT(DISTINCT strategy_archive_reset_mode) checks reset-mode uniqueness.
    SELECT DISTINCT replacement-key fields confirms a single archive slice.

BOUNDARY:
    Section 12.1 does not create archive rows.
    Section 12.1 does not delete archive rows.
    Section 12.1 does not modify latest-run rows.
    Section 12.1 only validates readiness for archive persistence.

****************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Latest-run row-grain diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_latest_count BIGINT;
    v_latest_distinct_app_count BIGINT;
    v_duplicate_application_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Archive-control diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_archive_control_null_count BIGINT;
    v_archive_control_invalid_count BIGINT;
    v_archive_flag_value_count BIGINT;
    v_archive_mode_value_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Archive replacement-key diagnostic.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_archive_key_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run output table must exist.

    SQL mechanics:
        TO_REGCLASS returns NULL if the table does not exist.

    Failure interpretation:
        Section 11 has not run successfully, or the latest-run output was dropped after Section 11.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions') IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions does not exist.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run output must contain rows.

    Business purpose:
        A zero-row latest-run table is not a completed strategy run suitable for archive persistence.

    SQL mechanics:
        COUNT(*) returns the number of latest-run rows.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_latest_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_latest_count = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: latest-run strategy_decisions table contains zero rows.';
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run application_id must be unique.

    Business purpose:
        Section 12 archive persistence assumes one latest-run row per application_id.

    Credit risk / comparison interpretation:
        Duplicate application_id values would duplicate archived decisions and distort matched
        baseline / challenger comparisons.

    SQL mechanics:
        Compare total rows to distinct application_id count.

        If they differ, the nested GROUP BY query counts how many application_id groups are
        duplicated.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
    INTO v_latest_distinct_app_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_latest_distinct_app_count <> v_latest_count THEN
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        INTO v_duplicate_application_count
        FROM (
            SELECT application_id
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
            GROUP BY application_id
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ) d;

        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: latest-run application_id is not unique. Latest rows: %, distinct application_id count: %, duplicate application_id group count: %.',
            v_latest_count,
            v_latest_distinct_app_count,
            v_duplicate_application_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: archive controls must be populated.

    Business purpose:
        Archive behavior should be explicit. NULL archive controls would make persistence ambiguous.

    Required controls:
        archive_run_flag
        strategy_archive_reset_mode
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_archive_control_null_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE archive_run_flag IS NULL
       OR strategy_archive_reset_mode IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(strategy_archive_reset_mode), '') IS NULL;

    IF v_archive_control_null_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: % latest-run row(s) have null archive controls.',
            v_archive_control_null_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: archive reset mode must be valid.

    Accepted modes:
        NONE
        STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY
        STRATEGY_SET_ONLY
        ALL

    Boundary:
        The mode controls archive persistence behavior only.

        It does not change decisions, exposure, or reason codes.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_archive_control_invalid_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    WHERE strategy_archive_reset_mode NOT IN (
        'NONE',
        'STRATEGY_SCENARIO_ONLY',
        'STRATEGY_SET_ONLY',
        'ALL'
    );

    IF v_archive_control_invalid_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: % latest-run row(s) have invalid strategy_archive_reset_mode values.',
            v_archive_control_invalid_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run table must contain exactly one archive_run_flag value.

    Business purpose:
        The latest-run table is one completed strategy run.

        It cannot simultaneously ask to both archive and not archive itself.

    SQL mechanics:
        COUNT(DISTINCT archive_run_flag) should equal 1.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT archive_run_flag)
    INTO v_archive_flag_value_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_archive_flag_value_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: latest-run output contains % distinct archive_run_flag values. Expected exactly one.',
            v_archive_flag_value_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run table must contain exactly one archive reset mode.

    Business purpose:
        A mixed reset-mode latest-run output would make delete scope ambiguous.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT strategy_archive_reset_mode)
    INTO v_archive_mode_value_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    IF v_archive_mode_value_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: latest-run output contains % distinct strategy_archive_reset_mode values. Expected exactly one.',
            v_archive_mode_value_count;
    END IF;


    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Gatekeeper: latest-run table must contain exactly one archive replacement / rerun key.

    Archive replacement / rerun key:
        strategy_set_name
        strategy_name
        strategy_version
        module1_scenario_set_name
        module1_scenario_name
        population_id

    Business interpretation:
        The latest-run output should represent one strategy / Module 1 scenario / population slice.

        If more than one replacement key is present, archive delete / insert behavior could affect
        the wrong history slice.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_archive_key_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    ) k;

    IF v_archive_key_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 12 failure: latest-run output contains % archive replacement keys. Expected exactly one.',
            v_archive_key_count;
    END IF;
END $$;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 12.2 — ARCHIVE TABLE SETUP AND SCHEMA ALIGNMENT CHECK
****************************************************************************************************

ARCHIVE TABLE DESIGN:
    all fields from credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    plus archive_inserted_ts.

archive_inserted_ts:
    Audit metadata indicating when the latest-run output was persisted to archive.

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Ensure the archive table exists and can faithfully hold the current latest-run output schema.

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Create the archive table from the latest-run output schema when needed.
    2. Add archive_inserted_ts if needed.
    3. Validate every latest-run column exists in the archive.
    4. Validate common latest-run / archive column data types align.
    5. Validate the archive does not contain unexpected non-latest-run columns.
    6. Validate archive_inserted_ts exists.

WHY SCHEMA ALIGNMENT MATTERS:
    Archive rows should be a faithful persisted copy of the governed latest-run output.

    If the latest-run schema and archive schema diverge, matched comparison, frontier analysis,
    QA review, and evidence capture can become unreliable.

SQL MECHANICS:
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ... LIKE:
        Creates the archive table from the latest-run table when the archive does not exist.

    ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS:
        Adds archive_inserted_ts in a rerunnable way.

    information_schema.columns:
        Lets the code inspect table columns, data types, numeric precision, numeric scale, character
        length, and timestamp precision.

    STRING_AGG:
        Converts any schema defects into readable exception text.

BOUNDARY:
    Section 12.2 may create or alter the archive table structure.

    It does not insert archive rows.
