        Performs NULL-safe equality testing for registry alignment.

    UNION ALL:
        Combines registry-alignment checks across multiple evidence tables into one compact count.

READ-ONLY / PERSISTENCE BOUNDARY:
    Section 16.7 does not insert evidence rows.
    Section 16.7 does not delete evidence rows.
    Section 16.7 does not update evidence rows.
    Section 16.7 does not modify credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions.
    Section 16.7 does not modify credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive.
    Section 16.7 does not modify campaign registry rows.
    Section 16.7 does not recalculate decisions.
    Section 16.7 does not recalculate approved exposure.
    Section 16.7 does not recalculate approved Expected Loss.
    Section 16.7 does not reassign simulated reason codes.
    Section 16.7 does not implement Module 3 economics.

***************************************************************************************************/

DO $$
DECLARE
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Current run key record.

    Section 16.0 already validated that tmp_m2_current_run_key contains exactly one row.

    Section 16.7 reads that one row and uses it to scope every evidence-count check below.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    k RECORD;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Current run story / registry record.

    Section 16.0 already validated that tmp_m2_current_run_story_params contains exactly one active
    row.

    Section 16.7 uses this record as the expected registry-linkage source for persistent evidence
    rows.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    s RECORD;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Evidence row-count diagnostics.

    These counts confirm that each persistent evidence table contains the expected current-run
    records after Sections 16.3 through 16.6 executed.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_summary_count BIGINT;
    v_validation_count BIGINT;
    v_expected_validation_count BIGINT;
    v_parameter_snapshot_count BIGINT;
    v_segment_count BIGINT;
    v_expected_segment_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Evidence completeness diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_null_required_summary_count BIGINT;
    v_validation_registry_gap_count BIGINT;
    v_parameter_registry_gap_count BIGINT;
    v_segment_registry_gap_count BIGINT;
    v_parameter_payload_gap_count BIGINT;
    v_registry_alignment_violation_count BIGINT;

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Module 3 readiness diagnostic.

    This count is intentionally not used as a failure condition because Module 3 is future scope.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    v_module3_gap_count BIGINT;

BEGIN
    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7A Load current run key.

    Purpose:
        Scope all local evidence gatekeepers to the current latest-run strategy / Module 1 scenario /
        population slice.

    Assumption:
        Section 16.0 already enforced exactly one row in tmp_m2_current_run_key.

    Failure behavior:
        If no current key exists, subsequent counts will not find expected evidence rows and will
        raise clear exceptions.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT *
    INTO k
    FROM tmp_m2_current_run_key
    LIMIT 1;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7B Load current run registry / story metadata.

    Purpose:
        Establish the expected campaign registry fields that should now appear in all persistent
        evidence rows.

    Assumption:
        Section 16.0 already enforced exactly one active story row.

    Registry interpretation:
        RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED means the row was tied to the formal campaign registry.

        Fallback statuses may appear only when campaign_registry_required_flag is FALSE.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT *
    INTO s
    FROM tmp_m2_current_run_story_params
    WHERE active_story_flag IS TRUE
    LIMIT 1;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7C Executive evidence summary row-count gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        exactly one row in credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary for the current run
        key.

    Why exactly one:
        The executive evidence summary is one-row-per-run-key evidence.

        Multiple rows would create duplicate or conflicting executive stories.
        Zero rows would mean Section 16.6 did not persist the run-level evidence.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_summary_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id;

    IF v_summary_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: expected exactly one executive evidence summary row for current run, found %.',
            v_summary_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7D Validation evidence detail row-count gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        persistent validation evidence count should equal tmp_m2_validation_status_summary count.

    Why exact count matters:
        Section 16.3 should persist every Section 14 validation status row.

        A mismatch means the Validation Summary evidence spine is incomplete or overpopulated.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_validation_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_validation_evidence e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id;

    IF v_validation_count <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: no validation evidence rows were captured for current run.';
    END IF;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_expected_validation_count
    FROM tmp_m2_validation_status_summary;

    IF v_expected_validation_count <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: tmp_m2_validation_status_summary contains zero rows.';
    END IF;

    IF v_validation_count <> v_expected_validation_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: validation evidence row count (%) does not match Section 14 validation summary row count (%).',
            v_validation_count,
            v_expected_validation_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7E Parameter snapshot row-count gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        exactly one row in credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot for the current run
        key.

    Why exactly one:
        Each current run key should have one snapshot of:
            active strategy parameters,
            product policy parameters,
            and run-story metadata.

    Failure meaning:
        Zero rows means parameter evidence is missing.
        More than one row means the evidence layer contains duplicate parameter snapshots for the
        same run key.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_parameter_snapshot_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id;

    IF v_parameter_snapshot_count <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: expected exactly one parameter snapshot row for current run, found %.',
            v_parameter_snapshot_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7F Segment evidence row-count gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        Persistent segment evidence row count should equal the number of distinct product × score
        combinations in the current latest-run output.

    Why this matters:
        Section 16.5 is the product × score companion evidence layer.

        If it misses a segment, executive driver fields may not be supported by complete drill-down
        evidence.

        If it overpopulates segments, the evidence layer may be mixing current-run and stale segment
        rows.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_segment_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_segment_evidence_summary e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id;

    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_expected_segment_count
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            product_type_policy_key,
            score_band_policy_key
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    ) d;

    IF v_segment_count <> v_expected_segment_count THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: segment evidence row count (%) does not match expected product × score segment count (%).',
            v_segment_count,
            v_expected_segment_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7G Executive evidence required-field completeness gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        Required executive evidence fields should be populated.

    Required field families:
        evidence capture metadata,
        registry linkage,
        strategy identity,
        Module 1 lineage,
        application count,
        decision rates,
        simulated offer-exposure rate,
        approved amount,
        approved Expected Loss,
        top primary simulated reason code,
        validation status counts,
        and Module 3 boundary fields.

    Registry patch:
        module1_run_id, module2_run_id, and run_registry_match_status are required because the
        executive evidence row should always identify how it links back to the campaign roadmap.

        When campaign_registry_required_flag = TRUE, run_registry_match_status must already be
        RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED due to Section 16.0.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_null_required_summary_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND (
             e.evidence_snapshot_ts IS NULL

          OR e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS NULL
          OR e.registry_match_count IS NULL
          OR e.run_registry_match_status IS NULL
          OR e.module1_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.module2_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.showcase_name IS NULL

          OR (
                e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS TRUE
            AND (
                    e.run_registry_match_status <> 'RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED'
                 OR e.run_sequence_number IS NULL
                 OR e.showcase_id IS NULL
                 OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS NULL
                )
             )

          OR e.strategy_set_name IS NULL
          OR e.strategy_name IS NULL
          OR e.strategy_version IS NULL
          OR e.module1_scenario_set_name IS NULL
          OR e.module1_scenario_name IS NULL
          OR e.population_id IS NULL

          OR e.applications IS NULL
          OR e.approval_rate IS NULL
          OR e.counteroffer_rate IS NULL
          OR e.manual_review_rate IS NULL
          OR e.decline_rate IS NULL
          OR e.simulated_offer_exposure_rate IS NULL

          OR e.total_approved_amount IS NULL
          OR e.total_approved_expected_loss_amount IS NULL
          OR e.top_primary_reason_code IS NULL

          OR e.validation_pass_count IS NULL
          OR e.validation_review_count IS NULL
          OR e.validation_not_applicable_count IS NULL
          OR e.validation_status_summary_jsonb IS NULL

          OR e.module3_revenue_model_required_flag IS NULL
          OR e.module3_boundary_note IS NULL
      );

    IF v_null_required_summary_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: executive evidence summary has null or invalid required evidence fields.';
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7H Registry-linkage completeness gatekeeper for validation evidence.

    Expected:
        Every persisted validation evidence row for the current run should carry the run ID and
        registry match status fields.

    Why this matters:
        Validation Summary artifacts should be traceable to individual validation evidence rows using
        module2_run_id and validation_evidence_group_id.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_validation_registry_gap_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_validation_evidence e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND (
             e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS NULL
          OR e.registry_match_count IS NULL
          OR e.run_registry_match_status IS NULL
          OR e.module1_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.module2_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.showcase_name IS NULL
          OR (
                e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS TRUE
            AND (
                    e.run_registry_match_status <> 'RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED'
                 OR e.run_sequence_number IS NULL
                 OR e.showcase_id IS NULL
                 OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS NULL
                )
             )
      );

    IF v_validation_registry_gap_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: % validation evidence row(s) are missing required registry-linkage fields.',
            v_validation_registry_gap_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7I Registry-linkage completeness gatekeeper for parameter snapshot.

    Expected:
        The parameter snapshot row should carry the same registry linkage used by the executive
        evidence row.

    Why this matters:
        Parameter evidence should be traceable to the same run ID and validation evidence group as
        the executive evidence and validation detail rows.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_parameter_registry_gap_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND (
             e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS NULL
          OR e.registry_match_count IS NULL
          OR e.run_registry_match_status IS NULL
          OR e.module1_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.module2_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.showcase_name IS NULL
          OR (
                e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS TRUE
            AND (
                    e.run_registry_match_status <> 'RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED'
                 OR e.run_sequence_number IS NULL
                 OR e.showcase_id IS NULL
                 OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS NULL
                )
             )
      );

    IF v_parameter_registry_gap_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: parameter snapshot row is missing required registry-linkage fields.';
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7J Registry-linkage completeness gatekeeper for product × score segment evidence.

    Expected:
        Every product × score segment evidence row should carry the same registry linkage used by the
        executive evidence row.

    Why this matters:
        Segment evidence should be directly usable in the Validation Summary or README without
        manual reconstruction of run IDs.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_segment_registry_gap_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_segment_evidence_summary e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND (
             e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS NULL
          OR e.registry_match_count IS NULL
          OR e.run_registry_match_status IS NULL
          OR e.module1_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.module2_run_id IS NULL
          OR e.showcase_name IS NULL
          OR (
                e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS TRUE
            AND (
                    e.run_registry_match_status <> 'RUN_REGISTRY_MATCHED'
                 OR e.run_sequence_number IS NULL
                 OR e.showcase_id IS NULL
                 OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS NULL
                )
             )
      );

    IF v_segment_registry_gap_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: % product × score segment evidence row(s) are missing required registry-linkage fields.',
            v_segment_registry_gap_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7K Parameter snapshot payload gatekeeper.

    Expected:
        strategy_params_jsonb, product_policy_params_jsonb, run_story_params_jsonb, and
        parameter_snapshot_hash should all be populated.

    Why this matters:
        The parameter snapshot is the evidence trail from observed strategy outcomes back to active
        strategy parameters, product-policy settings, and registry / story metadata.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_parameter_payload_gap_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND (
             e.strategy_params_jsonb IS NULL
          OR e.product_policy_params_jsonb IS NULL
          OR e.run_story_params_jsonb IS NULL
          OR e.parameter_snapshot_hash IS NULL
      );

    IF v_parameter_payload_gap_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: parameter snapshot is missing strategy, product-policy, story JSONB payload, or parameter hash.';
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7L Registry alignment gatekeeper across all evidence tables.

    Expected:
        Persistent evidence rows should align to the active current-run story metadata.

    Why this matters:
        Populated registry fields are not enough.

        They must also match the active current-run story metadata, or the evidence layer could
        connect a strategy result to the wrong roadmap / comparison / validation group.

    SQL mechanics:
        IS DISTINCT FROM performs NULL-safe comparison.

        UNION ALL stacks alignment violations across:
            executive evidence,
            validation evidence,
            parameter snapshot,
            segment evidence.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_registry_alignment_violation_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 'EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY' AS evidence_table_name
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary e
        WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
          AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
          AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
          AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
          AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
          AND e.population_id = k.population_id
          AND (
                 e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS DISTINCT FROM s.campaign_registry_required_flag
              OR e.registry_match_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.registry_match_count
              OR e.run_registry_match_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_registry_match_status
              OR e.module1_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module1_run_id
              OR e.module2_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module2_run_id
              OR e.run_sequence_number IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_sequence_number
              OR e.showcase_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_id
              OR e.showcase_name IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_name
              OR e.comparison_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.comparison_group_id
              OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_evidence_group_id
              OR e.readme_storyline_label IS DISTINCT FROM s.readme_storyline_label
              OR e.linkedin_post_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM s.linkedin_post_sequence
              OR e.validation_summary_section_hint IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_summary_section_hint
          )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'VALIDATION_EVIDENCE' AS evidence_table_name
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_validation_evidence e
        WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
          AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
          AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
          AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
          AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
          AND e.population_id = k.population_id
          AND (
                 e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS DISTINCT FROM s.campaign_registry_required_flag
              OR e.registry_match_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.registry_match_count
              OR e.run_registry_match_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_registry_match_status
              OR e.module1_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module1_run_id
              OR e.module2_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module2_run_id
              OR e.run_sequence_number IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_sequence_number
              OR e.showcase_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_id
              OR e.showcase_name IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_name
              OR e.comparison_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.comparison_group_id
              OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_evidence_group_id
              OR e.readme_storyline_label IS DISTINCT FROM s.readme_storyline_label
              OR e.linkedin_post_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM s.linkedin_post_sequence
              OR e.validation_summary_section_hint IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_summary_section_hint
          )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'PARAMETER_SNAPSHOT' AS evidence_table_name
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_parameter_snapshot e
        WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
          AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
          AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
          AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
          AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
          AND e.population_id = k.population_id
          AND (
                 e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS DISTINCT FROM s.campaign_registry_required_flag
              OR e.registry_match_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.registry_match_count
              OR e.run_registry_match_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_registry_match_status
              OR e.module1_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module1_run_id
              OR e.module2_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module2_run_id
              OR e.run_sequence_number IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_sequence_number
              OR e.showcase_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_id
              OR e.showcase_name IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_name
              OR e.comparison_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.comparison_group_id
              OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_evidence_group_id
              OR e.readme_storyline_label IS DISTINCT FROM s.readme_storyline_label
              OR e.linkedin_post_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM s.linkedin_post_sequence
              OR e.validation_summary_section_hint IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_summary_section_hint
          )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT 'SEGMENT_EVIDENCE' AS evidence_table_name
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_segment_evidence_summary e
        WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
          AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
          AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
          AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
          AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
          AND e.population_id = k.population_id
          AND (
                 e.campaign_registry_required_flag IS DISTINCT FROM s.campaign_registry_required_flag
              OR e.registry_match_count IS DISTINCT FROM s.registry_match_count
              OR e.run_registry_match_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_registry_match_status
              OR e.module1_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module1_run_id
              OR e.module2_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.module2_run_id
              OR e.run_sequence_number IS DISTINCT FROM s.run_sequence_number
              OR e.showcase_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_id
              OR e.showcase_name IS DISTINCT FROM s.showcase_name
              OR e.comparison_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.comparison_group_id
              OR e.validation_evidence_group_id IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_evidence_group_id
              OR e.readme_storyline_label IS DISTINCT FROM s.readme_storyline_label
              OR e.linkedin_post_sequence IS DISTINCT FROM s.linkedin_post_sequence
              OR e.validation_summary_section_hint IS DISTINCT FROM s.validation_summary_section_hint
          )
    ) alignment_violations;

    IF v_registry_alignment_violation_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Module 2 Section 16 failure: % evidence row(s) have registry-linkage values that do not align to tmp_m2_current_run_story_params.',
            v_registry_alignment_violation_count;
    END IF;



    /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16.7M Module 3 readiness gap diagnostic.

    Purpose:
        Count whether the executive evidence row indicates that Module 3 growth / economics inputs
        are not fully available.

    Important:
        This is intentionally NOT a failure condition.

    Why not fail:
        Module 3 economics is future scope.

        Section 16 is responsible for preserving readiness evidence and gap notes, not for forcing all
        future economics inputs to be complete today.
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO v_module3_gap_count
    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary e
    WHERE e.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
      AND e.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
      AND e.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
      AND e.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
      AND e.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
      AND e.population_id = k.population_id
      AND e.module3_growth_inputs_available_flag IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE;

    /*
    A Module 3 readiness gap does not fail Section 16 because Module 3 is future scope.

    The evidence row stores:

/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 16.6 — CAPTURE CURRENT RUN EXECUTIVE EVIDENCE SUMMARY
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Insert the one-row executive evidence summary for the current completed Module 2 strategy run.

    Section 16.6 answers:

        "What is the compact executive story of this completed run, including campaign run IDs,
         outcome distribution, simulated offer exposure, approved exposure, approved Expected Loss,
         reason-code story, validation status, segment drivers, frontier posture, and Module 3
         readiness?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Read the current run key from tmp_m2_current_run_key.
    2. Read current registry / story labels from tmp_m2_current_run_story_params.
    3. Read the current archive timestamp for the matching archived slice.
    4. Calculate portfolio-level outcome, exposure, affordability, APR proxy, term, synthetic-risk,
       LGD, and Expected Loss metrics directly from credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions.
    5. Calculate product-level, score-band-level, and product × score driver fields.
    6. Calculate top simulated reason-code story fields.
    7. Summarize Section 14 validation statuses.
    8. Join Section 15 frontier posture fields for the current run.
    9. Calculate baseline-relative segment-delta driver fields where a baseline exists.
    10. Calculate Module 3 readiness flags and gap notes.
    11. Insert exactly one executive evidence row into:
            credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary

REGISTRY PATCH:
    Section 16.6 persists formal campaign registry fields in the one-row executive evidence summary:

        campaign_registry_required_flag
        registry_match_count
        run_registry_match_status
        module1_run_id
        module2_run_id
        run_sequence_number
        showcase_id
        showcase_name
        comparison_group_id
        validation_evidence_group_id
        readme_storyline_label
        linkedin_post_sequence
        validation_summary_section_hint

    These fields make the executive evidence row directly linkable to:
        the run roadmap,
        comparison registry,
        future Validation Summary,
        GitHub README,
        LinkedIn campaign sequence,
        parameter snapshot,
        validation evidence detail,
        and product × score segment evidence.

INPUTS:
    tmp_m2_current_run_key
    tmp_m2_current_run_story_params
    tmp_m2_validation_status_summary
    tmp_m2_strategy_frontier_executive_summary
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

OUTPUT:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary

TARGET GRAIN:
    One row per current run key:

        strategy_set_name
        strategy_name
        strategy_version
        module1_scenario_set_name
        module1_scenario_name
        population_id

WHY THIS SECTION IS PERSISTENT:
    Section 14 validation outputs and Section 15 frontier outputs are temporary session objects.

    The latest-run table is replaceable.

    Section 16.6 creates a durable executive evidence row so each completed strategy run can be
    reviewed later without rerunning all diagnostic grids.

WHY MOST METRICS ARE CALCULATED FROM THE LATEST-RUN TABLE:
    Section 16.6 captures the current completed run.

    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions is the current latest-run output and contains the
    final applicant-level strategy result.

    Calculating portfolio and driver metrics directly from this table ensures that the executive
    evidence row reflects the current latest-run output being captured.

WHY FRONTIER FIELDS COME FROM SECTION 15:
    Section 15 already calculates archive-backed frontier posture, executive quadrant, and
    baseline-relative reason-code movement.

    Section 16.6 carries those fields into persistent evidence rather than recalculating the frontier.

WHY VALIDATION FIELDS COME FROM SECTION 14:
    Section 14 already materializes tmp_m2_validation_status_summary.

        validation status counts,
        review-item text,
        and JSONB validation evidence.

    This lets the one-row executive evidence record remain compact while preserving detailed
    validation evidence in both:
        credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_validation_evidence
        and validation_status_summary_jsonb.

WHY SEGMENT DRIVER FIELDS ARE CALCULATED HERE:
    The one-row executive evidence summary needs concise driver labels, not full segment tables.

    Section 16.5 stores the full product × score companion table.

    Section 16.6 stores the most important driver labels, such as:
        top approved amount product,
        top approved Expected Loss product,
        top counteroffer product,
        top decline product,
        highest offer-rate score band,
        and largest baseline-relative delta segments.

CREDIT RISK INTERPRETATION:
    This executive evidence row ties together the main strategy questions:

        Access:
            How much simulated positive offer exposure did the strategy produce?

        Exposure:
            How much requested exposure survived into simulated approved exposure?

        Risk:
            What synthetic estimated-risk proxy, LGD, requested Expected Loss, and approved Expected
            Loss profile did the strategy produce?

        Affordability:
            How did requested PTI and approved PTI behave?

        Treatment:
            How much of the population was approved, counteroffered, manually reviewed, or declined?

        Explainability:
            Which simulated reason codes explain the final strategy outcomes?

        Validation:
            Which QA checks passed, required review, or were not applicable?

        Future economics:
            Are APR proxy, term, product mix, approved exposure, and approved Expected Loss fields
            available for future Module 3 design?

WHAT TO LOOK FOR AFTER THIS SECTION:
    credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_run_evidence_summary should contain exactly one row for the
    current run key.

    The row should include:
        registry IDs,
        strategy identity,
        Module 1 scenario lineage,
        final outcome counts and rates,
        exposure metrics,
        approved Expected Loss metrics,
        reason-code story fields,
        validation rollup,
        segment drivers,
        frontier posture,
        and Module 3 readiness indicators.

REVIEW TRIGGERS:
    Missing executive evidence row:
        Section 16.6 did not complete or one of the one-row CTEs returned zero rows.

    Missing frontier_position_type:
        Section 15 frontier row did not match the current run key.

    Missing validation counts:
        Section 14 validation summary was not available or did not populate.

    Missing module2_run_id on a formal campaign run:
        registry linkage should be reviewed before documentation.

    Unexpectedly high approved_expected_loss_rate:
        review product mix, score mix, LGD, approved amount, and reason-code evidence.

    High counteroffer_share_of_offers:
        review whether the strategy depends heavily on reduced-exposure treatment.

    High manual_review_rate:
        review unresolved outcome burden and failed-counteroffer resolution behavior.

MODULE 3 READINESS:
    Section 16.6 captures whether key future economics inputs exist.

    It does not calculate:
        revenue,
        yield,
        funding cost,
        fee income,
        utilization,
        profitability,
        capital,
        pricing optimization,
        risk-adjusted margin,
        lifetime value,
        or net income.

INTERPRETATION BOUNDARIES:
    approved_expected_loss_rate is a synthetic strategy evidence metric.

    It is not a production loss-rate forecast.

    approved_amount is simulated approved exposure.

    It is not booked exposure, funded exposure, account creation, or production approval.

    simulated_offer_exposure_flag means the simulated strategy produced positive offer exposure

    It does not imply real customer treatment.

    Reason codes are simulated strategy explanation codes only.

SQL CONCEPTS TAUGHT IN THIS SECTION:
    CTE chain:
        Breaks a complex executive evidence insert into named, interpretable layers.

    CROSS JOIN:
        Combines one-row CTEs into one executive evidence row.

    LEFT JOIN:
        Keeps the evidence insert structurally tolerant if a frontier row is unexpectedly absent.

    COUNT(*) FILTER:
        Calculates outcome-specific counts and rates.

    COALESCE:
        Converts no-offer / unresolved approved metrics to zero for all-application impact measures.

    NULLIF:
        Prevents divide-by-zero in rates and ratios.

    jsonb_object_agg:
        Preserves compact product-level driver evidence inside one executive evidence row.

    STRING_AGG:
        Creates a readable validation-review summary.

    jsonb_agg:
        Preserves validation status details as structured evidence.

READ-ONLY / PERSISTENCE BOUNDARY:

    It does not modify campaign registry rows.
    It does not recalculate decisions.
    It does not recalculate approved exposure.
    It does not recalculate approved Expected Loss.
    It does not reassign simulated reason codes.
    It does not modify strategy or product-policy parameters.
    It does not implement Module 3 economics.

***************************************************************************************************/

    CTE: story

    Purpose:

    SQL mechanics:
        WHERE active_story_flag IS TRUE ensures only the governed active story row is used.

        LIMIT 1 is safe because Section 16.0 validates that exactly one active story row exists.

    Boundary:
        Story labels do not change decision outcomes, strategy logic, approved exposure, approved

    ***********************************************************************************************/

    WHERE active_story_flag IS TRUE

archive_ts AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    CTE: archive_ts

    Purpose:
        Retrieve the most recent archive_inserted_ts for the current archived slice.

    SQL mechanics:
        The archive is applicant-grain, so the current run key is used to isolate the matching slice.

        MAX(archive_inserted_ts) gives one audit timestamp for the slice.

    Interpretation:
        archive_inserted_ts is traceability metadata.

        It is not:
            a strategy metric,
            a comparison grain,
            a business outcome,
            or a run-performance measure.

    Review trigger:
        If archive_inserted_ts is NULL for a formal archived run, review Section 12 archive
        persistence and Section 14 archive-readiness diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
