    primary_metric_focus,

    registry_created_ts,
    registry_updated_ts

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.1 — ARCHIVE INVENTORY
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Show what archived Module 2 strategy slices are available before matched comparison is
    interpreted.

    Section 13.1 answers:

        "What completed strategy / scenario / population slices exist in the archive?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Summarize archived strategy slices.
    2. Display archived decision-outcome distribution by slice.
    3. Check archive row-level grain duplicate groups.

BOUNDARY:
    Archive inventory is read-only.

    It does not select the comparison.
    It does not mutate archive rows.
    It does not validate the latest-run output.

****************************************************************************************************/



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.1A Archive inventory by strategy / Module 1 scenario / population.

Expected:
    One row per archived strategy / scenario / population slice.

Interpretation:
    Use this output to confirm the selected baseline and challenger slices are present.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,

    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,

    COUNT(*) AS archived_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS distinct_application_id_count,

    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
        AS duplicate_application_row_count,

    MIN(strategy_run_id) AS min_strategy_run_id,
    MAX(strategy_run_id) AS max_strategy_run_id,

    MIN(strategy_run_ts) AS min_strategy_run_ts,
    MAX(strategy_run_ts) AS max_strategy_run_ts,

    MIN(archive_inserted_ts) AS first_archive_inserted_ts,
    MAX(archive_inserted_ts) AS last_archive_inserted_ts

FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

GROUP BY
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id

ORDER BY
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.1B Archived decision-outcome inventory by slice.

Purpose:
    Show the final outcome mix for every archived slice.

Interpretation:
    This is inventory, not matched comparison.

    The same decision_outcome distribution can mean different things depending on product, score,
    requested exposure, affordability, and reason-code mix.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,

    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,

    decision_outcome,

    COUNT(*) AS archived_rows,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(
            SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    strategy_set_name,
                    strategy_name,
                    strategy_version,
                    module1_scenario_set_name,
                    module1_scenario_name,
                    population_id
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS pct_within_archived_slice

FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

GROUP BY
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    decision_outcome

ORDER BY
    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,
    strategy_set_name,
    strategy_name,
    strategy_version,
    CASE decision_outcome
        WHEN 'APPROVE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'COUNTEROFFER' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW' THEN 3
        WHEN 'DECLINE' THEN 4
        ELSE 99
    END;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.1C Archive row-level grain duplicate diagnostic.

Purpose:
    Confirm the archive is unique at:
        strategy_set_name
        strategy_name
        strategy_version
        module1_scenario_set_name
        module1_scenario_name
        population_id
        application_id

Expected:
    duplicate_archive_grain_count = 0.

Interpretation:
    Duplicate archive grain can corrupt matched comparison and frontier analysis.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_archive_grain_count

FROM (
    SELECT
        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version,
        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id,
        application_id,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count

    FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive

    GROUP BY
        strategy_set_name,
        strategy_name,
        strategy_version,
        module1_scenario_set_name,
        module1_scenario_name,
        population_id,
        application_id

    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) d;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.2 — SELECTED COMPARISON READINESS
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Evaluate whether the selected baseline / challenger comparison is ready for matched comparison.

    Section 13.2 answers:

        "Do the selected baseline and challenger archived slices exist, have clean application grain,
         and fully overlap by application_id?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Count archived baseline rows.
    2. Count archived challenger rows.
    3. Count distinct application_id values for each side.
    4. Count duplicate application_id rows within each side.
    5. Count matched, baseline-only, and challenger-only application_id values.
    6. Assign readiness_status.
    7. Persist the readiness result into tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_readiness.

IMPORTANT:
    Section 13.2 does not fail solely because selected archive slices are not ready.

    It records readiness status so inventory can still be reviewed and Section 14 can surface
    NOT_APPLICABLE comparison status where appropriate.

***************************************************************************************************/

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_readiness
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
AS
WITH params AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    One-row active comparison selector from Section 13.0.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params
    LIMIT 1
),

baseline_slice AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Baseline archived slice selected by baseline strategy identity and Module 1 lineage.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        b.application_id
    FROM params p

    LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive b
        ON b.strategy_set_name = p.baseline_strategy_set_name
       AND b.strategy_name = p.baseline_strategy_name
       AND b.strategy_version = p.baseline_strategy_version
       AND b.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND b.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
       AND b.population_id = p.population_id
),

challenger_slice AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Challenger archived slice selected by challenger strategy identity and the same Module 1 lineage.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        c.application_id
    FROM params p

    LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive c
        ON c.strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
       AND c.strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
       AND c.strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
       AND c.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND c.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
       AND c.population_id = p.population_id
),

baseline_counts AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Baseline row and grain diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        COUNT(application_id) AS baseline_archived_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS baseline_distinct_application_id_count,
        COUNT(application_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
            AS baseline_duplicate_application_row_count
    FROM baseline_slice
),

challenger_counts AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Challenger row and grain diagnostics.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        COUNT(application_id) AS challenger_archived_row_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS challenger_distinct_application_id_count,
        COUNT(application_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT application_id)
            AS challenger_duplicate_application_row_count
    FROM challenger_slice
),

application_overlap AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Application-level overlap diagnostics.

    SQL mechanics:
        FULL OUTER JOIN keeps application IDs that appear on either side.

    Business interpretation:
        Complete overlap is required for clean matched comparison.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE b.application_id IS NOT NULL
              AND c.application_id IS NOT NULL
        ) AS matched_application_id_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE b.application_id IS NOT NULL
              AND c.application_id IS NULL
        ) AS baseline_only_application_id_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE b.application_id IS NULL
              AND c.application_id IS NOT NULL
        ) AS challenger_only_application_id_count

    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT application_id
        FROM baseline_slice
        WHERE application_id IS NOT NULL
    ) b

    FULL OUTER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT application_id
        FROM challenger_slice
        WHERE application_id IS NOT NULL
    ) c
        ON c.application_id = b.application_id
)

SELECT
    p.comparison_group_id,
    p.comparison_set_name,

    p.showcase_id,
    p.showcase_name,

    p.baseline_module2_run_id,
    p.challenger_module2_run_id,

    p.module1_scenario_set_name,
    p.module1_scenario_name,
    p.population_id,

    p.baseline_strategy_set_name,
    p.baseline_strategy_name,
    p.baseline_strategy_version,

    p.challenger_strategy_set_name,
    p.challenger_strategy_name,
    p.challenger_strategy_version,

    (
        p.baseline_strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
        AND p.baseline_strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
        AND p.baseline_strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
    ) AS same_strategy_selected_flag,

    bc.baseline_archived_row_count,
    cc.challenger_archived_row_count,

    bc.baseline_distinct_application_id_count,
    cc.challenger_distinct_application_id_count,

    bc.baseline_duplicate_application_row_count,
    cc.challenger_duplicate_application_row_count,

    ao.matched_application_id_count,
    ao.baseline_only_application_id_count,
    ao.challenger_only_application_id_count,

    CASE
        WHEN (
            p.baseline_strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
            AND p.baseline_strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
            AND p.baseline_strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
        )
            THEN 'NOT_READY_SAME_STRATEGY_SELECTED'

        WHEN bc.baseline_archived_row_count = 0
         AND cc.challenger_archived_row_count = 0
            THEN 'NOT_READY_BASELINE_AND_CHALLENGER_ARCHIVE_MISSING'

        WHEN bc.baseline_archived_row_count = 0
            THEN 'NOT_READY_BASELINE_ARCHIVE_MISSING'

        WHEN cc.challenger_archived_row_count = 0
            THEN 'NOT_READY_CHALLENGER_ARCHIVE_MISSING'

        WHEN bc.baseline_duplicate_application_row_count > 0
          OR cc.challenger_duplicate_application_row_count > 0
            THEN 'NOT_READY_DUPLICATE_APPLICATION_ID_IN_ARCHIVE_SLICE'

        WHEN bc.baseline_archived_row_count <> bc.baseline_distinct_application_id_count
          OR cc.challenger_archived_row_count <> cc.challenger_distinct_application_id_count
            THEN 'NOT_READY_ARCHIVE_SLICE_NOT_UNIQUE_AT_APPLICATION_ID'

        WHEN bc.baseline_distinct_application_id_count <> cc.challenger_distinct_application_id_count
            THEN 'NOT_READY_BASELINE_CHALLENGER_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH'

        WHEN ao.matched_application_id_count <> bc.baseline_distinct_application_id_count
          OR ao.matched_application_id_count <> cc.challenger_distinct_application_id_count
          OR ao.baseline_only_application_id_count > 0
          OR ao.challenger_only_application_id_count > 0
            THEN 'NOT_READY_INCOMPLETE_APPLICATION_ID_OVERLAP'

        ELSE 'READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'
    END AS readiness_status,

    p.expected_comparison_storyline,
    p.primary_metric_focus

FROM params p
CROSS JOIN baseline_counts bc
CROSS JOIN challenger_counts cc
CROSS JOIN application_overlap ao;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.2A Selected comparison readiness output.

Expected:
    readiness_status = READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON
    before interpreting matched baseline / challenger deltas.

Boundary:
    This query does not mutate archive rows.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    comparison_group_id,
    comparison_set_name,

    showcase_id,
    showcase_name,

    baseline_module2_run_id,
    challenger_module2_run_id,

    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,

    baseline_strategy_set_name,
    baseline_strategy_name,
    baseline_strategy_version,

    challenger_strategy_set_name,
    challenger_strategy_name,
    challenger_strategy_version,

    same_strategy_selected_flag,

    baseline_archived_row_count,
    challenger_archived_row_count,

    baseline_distinct_application_id_count,
    challenger_distinct_application_id_count,

    baseline_duplicate_application_row_count,

    matched_application_id_count,

    challenger_only_application_id_count,

    readiness_status,

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_readiness;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.3 — MATCHED BASELINE / CHALLENGER APPLICANT TABLE
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Materialize row-level matched baseline / challenger comparison evidence.

    Section 13.3 answers:

        "For each synthetic applicant that exists in both archived slices, what changed between the
         baseline and challenger strategy?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Join baseline and challenger archived rows by application_id.
    2. Preserve selected comparison metadata.
    3. Preserve immutable Module 1 source fields for consistency checks.
    4. Preserve final outcomes, final exposure, approved affordability, approved Expected Loss, and
       reason-code fields for comparison diagnostics.
    5. Create diagnostic deltas and migration labels used by downstream Section 13 outputs.

IMPORTANT:
    This table may be empty when readiness_status is not READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON.

    That is intentional.

    Readiness is interpreted through tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_readiness.

***************************************************************************************************/

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
AS
WITH params AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_params
    LIMIT 1
),

matched_rows AS (
    SELECT
        /*******************************************************************************************
        Comparison registry metadata.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        p.comparison_group_id,
        p.comparison_set_name,
        p.showcase_id,
        p.showcase_name,

        p.baseline_module2_run_id,
        p.challenger_module2_run_id,

        p.expected_comparison_storyline,
        p.primary_metric_focus,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Matched application key.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        b.application_id,
        b.applicant_id AS baseline_applicant_id,
        c.applicant_id AS challenger_applicant_id,

        /*******************************************************************************************
        Module 1 lineage selected for the comparison.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        p.module1_scenario_set_name AS comparison_module1_scenario_set_name,
        p.module1_scenario_name AS comparison_module1_scenario_name,
        p.population_id AS comparison_population_id,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Baseline strategy identity.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        b.module2_model_version AS baseline_module2_model_version,
        b.strategy_set_name AS baseline_strategy_set_name,
        b.strategy_name AS baseline_strategy_name,
        b.strategy_version AS baseline_strategy_version,
        b.strategy_run_id AS baseline_strategy_run_id,
        b.strategy_run_ts AS baseline_strategy_run_ts,
        b.archive_inserted_ts AS baseline_archive_inserted_ts,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Challenger strategy identity.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        c.module2_model_version AS challenger_module2_model_version,
        c.strategy_set_name AS challenger_strategy_set_name,
        c.strategy_name AS challenger_strategy_name,
        c.strategy_version AS challenger_strategy_version,
        c.strategy_run_id AS challenger_strategy_run_id,
        c.strategy_run_ts AS challenger_strategy_run_ts,
        c.archive_inserted_ts AS challenger_archive_inserted_ts,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Immutable Module 1 source fields — baseline.
        These should match challenger values in a clean matched comparison.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        b.module1_scenario_set_name AS baseline_module1_scenario_set_name,
        b.module1_scenario_name AS baseline_module1_scenario_name,
        b.population_id AS baseline_population_id,

        b.product_type_policy_key AS baseline_product_type_policy_key,
        b.score_band_policy_key AS baseline_score_band_policy_key,
        b.credit_score AS baseline_credit_score,
        b.annual_income AS baseline_annual_income,
        b.requested_amount AS baseline_requested_amount,
        b.requested_monthly_payment_proxy AS baseline_requested_monthly_payment_proxy,
        b.requested_payment_to_income_ratio AS baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
        b.amount_to_income_ratio AS baseline_amount_to_income_ratio,
        b.estimated_pd AS baseline_estimated_pd,
        b.estimated_lgd AS baseline_estimated_lgd,
        b.requested_expected_loss_amount AS baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Immutable Module 1 source fields — challenger.
        These should match baseline values in a clean matched comparison.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        c.module1_scenario_set_name AS challenger_module1_scenario_set_name,
        c.module1_scenario_name AS challenger_module1_scenario_name,
        c.population_id AS challenger_population_id,

        c.product_type_policy_key AS challenger_product_type_policy_key,
        c.score_band_policy_key AS challenger_score_band_policy_key,
        c.credit_score AS challenger_credit_score,
        c.annual_income AS challenger_annual_income,
        c.requested_amount AS challenger_requested_amount,
        c.requested_monthly_payment_proxy AS challenger_requested_monthly_payment_proxy,
        c.requested_payment_to_income_ratio AS challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
        c.amount_to_income_ratio AS challenger_amount_to_income_ratio,
        c.estimated_pd AS challenger_estimated_pd,
        c.estimated_lgd AS challenger_estimated_lgd,
        c.requested_expected_loss_amount AS challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Common segment dimensions.

        COALESCE is used only for grouping convenience. Source consistency is validated separately.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        COALESCE(b.product_type_policy_key, c.product_type_policy_key)
            AS product_type_policy_key,

        COALESCE(b.score_band_policy_key, c.score_band_policy_key)
            AS score_band_policy_key,

        COALESCE(b.product_score_policy_segment, c.product_score_policy_segment)
            AS product_score_policy_segment,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Baseline diagnostic segmentation and triggers.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        b.strategy_risk_tier AS baseline_strategy_risk_tier,
        b.requested_pti_bucket AS baseline_requested_pti_bucket,
        b.dti_bucket AS baseline_dti_bucket,
        b.requested_exposure_tier AS baseline_requested_exposure_tier,
        b.requested_expected_loss_tier AS baseline_requested_expected_loss_tier,
        b.mixed_signal_profile_type AS baseline_mixed_signal_profile_type,
        b.borderline_profile_flag AS baseline_borderline_profile_flag,
        b.total_rule_trigger_count AS baseline_total_rule_trigger_count,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Challenger diagnostic segmentation and triggers.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        c.strategy_risk_tier AS challenger_strategy_risk_tier,
        c.requested_pti_bucket AS challenger_requested_pti_bucket,
        c.dti_bucket AS challenger_dti_bucket,
        c.requested_exposure_tier AS challenger_requested_exposure_tier,
        c.requested_expected_loss_tier AS challenger_requested_expected_loss_tier,
        c.mixed_signal_profile_type AS challenger_mixed_signal_profile_type,
        c.borderline_profile_flag AS challenger_borderline_profile_flag,
        c.total_rule_trigger_count AS challenger_total_rule_trigger_count,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Baseline final decision and final exposure fields.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        b.decision_outcome AS baseline_decision_outcome,
        b.decision_path AS baseline_decision_path,
        b.decision_resolution_source AS baseline_decision_resolution_source,

        b.approval_flag AS baseline_approval_flag,
        b.counteroffer_flag AS baseline_counteroffer_flag,
        b.manual_review_flag AS baseline_manual_review_flag,
        b.decline_flag AS baseline_decline_flag,
        b.simulated_offer_exposure_flag AS baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag,

        b.approved_amount AS baseline_approved_amount,
        b.counteroffer_amount AS baseline_counteroffer_amount,
        b.exposure_reduction_amount AS baseline_exposure_reduction_amount,
        b.exposure_reduction_pct AS baseline_exposure_reduction_pct,

        b.approved_payment_to_income_ratio AS baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,
        b.approved_expected_loss_amount AS baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount,
        b.approved_el_reduction_amount AS baseline_approved_el_reduction_amount,
        b.approved_el_reduction_pct AS baseline_approved_el_reduction_pct,

        b.primary_reason_family AS baseline_primary_reason_family,
        b.primary_reason_code AS baseline_primary_reason_code,
        b.secondary_reason_code AS baseline_secondary_reason_code,
        b.tertiary_reason_code AS baseline_tertiary_reason_code,
        b.triggered_reason_code_list AS baseline_triggered_reason_code_list,
        b.reason_code_count AS baseline_reason_code_count,


        /*******************************************************************************************
        Challenger final decision and final exposure fields.
        *******************************************************************************************/
        c.decision_outcome AS challenger_decision_outcome,
        c.decision_path AS challenger_decision_path,
        c.decision_resolution_source AS challenger_decision_resolution_source,

        c.approval_flag AS challenger_approval_flag,
        c.counteroffer_flag AS challenger_counteroffer_flag,
        c.manual_review_flag AS challenger_manual_review_flag,
        c.decline_flag AS challenger_decline_flag,
        c.simulated_offer_exposure_flag AS challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag,

        c.approved_amount AS challenger_approved_amount,
        c.counteroffer_amount AS challenger_counteroffer_amount,
        c.exposure_reduction_amount AS challenger_exposure_reduction_amount,
        c.exposure_reduction_pct AS challenger_exposure_reduction_pct,

        c.approved_payment_to_income_ratio AS challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,
        c.approved_expected_loss_amount AS challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount,
        c.approved_el_reduction_amount AS challenger_approved_el_reduction_amount,
        c.approved_el_reduction_pct AS challenger_approved_el_reduction_pct,

        c.primary_reason_family AS challenger_primary_reason_family,
        c.primary_reason_code AS challenger_primary_reason_code,
        c.secondary_reason_code AS challenger_secondary_reason_code,
        c.tertiary_reason_code AS challenger_tertiary_reason_code,
        c.triggered_reason_code_list AS challenger_triggered_reason_code_list,
        c.reason_code_count AS challenger_reason_code_count

    FROM params p

    JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive b
        ON b.strategy_set_name = p.baseline_strategy_set_name
       AND b.strategy_name = p.baseline_strategy_name
       AND b.strategy_version = p.baseline_strategy_version
       AND b.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND b.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
       AND b.population_id = p.population_id

    JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive c
        ON c.strategy_set_name = p.challenger_strategy_set_name
       AND c.strategy_name = p.challenger_strategy_name
       AND c.strategy_version = p.challenger_strategy_version
       AND c.module1_scenario_set_name = p.module1_scenario_set_name
       AND c.module1_scenario_name = p.module1_scenario_name
       AND c.population_id = p.population_id
       AND c.application_id = b.application_id
)

SELECT
    mr.*,

    /***********************************************************************************************
    Final outcome migration label.

    This label is a diagnostic summary of how the same synthetic applicant moved between strategies.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    CASE
        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome = mr.challenger_decision_outcome
            THEN 'STABLE_OUTCOME'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
            THEN 'APPROVE_TO_COUNTEROFFER_EXPOSURE_REDUCTION'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER'
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE'
            THEN 'COUNTEROFFER_TO_APPROVE_ACCESS_EXPANSION'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER')
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome IN ('MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
            THEN 'OFFER_TO_NO_OFFER_OR_UNRESOLVED_RISK_TIGHTENING'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome IN ('MANUAL_REVIEW', 'DECLINE')
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome IN ('APPROVE', 'COUNTEROFFER')
            THEN 'NO_OFFER_OR_UNRESOLVED_TO_OFFER_ACCESS_EXPANSION'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
            THEN 'MANUAL_REVIEW_TO_DECLINE_REVIEW_BURDEN_REDUCTION'

        WHEN mr.baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE'
         AND mr.challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
            THEN 'DECLINE_TO_MANUAL_REVIEW_REVIEW_EXPANSION'

        ELSE 'MIXED_DECISION_MIGRATION'
    END AS decision_migration_type,


    /***********************************************************************************************
    Numeric deltas.

    COALESCE treats unresolved / no-offer approved values as zero for all-application portfolio
    impact comparison.

    Requested fields should normally have zero deltas because the matched source population is the
    same.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    COALESCE(mr.challenger_approved_amount, 0)
        - COALESCE(mr.baseline_approved_amount, 0)
        AS delta_approved_amount,

    COALESCE(mr.challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)
        - COALESCE(mr.baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)
        AS delta_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    COALESCE(mr.challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio, 0)
        - COALESCE(mr.baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio, 0)
        AS delta_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,

    COALESCE(mr.challenger_requested_amount, 0)
        - COALESCE(mr.baseline_requested_amount, 0)
        AS delta_requested_amount,

    COALESCE(mr.challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount, 0)
        - COALESCE(mr.baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount, 0)
        AS delta_requested_expected_loss_amount

FROM matched_rows mr;
