/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.4 — PORTFOLIO-LEVEL BASELINE / CHALLENGER SUMMARY
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Compare baseline and challenger portfolio outcomes on the same matched applicant population.

    Section 13.4 answers:

        "How did the challenger change high-level simulated outcome mix, offer exposure, approved
         exposure, approved affordability, and approved Expected Loss relative to baseline?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Summarize baseline portfolio metrics.
    2. Summarize challenger portfolio metrics.
    3. Display baseline and challenger side-by-side as rows.
    4. Display challenger-minus-baseline deltas as one compact row.

BOUNDARY:
    These are simulated strategy metrics, not production outcomes.

****************************************************************************************************/



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.4A Baseline and challenger portfolio summary.

Interpretation:
    This is the high-level matched comparison table.

    Review rates and totals before drilling into migration, segments, reason codes, and source
    consistency.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH side_summary AS (
    SELECT
        'BASELINE'::TEXT AS comparison_side,

        COUNT(*) AS applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE') AS approval_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER') AS counteroffer_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW') AS manual_review_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE') AS decline_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE) AS offer_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(baseline_requested_amount) AS total_requested_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(baseline_requested_amount), 0) AS approved_amount_capture_rate,

        SUM(baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS total_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            AS total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
            AS approved_expected_loss_rate,

        AVG(baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio)
            AS avg_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

        AVG(baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
            FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        AVG(baseline_estimated_pd)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_all_apps,

        AVG(baseline_estimated_pd)
            FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CHALLENGER'::TEXT AS comparison_side,

        COUNT(*) AS applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE') AS approval_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER') AS counteroffer_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW') AS manual_review_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE') AS decline_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE) AS offer_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(challenger_requested_amount) AS total_requested_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(challenger_requested_amount), 0) AS approved_amount_capture_rate,

        SUM(challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount)
            AS total_requested_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            AS total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
            AS approved_expected_loss_rate,

        AVG(challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio)
            AS avg_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

        AVG(challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
            FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        AVG(challenger_estimated_pd)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_all_apps,

        AVG(challenger_estimated_pd)
            FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
)

SELECT *
FROM side_summary
ORDER BY
    CASE comparison_side
        WHEN 'BASELINE' THEN 1
        WHEN 'CHALLENGER' THEN 2
        ELSE 99
    END;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.4B Portfolio-level challenger-minus-baseline deltas.

Interpretation:
    Positive delta_simulated_offer_exposure_rate:
        challenger expanded simulated positive offer exposure.

    Negative delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount:
        challenger reduced approved-exposure Expected Loss.

    Negative delta_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows:
        challenger improved the offered-population synthetic risk profile.

Boundary:
    Deltas are simulated strategy movement, not production performance movement.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH side_summary AS (
    SELECT
        'BASELINE'::TEXT AS comparison_side,

        COUNT(*) AS applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
            AS approved_expected_loss_rate,

        AVG(baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
            FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        AVG(baseline_estimated_pd)
            FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CHALLENGER'::TEXT AS comparison_side,

        COUNT(*) AS applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
            / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
            AS approved_expected_loss_rate,

        AVG(challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
            FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        AVG(challenger_estimated_pd)
            FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
            AS avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
),

pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(applications) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_applications,
        MAX(applications) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_applications,

        MAX(approval_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_approval_rate,
        MAX(approval_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_approval_rate,

        MAX(counteroffer_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_counteroffer_rate,
        MAX(counteroffer_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_counteroffer_rate,

        MAX(manual_review_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_manual_review_rate,
        MAX(manual_review_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_manual_review_rate,

        MAX(decline_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_decline_rate,
        MAX(decline_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_decline_rate,

        MAX(simulated_offer_exposure_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE')
            AS baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        MAX(simulated_offer_exposure_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER')
            AS challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        MAX(total_approved_amount) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE') AS baseline_total_approved_amount,
        MAX(total_approved_amount) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER') AS challenger_total_approved_amount,

        MAX(total_approved_expected_loss_amount) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE')
            AS baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        MAX(total_approved_expected_loss_amount) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER')
            AS challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

        MAX(approved_expected_loss_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE')
            AS baseline_approved_expected_loss_rate,

        MAX(approved_expected_loss_rate) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER')
            AS challenger_approved_expected_loss_rate,

        MAX(avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE')
            AS baseline_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        MAX(avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER')
            AS challenger_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

        MAX(avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'BASELINE')
            AS baseline_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows,

        MAX(avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows) FILTER (WHERE comparison_side = 'CHALLENGER')
            AS challenger_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

    FROM side_summary
)

SELECT
    baseline_applications,
    challenger_applications,

    baseline_approval_rate,
    challenger_approval_rate,
    challenger_approval_rate - baseline_approval_rate AS delta_approval_rate,

    baseline_counteroffer_rate,
    challenger_counteroffer_rate,
    challenger_counteroffer_rate - baseline_counteroffer_rate AS delta_counteroffer_rate,

    baseline_manual_review_rate,
    challenger_manual_review_rate,
    challenger_manual_review_rate - baseline_manual_review_rate AS delta_manual_review_rate,

    baseline_decline_rate,
    challenger_decline_rate,
    challenger_decline_rate - baseline_decline_rate AS delta_decline_rate,

    baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate - baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate
        AS delta_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

    baseline_total_approved_amount,
    challenger_total_approved_amount,
    challenger_total_approved_amount - baseline_total_approved_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount - baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    baseline_approved_expected_loss_rate,
    challenger_approved_expected_loss_rate,
    challenger_approved_expected_loss_rate - baseline_approved_expected_loss_rate
        AS delta_approved_expected_loss_rate,

    baseline_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,
    challenger_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,
    challenger_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows
        - baseline_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows
        AS delta_avg_approved_payment_to_income_ratio_offer_rows,

    baseline_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows,
    challenger_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows,
    challenger_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows
        - baseline_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows
        AS delta_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy_offer_rows

FROM pivoted;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.5 — DECISION OUTCOME MIGRATION MATRIX
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Show how final simulated outcomes moved from baseline to challenger for the same applications.

    Section 13.5 answers:

        "Which applicants stayed in the same outcome, and which moved from one strategy outcome to
         another?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    Group matched rows by baseline_decision_outcome, challenger_decision_outcome, and migration type.

****************************************************************************************************/

SELECT
    baseline_decision_outcome,
    challenger_decision_outcome,
    decision_migration_type,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_matched_population,

    AVG(baseline_estimated_pd) AS avg_baseline_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,
    AVG(challenger_estimated_pd) AS avg_challenger_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

    AVG(baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio) AS avg_baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
    AVG(challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio) AS avg_challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

    AVG(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS avg_baseline_approved_amount_all_rows,
    AVG(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS avg_challenger_approved_amount_all_rows,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_baseline_approved_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_challenger_approved_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY
    baseline_decision_outcome,
    challenger_decision_outcome,
    decision_migration_type

ORDER BY
    row_count DESC,
    baseline_decision_outcome,
    challenger_decision_outcome;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.6 — MATCHED APPLICANT-LEVEL DELTA SAMPLE
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Provide row-level examples of how the challenger changed outcomes and economics for individual
    synthetic applicants.

    Section 13.6 answers:

        "What do the actual matched applicant-level changes look like?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    Display a limited sample ordered by largest absolute approved-exposure movement and Expected Loss
    movement.

BOUNDARY:
    This is a diagnostic sample.

    It should not be treated as the complete comparison result.

****************************************************************************************************/

SELECT
    application_id,

    product_type_policy_key,
    score_band_policy_key,

    baseline_decision_outcome,
    challenger_decision_outcome,
    decision_migration_type,

    baseline_primary_reason_code,
    challenger_primary_reason_code,

    baseline_requested_amount,
    challenger_requested_amount,
    delta_requested_amount,

    baseline_approved_amount,
    challenger_approved_amount,
    delta_approved_amount,

    baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
    challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

    baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,
    challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,
    delta_approved_payment_to_income_ratio,

    baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    delta_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    delta_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    baseline_estimated_pd,
    challenger_estimated_pd,

    baseline_total_rule_trigger_count,
    challenger_total_rule_trigger_count,

    baseline_decision_path,
    challenger_decision_path

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

ORDER BY
    ABS(delta_approved_amount) DESC NULLS LAST,
    ABS(delta_approved_expected_loss_amount) DESC NULLS LAST,
    application_id

LIMIT 100;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.7 — PRODUCT, SCORE-BAND, AND PRODUCT × SCORE COMPARISON DIAGNOSTICS
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Show where strategy movement concentrates by product, score band, and product × score segment.

    Section 13.7 answers:

        "Which portfolio segments drove the baseline / challenger differences?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Compare product-level baseline and challenger metrics.
    2. Compare score-band-level baseline and challenger metrics.
    3. Compare product × score-level baseline and challenger metrics.

****************************************************************************************************/



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.7A Product-level comparison.

Interpretation:
    Product-level movement may reflect product caps, LGD, requested exposure, PTI, counteroffer
    feasibility, and product-policy settings.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT
        baseline_product_type_policy_key AS product_type_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS baseline_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY baseline_product_type_policy_key
),

challenger AS (
    SELECT
        challenger_product_type_policy_key AS product_type_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS challenger_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY challenger_product_type_policy_key
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(b.product_type_policy_key, c.product_type_policy_key)
        AS product_type_policy_key,

    b.baseline_applications,
    c.challenger_applications,

    b.baseline_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate - b.baseline_approval_rate AS delta_approval_rate,

    b.baseline_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate - b.baseline_counteroffer_rate AS delta_counteroffer_rate,

    b.baseline_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate - b.baseline_manual_review_rate AS delta_manual_review_rate,

    b.baseline_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate - b.baseline_decline_rate AS delta_decline_rate,

    b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate - b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate
        AS delta_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

    b.baseline_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM baseline b

FULL OUTER JOIN challenger c
    ON c.product_type_policy_key = b.product_type_policy_key

ORDER BY product_type_policy_key;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.7B Score-band-level comparison.

Interpretation:
    Score-band movement shows how borrower-quality segments respond to challenger strategy rules.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT
        baseline_score_band_policy_key AS score_band_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS baseline_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        AVG(baseline_credit_score) AS baseline_avg_credit_score,
        AVG(baseline_estimated_pd) AS baseline_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY baseline_score_band_policy_key
),

challenger AS (
    SELECT
        challenger_score_band_policy_key AS score_band_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS challenger_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        AVG(challenger_credit_score) AS challenger_avg_credit_score,
        AVG(challenger_estimated_pd) AS challenger_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY challenger_score_band_policy_key
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(b.score_band_policy_key, c.score_band_policy_key)
        AS score_band_policy_key,

    b.baseline_applications,
    c.challenger_applications,

    b.baseline_avg_credit_score,
    c.challenger_avg_credit_score,

    b.baseline_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,
    c.challenger_avg_synthetic_estimated_pd_proxy,

    b.baseline_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate - b.baseline_approval_rate AS delta_approval_rate,

    b.baseline_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate - b.baseline_counteroffer_rate AS delta_counteroffer_rate,

    b.baseline_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate - b.baseline_manual_review_rate AS delta_manual_review_rate,

    b.baseline_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate - b.baseline_decline_rate AS delta_decline_rate,

    b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate - b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate
        AS delta_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

    b.baseline_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM baseline b

FULL OUTER JOIN challenger c
    ON c.score_band_policy_key = b.score_band_policy_key

ORDER BY
    CASE COALESCE(b.score_band_policy_key, c.score_band_policy_key)
        WHEN 'SUPER_PRIME' THEN 1
        WHEN 'PRIME' THEN 2
        WHEN 'NEAR_PRIME' THEN 3
        WHEN 'SUBPRIME' THEN 4
        WHEN 'DEEP_SUBPRIME' THEN 5
        ELSE 99
    END;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.7C Product × score-band comparison.

Interpretation:
    This is the most important segment-level comparison grid for explaining where movement is
    concentrated.

    Portfolio-level deltas can hide product × score concentration.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH baseline AS (
    SELECT
        baseline_product_type_policy_key AS product_type_policy_key,
        baseline_score_band_policy_key AS score_band_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS baseline_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY
        baseline_product_type_policy_key,
        baseline_score_band_policy_key
),

challenger AS (
    SELECT
        challenger_product_type_policy_key AS product_type_policy_key,
        challenger_score_band_policy_key AS score_band_policy_key,

        COUNT(*) AS challenger_applications,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'APPROVE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_approval_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'COUNTEROFFER')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_counteroffer_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'MANUAL_REVIEW')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_manual_review_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_decision_outcome = 'DECLINE')::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_decline_rate,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)::NUMERIC
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0)) AS challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY
        challenger_product_type_policy_key,
        challenger_score_band_policy_key
)

SELECT
    COALESCE(b.product_type_policy_key, c.product_type_policy_key)
        AS product_type_policy_key,

    COALESCE(b.score_band_policy_key, c.score_band_policy_key)
        AS score_band_policy_key,

    b.baseline_applications,
    c.challenger_applications,

    b.baseline_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate,
    c.challenger_approval_rate - b.baseline_approval_rate AS delta_approval_rate,

    b.baseline_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate,
    c.challenger_counteroffer_rate - b.baseline_counteroffer_rate AS delta_counteroffer_rate,

    b.baseline_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate,
    c.challenger_manual_review_rate - b.baseline_manual_review_rate AS delta_manual_review_rate,

    b.baseline_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate,
    c.challenger_decline_rate - b.baseline_decline_rate AS delta_decline_rate,

    b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,
    c.challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_rate - b.baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_rate
        AS delta_simulated_offer_exposure_rate,

    b.baseline_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,
    c.challenger_total_approved_expected_loss_amount - b.baseline_total_approved_expected_loss_amount
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM baseline b

FULL OUTER JOIN challenger c
    ON c.product_type_policy_key = b.product_type_policy_key
   AND c.score_band_policy_key = b.score_band_policy_key

ORDER BY
    product_type_policy_key,
    CASE score_band_policy_key
        WHEN 'SUPER_PRIME' THEN 1
        WHEN 'PRIME' THEN 2
        WHEN 'NEAR_PRIME' THEN 3
        WHEN 'SUBPRIME' THEN 4
        WHEN 'DEEP_SUBPRIME' THEN 5
        ELSE 99
    END;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.8 — REASON-CODE MOVEMENT DIAGNOSTICS
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Explain why strategy movement occurred, not only how much movement occurred.

    Section 13.8 answers:

        "Which simulated explanation-code themes increased, decreased, or migrated under the
         challenger?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Compare primary reason-code distribution by side.
    2. Show reason-code migration from baseline to challenger.
    3. Surface reason-code movement by product.

BOUNDARY:
    Reason-code movement is internal simulated strategy explainability.

    It is not customer communication or regulatory notice evidence.

****************************************************************************************************/



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.8A Primary reason-code distribution by comparison side.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

WITH reason_distribution AS (
    SELECT
        'BASELINE'::TEXT AS comparison_side,
        baseline_primary_reason_family AS primary_reason_family,
        baseline_primary_reason_code AS primary_reason_code,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY
        baseline_primary_reason_family,
        baseline_primary_reason_code

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CHALLENGER'::TEXT AS comparison_side,
        challenger_primary_reason_family AS primary_reason_family,
        challenger_primary_reason_code AS primary_reason_code,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
    GROUP BY
        challenger_primary_reason_family,
        challenger_primary_reason_code
)

SELECT
    comparison_side,
    primary_reason_family,
    primary_reason_code,
    row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * row_count::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(row_count) OVER (PARTITION BY comparison_side), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_within_comparison_side

FROM reason_distribution

ORDER BY
    comparison_side,
    row_count DESC,
    primary_reason_family,
    primary_reason_code;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.8B Primary reason-code migration matrix.

Interpretation:
    Use this output to understand how explanation themes changed applicant by applicant.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    baseline_primary_reason_family,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,

    challenger_primary_reason_family,
    challenger_primary_reason_code,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_matched_population,

    AVG(delta_approved_amount) AS avg_delta_approved_amount,
    AVG(delta_approved_expected_loss_amount) AS avg_delta_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY
    baseline_primary_reason_family,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,
    challenger_primary_reason_family,
    challenger_primary_reason_code

ORDER BY
    row_count DESC,
    baseline_primary_reason_family,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,
    challenger_primary_reason_family,
    challenger_primary_reason_code;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.8C Product × reason-code movement.

Interpretation:
    Product concentration in reason-code movement may identify where policy guardrails,
    affordability adjustments, or risk discipline are most active.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    product_type_policy_key,

    baseline_primary_reason_family,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,

    challenger_primary_reason_family,
    challenger_primary_reason_code,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    AVG(delta_approved_amount) AS avg_delta_approved_amount,
    AVG(delta_approved_expected_loss_amount) AS avg_delta_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY
    product_type_policy_key,
    baseline_primary_reason_family,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,
    challenger_primary_reason_family,
    challenger_primary_reason_code

ORDER BY
    product_type_policy_key,
    row_count DESC,
    baseline_primary_reason_code,
    challenger_primary_reason_code;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.9 — SIMULATED OFFER-EXPOSURE AND ECONOMIC TRANSITION DIAGNOSTICS
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Show how simulated offer exposure, approved exposure, affordability, and approved Expected Loss
    moved under the challenger.

    Section 13.9 answers:

        "Did the challenger change access, exposure capture, affordability, and approved Expected Loss
         in ways that are visible and explainable?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Summarize simulated offer-exposure flag transitions.
    2. Summarize approved exposure deltas by outcome migration type.
    3. Summarize approved Expected Loss deltas by outcome migration type.

****************************************************************************************************/



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.9A Simulated offer-exposure flag transition.

Interpretation:
    FALSE → TRUE:
        access expansion.

    TRUE → FALSE:
        risk tightening or review / no-offer shift.

    TRUE → TRUE:
        retained simulated positive offer exposure, possibly with changed approved amount.

Boundary:
    simulated_offer_exposure_flag is simulated positive offer exposure, not booked exposure.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag,
    challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag,

    CASE
        WHEN baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE
         AND challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE
            THEN 'OFFER_EXPOSURE_RETAINED'

        WHEN baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS FALSE
         AND challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE
            THEN 'OFFER_EXPOSURE_GAINED'

        WHEN baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE
         AND challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS FALSE
            THEN 'OFFER_EXPOSURE_REMOVED'

        ELSE 'NO_OFFER_EXPOSURE_BOTH'
    END AS offer_exposure_transition_type,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*)::NUMERIC
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_of_matched_population,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_baseline_approved_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_challenger_approved_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY
    baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag,
    challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag

ORDER BY
    offer_exposure_transition_type;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.9B Approved exposure movement by decision migration type.

Purpose:
    Connect outcome migration to exposure movement.

Interpretation:
    Large exposure reduction with retained offer exposure may indicate counteroffer management.
    Exposure removal may indicate risk discipline or manual-review / decline migration.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    decision_migration_type,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_baseline_approved_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)) AS total_challenger_approved_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_amount,

    AVG(delta_approved_amount) AS avg_delta_approved_amount,

    AVG(baseline_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
        FILTER (WHERE baseline_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
        AS avg_baseline_approved_pti_offer_rows,

    AVG(challenger_approved_payment_to_income_ratio)
        FILTER (WHERE challenger_simulated_offer_exposure_flag IS TRUE)
        AS avg_challenger_approved_pti_offer_rows

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY decision_migration_type

ORDER BY
    ABS(SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0))) DESC,
    decision_migration_type;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.9C Approved Expected Loss movement by decision migration type.

Purpose:
    Connect outcome migration to approved-exposure Expected Loss movement.

Boundary:
    approved_expected_loss_amount is a synthetic strategy metric, not a production loss forecast.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    decision_migration_type,

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS total_challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        AS delta_total_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    AVG(delta_approved_expected_loss_amount)
        AS avg_delta_approved_expected_loss_amount,

    SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
        AS baseline_approved_expected_loss_rate,

    SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_amount, 0)), 0)
        AS challenger_approved_expected_loss_rate

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

GROUP BY decision_migration_type

ORDER BY
    ABS(
        SUM(COALESCE(challenger_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
        - SUM(COALESCE(baseline_approved_expected_loss_amount, 0))
    ) DESC,
    decision_migration_type;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.10 — MATCHED SOURCE-FIELD CONSISTENCY DIAGNOSTIC
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Confirm that matched baseline and challenger rows share the same immutable Module 1 source fields.

    Section 13.10 answers:

        "Can the matched comparison be interpreted as downstream Module 2 strategy movement, or do
         source-field differences require review first?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Compare immutable source fields using IS DISTINCT FROM.
    2. Count mismatch types.
    3. Materialize tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_source_consistency.
    4. Display the source-consistency diagnostic.
    5. Display a limited sample of mismatched rows where applicable.

WHY THIS SECTION MATTERS:
    Matched comparison is only clean when baseline and challenger rows represent the same synthetic
    applicant under the same Module 1 source conditions.

    If source fields differ, the comparison may reflect:
        population drift,
        source-selection error,
        upstream scenario mismatch,
        archive slice mismatch,
        or manual archive corruption.

BOUNDARY:
    This section is read-only.
    It does not repair mismatches.
    It does not mutate archive rows.
    It does not recalculate decisions.
    It does not recalculate approved exposure or Expected Loss.

****************************************************************************************************/

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_source_consistency
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
AS
WITH readiness AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_readiness
    LIMIT 1
),

field_flags AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    One row per matched applicant with nullable-safe mismatch flags.

    SQL mechanics:
        IS DISTINCT FROM treats NULL versus non-NULL as different and NULL versus NULL as equal.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        application_id,

        (
            baseline_product_type_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_product_type_policy_key
        ) AS product_type_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_score_band_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_score_band_policy_key
        ) AS score_band_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_credit_score IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_credit_score
        ) AS credit_score_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_annual_income IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_annual_income
        ) AS annual_income_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_requested_amount IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_amount
        ) AS requested_amount_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_requested_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_monthly_payment_proxy
        ) AS requested_payment_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio
        ) AS requested_pti_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_amount_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_amount_to_income_ratio
        ) AS amount_to_income_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_estimated_pd IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_estimated_pd
        ) AS estimated_pd_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_estimated_lgd IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_estimated_lgd
        ) AS estimated_lgd_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount
        ) AS requested_expected_loss_mismatch_flag,

        (
            baseline_module1_scenario_set_name IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_module1_scenario_set_name
            OR baseline_module1_scenario_name IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_module1_scenario_name
            OR baseline_population_id IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_population_id
        ) AS module1_lineage_mismatch_flag

    FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows
),

summary AS (
    /***********************************************************************************************
    Aggregate mismatch counts.

    A clean matched strategy comparison should have all mismatch counts equal to zero.
    ***********************************************************************************************/
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS matched_application_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE product_type_mismatch_flag
               OR score_band_mismatch_flag
               OR credit_score_mismatch_flag
               OR annual_income_mismatch_flag
               OR requested_amount_mismatch_flag
               OR requested_payment_mismatch_flag
               OR requested_pti_mismatch_flag
               OR amount_to_income_mismatch_flag
               OR estimated_pd_mismatch_flag
               OR estimated_lgd_mismatch_flag
               OR requested_expected_loss_mismatch_flag
               OR module1_lineage_mismatch_flag
        ) AS source_field_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product_type_mismatch_flag)
            AS product_type_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE score_band_mismatch_flag)
            AS score_band_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE credit_score_mismatch_flag)
            AS credit_score_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE annual_income_mismatch_flag)
            AS annual_income_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE requested_amount_mismatch_flag)
            AS requested_amount_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE requested_payment_mismatch_flag)
            AS requested_payment_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE requested_pti_mismatch_flag)
            AS requested_pti_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount_to_income_mismatch_flag)
            AS amount_to_income_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_pd_mismatch_flag)
            AS estimated_pd_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_lgd_mismatch_flag)
            AS estimated_lgd_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE requested_expected_loss_mismatch_flag)
            AS requested_expected_loss_mismatch_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE module1_lineage_mismatch_flag)
            AS module1_lineage_mismatch_count

    FROM field_flags
)

SELECT
    r.comparison_group_id,
    r.comparison_set_name,

    r.baseline_module2_run_id,
    r.challenger_module2_run_id,

    r.module1_scenario_set_name,
    r.module1_scenario_name,
    r.population_id,

    r.readiness_status,

    s.matched_application_count,
    s.source_field_mismatch_count,

    s.product_type_mismatch_count,
    s.score_band_mismatch_count,
    s.credit_score_mismatch_count,
    s.annual_income_mismatch_count,
    s.requested_amount_mismatch_count,
    s.requested_payment_mismatch_count,
    s.requested_pti_mismatch_count,
    s.amount_to_income_mismatch_count,
    s.estimated_pd_mismatch_count,
    s.estimated_lgd_mismatch_count,
    s.requested_expected_loss_mismatch_count,
    s.module1_lineage_mismatch_count,

    CASE
        WHEN r.readiness_status <> 'READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'
            THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON'

        WHEN s.source_field_mismatch_count = 0
            THEN 'SOURCE_FIELDS_MATCH'

        ELSE 'SOURCE_FIELD_MISMATCH_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
    END AS source_consistency_status

FROM readiness r
CROSS JOIN summary s;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.10A Matched source-field consistency output.

Expected:
    source_consistency_status = SOURCE_FIELDS_MATCH
    when readiness_status = READY_FOR_MATCHED_COMPARISON.

Interpretation:
    Non-zero mismatch counts should be reviewed before interpreting comparison deltas as pure Module
    2 strategy movement.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    comparison_group_id,
    comparison_set_name,

    baseline_module2_run_id,
    challenger_module2_run_id,

    module1_scenario_set_name,
    module1_scenario_name,
    population_id,

    readiness_status,

    matched_application_count,
    source_field_mismatch_count,

    product_type_mismatch_count,
    score_band_mismatch_count,
    credit_score_mismatch_count,
    annual_income_mismatch_count,
    requested_amount_mismatch_count,
    requested_payment_mismatch_count,
    requested_pti_mismatch_count,
    amount_to_income_mismatch_count,
    estimated_pd_mismatch_count,
    estimated_lgd_mismatch_count,
    requested_expected_loss_mismatch_count,
    module1_lineage_mismatch_count,

    source_consistency_status

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_source_consistency;



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
13.10B Source-field mismatch sample.

Purpose:
    Display up to 50 mismatched rows if source consistency fails.

Expected:
    zero rows when source_consistency_status = SOURCE_FIELDS_MATCH.

Boundary:
    This is a diagnostic sample. It does not repair source mismatches.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

SELECT
    application_id,

    baseline_product_type_policy_key,
    challenger_product_type_policy_key,

    baseline_score_band_policy_key,
    challenger_score_band_policy_key,

    baseline_credit_score,
    challenger_credit_score,

    baseline_annual_income,
    challenger_annual_income,

    baseline_requested_amount,
    challenger_requested_amount,

    baseline_requested_monthly_payment_proxy,
    challenger_requested_monthly_payment_proxy,

    baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,
    challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio,

    baseline_amount_to_income_ratio,
    challenger_amount_to_income_ratio,

    baseline_estimated_pd,
    challenger_estimated_pd,

    baseline_estimated_lgd,
    challenger_estimated_lgd,

    baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount,
    challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount,

    baseline_module1_scenario_set_name,
    challenger_module1_scenario_set_name,

    baseline_module1_scenario_name,
    challenger_module1_scenario_name,

    baseline_population_id,
    challenger_population_id

FROM tmp_m2_strategy_comparison_matched_rows

WHERE baseline_product_type_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_product_type_policy_key
   OR baseline_score_band_policy_key IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_score_band_policy_key
   OR baseline_credit_score IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_credit_score
   OR baseline_annual_income IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_annual_income
   OR baseline_requested_amount IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_amount
   OR baseline_requested_monthly_payment_proxy IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_monthly_payment_proxy
   OR baseline_requested_payment_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_payment_to_income_ratio
   OR baseline_amount_to_income_ratio IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_amount_to_income_ratio
   OR baseline_estimated_pd IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_estimated_pd
   OR baseline_estimated_lgd IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_estimated_lgd
   OR baseline_requested_expected_loss_amount IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_requested_expected_loss_amount
   OR baseline_module1_scenario_set_name IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_module1_scenario_set_name
   OR baseline_module1_scenario_name IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_module1_scenario_name
   OR baseline_population_id IS DISTINCT FROM challenger_population_id

ORDER BY application_id

LIMIT 50;



/***************************************************************************************************
SECTION 13.11 — COMPACT COMPARISON READINESS RECAP
****************************************************************************************************

BUSINESS PURPOSE:
    Provide one compact end-of-section status row for downstream QA and evidence interpretation.

    Section 13.11 answers:

        "Can this selected comparison be interpreted as a ready, source-consistent matched comparison?"

SQL PURPOSE:
    1. Combine comparison readiness with source-field consistency.
    2. Produce a compact final Section 13 status label.

****************************************************************************************************/

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_m2_validation_archive_readiness_context (
    archive_table_exists                                    BOOLEAN,
    strategy_set_name                                       TEXT,
    strategy_name                                           TEXT,
    strategy_version                                        TEXT,
    module1_scenario_set_name                               TEXT,
    module1_scenario_name                                   TEXT,
    population_id                                           TEXT,
    latest_run_rows                                         BIGINT,
    latest_run_distinct_application_id_count                BIGINT,
    current_archived_slice_rows                             BIGINT,
    current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count    BIGINT,
    current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows             BIGINT,
    archive_readiness_status                                TEXT
) ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS;

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF TO_REGCLASS('credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive') IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO tmp_m2_validation_archive_readiness_context (
            archive_table_exists,
            latest_run_rows,
            latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,
            current_archived_slice_rows,
            current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
            current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,
            archive_readiness_status
        )
        SELECT
            FALSE AS archive_table_exists,
            COUNT(*) AS latest_run_rows,
            COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,
            0::BIGINT AS current_archived_slice_rows,
            0::BIGINT AS current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
            0::BIGINT AS current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,
            'NOT_APPLICABLE_ARCHIVE_TABLE_NOT_AVAILABLE' AS archive_readiness_status
        FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions;

    ELSE
        INSERT INTO tmp_m2_validation_archive_readiness_context (
            archive_table_exists,
            strategy_set_name,
            strategy_name,
            strategy_version,
            module1_scenario_set_name,
            module1_scenario_name,
            population_id,
            latest_run_rows,
            latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,
            current_archived_slice_rows,
            current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
            current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,
            archive_readiness_status
        )
        WITH latest_key AS (
            SELECT
                strategy_set_name,
                strategy_name,
                strategy_version,
                module1_scenario_set_name,
                module1_scenario_name,
                population_id,
                COUNT(*) AS latest_run_rows,
                COUNT(DISTINCT application_id) AS latest_run_distinct_application_id_count
            FROM credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions
            GROUP BY
                strategy_set_name,
                strategy_name,
                strategy_version,
                module1_scenario_set_name,
                module1_scenario_name,
                population_id
        )

        SELECT
            TRUE AS archive_table_exists,

            k.strategy_set_name,
            k.strategy_name,
            k.strategy_version,
            k.module1_scenario_set_name,
            k.module1_scenario_name,
            k.population_id,

            k.latest_run_rows,
            k.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count,

            COUNT(ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_rows,
            COUNT(DISTINCT ar.application_id) AS current_archived_slice_distinct_application_id_count,
            COUNT(ar.application_id) FILTER (WHERE ar.archive_inserted_ts IS NULL)
                AS current_archived_slice_null_archive_ts_rows,

            CASE
                WHEN COUNT(ar.application_id) = 0
                    THEN 'REVIEW_CURRENT_LATEST_RUN_SLICE_NOT_ARCHIVED'

                WHEN COUNT(ar.application_id) <> k.latest_run_rows
                    THEN 'REVIEW_ARCHIVED_CURRENT_SLICE_ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH'

                WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ar.application_id) <> COUNT(ar.application_id)
                    THEN 'REVIEW_ARCHIVED_CURRENT_SLICE_DUPLICATE_APPLICATION_ID'

                WHEN COUNT(ar.application_id) FILTER (WHERE ar.archive_inserted_ts IS NULL) > 0
                    THEN 'REVIEW_ARCHIVED_CURRENT_SLICE_NULL_ARCHIVE_TS'

                ELSE 'CURRENT_LATEST_RUN_SLICE_ARCHIVED'
            END AS archive_readiness_status

        FROM latest_key k

        LEFT JOIN credit_decisioning_sim.strategy_decisions_archive ar
            ON ar.strategy_set_name = k.strategy_set_name
           AND ar.strategy_name = k.strategy_name
           AND ar.strategy_version = k.strategy_version
           AND ar.module1_scenario_set_name = k.module1_scenario_set_name
           AND ar.module1_scenario_name = k.module1_scenario_name
           AND ar.population_id = k.population_id

        GROUP BY
            k.strategy_set_name,
            k.strategy_name,
            k.strategy_version,
            k.module1_scenario_set_name,
            k.module1_scenario_name,
            k.population_id,
            k.latest_run_rows,
            k.latest_run_distinct_application_id_count;
    END IF;
END $$;
